title: State Employees' Health Insurance Plan, employees retiring after December 31, 2011, required to have at least 10 years creditable service for retiree coverage, premiums subject to sliding scale calculation, based on years of service and difference between the age of the employee at retirement and the Medicare entitlement age, false information basis for disqualification of coverage, employer contribution for non-Medicare retiree not to exceed contribution for active employee, Secs. 36-29-1, 36-29-7, 36-29-8, 36-29-10, 36-29-19.4, 36-29-19.7 am'd. (2011-20786)
description: State Employees' Health Insurance Plan, employees retiring after December 31, 2011, required to have at least 10 years creditable service for retiree coverage, premiums subject to sliding scale calculation, based on years of service and difference between the age of the employee at retirement and the Medicare entitlement age, false information basis for disqualification of coverage, employer contribution for non-Medicare retiree not to exceed contribution for active employee, Secs. 36-29-1, 36-29-7, 36-29-8, 36-29-10, 36-29-19.4, 36-29-19.7 am'd. (2011-20786)
frontier_rationale: Raises service requirements and shifts retiree health-premium costs toward later retirees; this is a direct reduction in public-employee compensation, not a generic spending vote.

title: Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP), employees retiring after December 31, 2011, subject to sliding scale premium calculation based on years of service and difference between age of employee at retirement and Medicare entitlement age, limit on employer contribution based on other health insurance of spouse, false information basis for disqualification of coverage, employer contribution for non-Medicare retiree not to exceed contribution for active employee, Secs. 16-25A-1, 16-25A-8.1, 16-25A-17.1, 16-25A-20, 16-25A-22 am'd. (2011-20825)
description: Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP), employees retiring after December 31, 2011, subject to sliding scale premium calculation based on years of service and difference between age of employee at retirement and Medicare entitlement age, limit on employer contribution based on other health insurance of spouse, false information basis for disqualification of coverage, employer contribution for non-Medicare retiree not to exceed contribution for active employee, Secs. 16-25A-1, 16-25A-8.1, 16-25A-17.1, 16-25A-20, 16-25A-22 am'd. (2011-20825)
frontier_rationale: Raises service requirements and shifts PEEHIP retiree premium costs toward education retirees. The prior labor-rights label confused employee compensation with collective-bargaining power.

title: Firearms, preemption of, municipalities to regulate under limited conditions, possession of a pistol further provided for, possession of in motor vehicles under certain conditions, pistol permits, further provided for, revocation and appeal of denials, business license tax for gun shows, further provided for, use of force to protect business property or self authorized, Sec. 11-45-1.1 repealed; Secs. 11-80-11, 13A-3-23, 13A-11-7, 13A-11-52, 13A-11-70, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-75, 13A-11-85, 40-12-143 am'd.
description: Firearms, preemption of, municipalities to regulate under limited conditions, possession of a pistol further provided for, possession of in motor vehicles under certain conditions, pistol permits, further provided for, revocation and appeal of denials, business license tax for gun shows, further provided for, use of force to protect business property or self authorized, Sec. 11-45-1.1 repealed; Secs. 11-80-11, 13A-3-23, 13A-11-7, 13A-11-52, 13A-11-70, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-75, 13A-11-85, 40-12-143 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broad firearms-preemption, vehicle-possession, permit, and defensive-force measure. Its principal effect expands gun access and constrains local regulation; the defensive-force provision independently broadens self-defense authority.

title: Unborn infants, bodily remains disposition regulated, sale or unlawful disposition of bodily remains of unborn infant prohibited, use of unborn infant for certain research or transplantation, prohibited, criminal penalties, Unborn Infants Dignity of Life Act
description: Unborn infants, bodily remains disposition regulated, sale or unlawful disposition of bodily remains of unborn infant prohibited, use of unborn infant for certain research or transplantation, prohibited, criminal penalties, Unborn Infants Dignity of Life Act
frontier_rationale: Regulates disposition and use of fetal remains and prohibits specified research or transfer. This belongs under abortion and fetal-personhood policy, with a restrictive direction.

title: Health care providers, authorized to decline to perform services that violate their consciences, exceptions, Health Care Rights of Conscience Act
description: Health care providers, authorized to decline to perform services that violate their consciences, exceptions, Health Care Rights of Conscience Act
frontier_rationale: Creates a broad conscience refusal right for health-care providers. It expands religious accommodation and can restrict practical access to services including reproductive care; the second effect should be retained only where the enacted exceptions confirm that scope.

title: Suicide, Assisted Suicide Ban Act, established, person or health care provider prohibited from deliberately providing aid in dying under certain conditions, civil and criminal penalties
description: Suicide, Assisted Suicide Ban Act, established, person or health care provider prohibited from deliberately providing aid in dying under certain conditions, civil and criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Creates civil and criminal prohibitions on assisted suicide. This is a direct restrictive end-of-life-policy vote and should not be generalized to unrelated criminal punishment.

title: Interpreters and Transliterators, members of public, with prior written approval of local bd of ed., provide services to public school students in emergency and incidental situations, Sec. 34-16-7 am'd.
description: Interpreters and Transliterators, members of public, with prior written approval of local bd of ed., provide services to public school students in emergency and incidental situations, Sec. 34-16-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows narrowly supervised emergency or incidental interpreting in public schools. Although it relaxes one licensing rule, the exception is too narrow and operational to support a general market-autonomy score.

title: Public schools, professional educators' associations granted same level of access to employees of public schools
description: Public schools, professional educators' associations granted same level of access to employees of public schools
frontier_rationale: Requires equal school access for professional educators' associations, weakening exclusive or preferential access by the incumbent education association. The labor-direction inference is plausible but indirect because the synopsis does not identify bargaining or dues rights.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board, Governor, appointment of bd. members, nominations, appointment of Director of Pardons and Paroles, responsibilities, criteria for board to determine consideration for parole, procedures for deviations, AG to reveiw, Secs. 15-22-20, 15-22-21, 15-22-26, 15-22-28, 15-22-36, 15-22-37 am'd.
description: Pardons and Paroles Board, Governor, appointment of bd. members, nominations, appointment of Director of Pardons and Paroles, responsibilities, criteria for board to determine consideration for parole, procedures for deviations, AG to reveiw, Secs. 15-22-20, 15-22-21, 15-22-26, 15-22-28, 15-22-36, 15-22-37 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Tightens parole consideration and restructures appointment and oversight of the parole board. It is both a punitive parole measure and a transfer of institutional authority toward the Governor and Attorney General.

title: Corrections Dept., to create Deputy Commissioner of Prison Rehabilitation within Dept. of Corrections, to create Deputy Director for Parolee Rehabilitation within Board of Pardons and Paroles, to create the Study Commission on Interagency Cooperation and Collaboration on the Rehabilitation and Reintegration of Formerly Incarcerated Individuals and to provide for its duties, to provide for membership, Sec. 14-1-1.5 am'd.
description: Corrections Dept., to create Deputy Commissioner of Prison Rehabilitation within Dept. of Corrections, to create Deputy Director for Parolee Rehabilitation within Board of Pardons and Paroles, to create the Study Commission on Interagency Cooperation and Collaboration on the Rehabilitation and Reintegration of Formerly Incarcerated Individuals and to provide for its duties, to provide for membership, Sec. 14-1-1.5 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates senior rehabilitation offices and an interagency reintegration commission. The stated institutional purpose directly favors rehabilitation and reentry.

title: Public schools, restrooms or changing areas, required to be used based on individual's biological sex, kindergarden to fifth grade classroom instruction, limited regarding sexual orientation or gender identity, St. Board of Education to adopt rules
description: Public schools, restrooms or changing areas, required to be used based on individual's biological sex, kindergarden to fifth grade classroom instruction, limited regarding sexual orientation or gender identity, St. Board of Education to adopt rules
frontier_rationale: Requires sex-designated school facilities and limits early-grade instruction on sexual orientation or gender identity. The former public-school-funding label was substantively wrong.

title: Relating to parole; to amend Section 15-22-28, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that a prisoner is not eligible for parole of he or she has been duly charged with a new offense that has not been disposed.
description: Relating to parole; to amend Section 15-22-28, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that a prisoner is not eligible for parole of he or she has been duly charged with a new offense that has not been disposed.
frontier_rationale: Makes a prisoner charged with a new unresolved offense ineligible for parole. This restricts parole eligibility and is punitive, the opposite of the prior rehabilitative label.

title: Relating to correctional incentive time; to amend Section 14-9-41, as last amended by Act 2022-322, 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975, to reduce the amount of correctional incentive time a prisoner receives; to require a prisoner to remain in a certain classification for a longer period of time before moving up to a higher classification; to provide for additional circumstances in which a prisoner may be required to forfeit his or her correctional incentive time; and to require the Department of Corrections to provide annual reports to the Legislature, the Governor, and the Attorney General regarding correctional incentive time.
description: Relating to correctional incentive time; to amend Section 14-9-41, as last amended by Act 2022-322, 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975, to reduce the amount of correctional incentive time a prisoner receives; to require a prisoner to remain in a certain classification for a longer period of time before moving up to a higher classification; to provide for additional circumstances in which a prisoner may be required to forfeit his or her correctional incentive time; and to require the Department of Corrections to provide annual reports to the Legislature, the Governor, and the Attorney General regarding correctional incentive time.
frontier_rationale: Reduces correctional incentive time, slows progression to favorable classifications, and expands forfeiture. These provisions directly increase time served and punitive control.

title: Relating to sentencing; to amend Sections 12-25-34.2, 13A-4-1, 13A-4-2, 13A-4-3, 13A-5-6, 15-18-8, and 15-22-54, Code of Alabama 1975, to add additional offenses that would be subject to the presumptive sentencing guidelines; to modify the criminal penalties for criminal solicitation, attempt, and criminal conspiracy; to give a judge discretion when sentencing a person convicted of a Class C or Class D felony offense; to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to sentencing; to amend Sections 12-25-34.2, 13A-4-1, 13A-4-2, 13A-4-3, 13A-5-6, 15-18-8, and 15-22-54, Code of Alabama 1975, to add additional offenses that would be subject to the presumptive sentencing guidelines; to modify the criminal penalties for criminal solicitation, attempt, and criminal conspiracy; to give a judge discretion when sentencing a person convicted of a Class C or Class D felony offense; to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: The measure combines broader presumptive-guideline coverage and judicial discretion for lower felonies with altered inchoate-offense penalties. Those provisions do not support a single punitive-versus-reform scalar direction; retain the vote as mixed rather than forcing it punitive.

title: Department of Corrections; Deputy Commissioner for Prison Rehabilitation renamed; number of Deputy Commissioners further provided for; additional exempt and unclassified employees created; additional Joint Prison Oversight Committee duties created
description: Department of Corrections; Deputy Commissioner for Prison Rehabilitation renamed; number of Deputy Commissioners further provided for; additional exempt and unclassified employees created; additional Joint Prison Oversight Committee duties created
frontier_rationale: Renames and restructures corrections leadership while expanding oversight-committee duties. Administrative reorganization and oversight are not themselves evidence of a rehabilitative sentencing position.

title: Alabama Renewing Alabama's Investment in Student Excellence (RAISE) Act created, additional funding for public schools authorized based on the individual needs of students
description: Alabama Renewing Alabama's Investment in Student Excellence (RAISE) Act created, additional funding for public schools authorized based on the individual needs of students
frontier_rationale: Creates needs-weighted additional funding for public schools. This is a direct expansion of public-school investment.

title: FY27 2% Teacher Pay Raise and Retiree Longevity Bonus
description: FY27 2% Teacher Pay Raise and Retiree Longevity Bonus
frontier_rationale: Provides a teacher pay raise and retiree longevity bonus. It expands education appropriations and compensation for public education employees.

title: Income tax, employment, employers hiring persons receiving unemployment compensation or whose benefits have expired, tax deduction authorized, duties to Revenue Department, Reemployment Act
description: Income tax, employment, employers hiring persons receiving unemployment compensation or whose benefits have expired, tax deduction authorized, duties to Revenue Department, Reemployment Act
frontier_rationale: Creates an employer income-tax deduction for hiring people receiving or exhausting unemployment benefits. This is a targeted employment subsidy delivered through the tax code, not evidence for a general preference to reduce income taxes.

title: Class 3 municipalities, organized under Act 618, 1973 Reg. Sess., income tax credit for hiring certain persons under age 19 during school breaks, after school, or on weekends
description: Class 3 municipalities, organized under Act 618, 1973 Reg. Sess., income tax credit for hiring certain persons under age 19 during school breaks, after school, or on weekends
frontier_rationale: Creates a narrowly targeted municipal income-tax credit for employers hiring minors during non-school hours. The incidence is on qualifying employers and the purpose is youth employment, not broad personal-income-tax relief.

title: Income tax credit authorized for employers creating jobs, under certain conditions, Full Employment Act, Secs. 40-18-270, 40-18-271, 40-18-272 repealed; Act 2010-557, 2010 Reg. Sess. repealed
description: Income tax credit authorized for employers creating jobs, under certain conditions, Full Employment Act, Secs. 40-18-270, 40-18-271, 40-18-272 repealed; Act 2010-557, 2010 Reg. Sess. repealed
frontier_rationale: Authorizes employer tax credits conditioned on job creation. This is targeted economic-development policy rather than a general corporate-tax-rate position.

title: Pike Road, ad valorem tax, additional authorized for public schools, referendum
description: Pike Road, ad valorem tax, additional authorized for public schools, referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes an additional Pike Road property tax for public schools subject to referendum. It combines property-tax incidence, education investment, and voter approval.

title: Partnerships and limited liability companies, Subchapter K entities and Alabama S corporations, owners and resident beneficiaries of estates or trusts provided a proportionate tax credit for taxes paid to a foreign country, Secs. 40-18-14, 40-18-21 am'd. (2011-20801)
description: Partnerships and limited liability companies, Subchapter K entities and Alabama S corporations, owners and resident beneficiaries of estates or trusts provided a proportionate tax credit for taxes paid to a foreign country, Secs. 40-18-14, 40-18-21 am'd. (2011-20801)
frontier_rationale: Provides owners of pass-through entities and trust beneficiaries a proportional credit for taxes paid to foreign countries. This addresses double taxation of foreign income rather than reducing Alabama tax rates generally.

title: Economic development, tariff tax credits of capital investment costs for qualifying projects, job creation a qualifying factor, Tariff Credit Act
description: Economic development, tariff tax credits of capital investment costs for qualifying projects, job creation a qualifying factor, Tariff Credit Act
frontier_rationale: The Tariff Credit Act offsets tariff costs for qualifying capital projects tied to job creation. Support favors targeted industrial recruitment; opposition can reflect either fiscal restraint or free-market opposition to selective subsidies, so it is not a clean left-right tax vote.

title: Income tax, qualifying employers and qualifying employees authorized tax deductions for 100 percent of amounts paid for health insurance premiums, Sec. 40-18-15.3 am'd.
description: Income tax, qualifying employers and qualifying employees authorized tax deductions for 100 percent of amounts paid for health insurance premiums, Sec. 40-18-15.3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows qualifying employees and employers to deduct health-insurance premiums. Benefits flow to insured workers and sponsoring employers, so it should not be collapsed into either personal or corporate taxation alone.

title: Jefferson Co., county commission, limited authority to levy, assess, and collect additional sales and use tax, lease and rental tax, excise tax, alcoholic beverages tax, and privilege license tax, distrib., termination on November 5, 2014
description: Jefferson Co., county commission, limited authority to levy, assess, and collect additional sales and use tax, lease and rental tax, excise tax, alcoholic beverages tax, and privilege license tax, distrib., termination on November 5, 2014
frontier_rationale: Temporarily authorizes Jefferson County to levy several additional taxes and license charges. This expands local revenue authority across consumption, alcohol, rental, and business bases.

title: Small businesses, expansion or construction of new commercial property, noneducational ad valorem tax exemption authorized for certain time period, reappraisal
description: Small businesses, expansion or construction of new commercial property, noneducational ad valorem tax exemption authorized for certain time period, reappraisal
frontier_rationale: Authorizes temporary noneducation property-tax exemptions for small-business expansion or new commercial property. This is targeted business investment relief while preserving education millage.

title: Municipalities, neighborhood infrastructure authorities, establishment by homeowners and business owners authorized, to manage and coordinate financing for neighborhood projects, tax credits, Neighborhood Infrastructure Incentive Plan Act (2011-20524)
description: Municipalities, neighborhood infrastructure authorities, establishment by homeowners and business owners authorized, to manage and coordinate financing for neighborhood projects, tax credits, Neighborhood Infrastructure Incentive Plan Act (2011-20524)
frontier_rationale: Creates homeowner- and business-led neighborhood infrastructure authorities with coordinated financing and credits. It supports place-based reinvestment rather than general tax reduction.

title: Entertainment Industry Incentive Act of 2009, qualified production companies, tax rebates further provided for, tax exemptions limited to state portion of sales, use, and lodging tax, Secs. 41-7A-43, 41-7A-45 am'd.
description: Entertainment Industry Incentive Act of 2009, qualified production companies, tax rebates further provided for, tax exemptions limited to state portion of sales, use, and lodging tax, Secs. 41-7A-43, 41-7A-45 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises rebates and narrows exemptions for qualified entertainment productions to the state share of selected taxes. This is targeted film-industry subsidy design, not general sales-tax relief.

title: Property, income tax deduction the lesser of 50 percent of costs or $3,000 for retrofit improvements to homes to help withstand hurricane and windstorm damages, rate filings and related actuarial information for homeowners insurance coverage to be public information available on Internet (2011-21133)
description: Property, income tax deduction the lesser of 50 percent of costs or $3,000 for retrofit improvements to homes to help withstand hurricane and windstorm damages, rate filings and related actuarial information for homeowners insurance coverage to be public information available on Internet (2011-21133)
frontier_rationale: Creates a residential retrofit deduction and makes homeowners-insurance filings public. It combines targeted household resilience relief with insurance-market transparency rather than expressing a broad property-tax position.

title: Economic development, tariff tax credits of capital investment costs for qualifying projects, job creation a qualifying factor, Tariff Credit Act (2011-21034)
description: Economic development, tariff tax credits of capital investment costs for qualifying projects, job creation a qualifying factor, Tariff Credit Act (2011-21034)
frontier_rationale: The Tariff Credit Act offsets tariff costs for qualifying capital projects tied to job creation. Support favors targeted industrial recruitment; opposition can reflect either fiscal restraint or free-market opposition to selective subsidies, so it is not a clean left-right tax vote.

title: Taxation, one year income tax deduction for Medicaid providers authorized contingent upon rule change by Alabama Medicaid Agency
description: Taxation, one year income tax deduction for Medicaid providers authorized contingent upon rule change by Alabama Medicaid Agency
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a one-year income-tax deduction for Medicaid providers contingent on an agency rule change. It is targeted provider relief and may be tied to Medicaid financing mechanics; the synopsis is insufficient for a broader fiscal-ideology inference.

title: Income tax credit for qualifying projects or new or expanding businesses creating new jobs, tax credits claimed authorized to be carried over up to four tax years, Sec. 40-18-194 am'd.
description: Income tax credit for qualifying projects or new or expanding businesses creating new jobs, tax credits claimed authorized to be carried over up to four tax years, Sec. 40-18-194 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends carryforward treatment for tax credits awarded to qualifying job-creating projects. This expands targeted development subsidies rather than cutting the generally applicable business tax rate.

title: Taxation, tax exemption for Class 1-5 municipalities cultural districts
description: Taxation, tax exemption for Class 1-5 municipalities cultural districts
frontier_rationale: Creates an exemption associated with cultural districts in larger municipalities. This is targeted cultural-development policy; exact beneficiaries and eligible tax base require full-text confirmation.

title: Veterans, additional tax credits for previously unemployed veterans who became employed or began a business, "Heroes for Hire " Act
description: Veterans, additional tax credits for previously unemployed veterans who became employed or began a business, "Heroes for Hire " Act
frontier_rationale: Adds credits for previously unemployed veterans who obtain employment or start businesses. This is targeted veteran employment and entrepreneurship support.

title: Taxation, state income tax credit for investments, businesses in impoverished and low income communities.
description: Taxation, state income tax credit for investments, businesses in impoverished and low income communities.
frontier_rationale: Creates an investment credit for businesses in impoverished and low-income communities. The policy is geographically targeted community-development subsidy, not a generic business-tax reduction.

title: Partnerships and limited liability companies, Subchapter K entities and Alabama S corporations, owners and resident beneficiaries of estates or trusts provided a proportionate tax credit for taxes paid to a foreign country, Secs. 40-18-14, 40-18-21 am'd. (2011-20801)
description: Partnerships and limited liability companies, Subchapter K entities and Alabama S corporations, owners and resident beneficiaries of estates or trusts provided a proportionate tax credit for taxes paid to a foreign country, Secs. 40-18-14, 40-18-21 am'd. (2011-20801)
frontier_rationale: Provides owners of pass-through entities and trust beneficiaries a proportional credit for taxes paid to foreign countries. This addresses double taxation of foreign income rather than reducing rates generally.

title: Taxation, income tax credit for purchase and installation of irrigation systems, water wells and reservoirs by agricultural entities
description: Taxation, income tax credit for purchase and installation of irrigation systems, water wells and reservoirs by agricultural entities
frontier_rationale: Creates an agricultural income-tax credit for irrigation and water infrastructure. This is targeted rural and agricultural investment policy, not evidence about general income-tax levels.

title: Tax Credit, vehicles equipped with compressed natural gas (CNG)
description: Tax Credit, vehicles equipped with compressed natural gas (CNG)
frontier_rationale: Creates a credit for compressed-natural-gas vehicles. It is a targeted alternative-fuel transportation subsidy rather than general tax relief.

title: Pike Co., ad valorem tax, county commission authorized to levy additional outside corporate limits of Troy and Brundidge, distrib., referendum
description: Pike Co., ad valorem tax, county commission authorized to levy additional outside corporate limits of Troy and Brundidge, distrib., referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes an additional Pike County property tax outside specified municipalities subject to referendum. It expands local property taxation and voter-controlled fiscal authority.

title: Taxation, privilege, business tax, provider exemption to dormant entities, Sec. 40-14A-44 added
description: Taxation, privilege, business tax, provider exemption to dormant entities, Sec. 40-14A-44 added
frontier_rationale: Exempts dormant entities from a business privilege tax obligation. This is narrowly targeted business-entity relief rather than a general business-tax-rate reduction.

title: Taxation, income tax credit for purchase and installation of irrigation systems, water wells and reservoirs by agricultural entities
description: Taxation, income tax credit for purchase and installation of irrigation systems, water wells and reservoirs by agricultural entities
frontier_rationale: Creates an agricultural income-tax credit for irrigation and water infrastructure. This is targeted rural and agricultural investment policy, not evidence about general income-tax levels.

title: Catastrophe savings account, established, to cover insurance deductibles and other uninsured portions of risks of loss to owners of residential property owners from windstorm events, income tax deduction for deposits made to account
description: Catastrophe savings account, established, to cover insurance deductibles and other uninsured portions of risks of loss to owners of residential property owners from windstorm events, income tax deduction for deposits made to account
frontier_rationale: Allows deductions for deposits into household catastrophe-savings accounts. This is targeted residential disaster-risk relief and favors tax-advantaged private saving, not a general income-tax cut.

title: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
description: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Changes the liability threshold governing estimated sales-tax payments. The synopsis does not establish a rate or final-liability increase; coding it as a tax increase mistakes payment administration for tax incidence.

title: Economic Development, tax increment district, Major 21st Century Manufacturing Zone authorized in Class 3 municipalities, development of distressed areas, tax credit required, Secs. 11-99-1, 11-99-2, 11-99-4, 11-99-5, 11-99-6, 11-99-8, 11-99-10 am'd
description: Economic Development, tax increment district, Major 21st Century Manufacturing Zone authorized in Class 3 municipalities, development of distressed areas, tax credit required, Secs. 11-99-1, 11-99-2, 11-99-4, 11-99-5, 11-99-6, 11-99-8, 11-99-10 am'd
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a manufacturing-zone tax-increment district and required credits for distressed-area development. It is targeted industrial policy and development finance, not broad tax relief.

title: Barbour Co., sales and use tax, county commission authorized to levy additional, 1/2 cent sales tax with distribution to county general fund, penalties
description: Barbour Co., sales and use tax, county commission authorized to levy additional, 1/2 cent sales tax with distribution to county general fund, penalties
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Barbour County to levy an additional half-cent sales tax for its general fund. It directly permits a regressive consumption-tax increase while expanding county fiscal authority.

title: Income tax credit for qualifying projects or new or expanding businesses creating new jobs, tax credits claimed authorized to be carried over up to four tax years, Sec. 40-18-194 am'd.
description: Income tax credit for qualifying projects or new or expanding businesses creating new jobs, tax credits claimed authorized to be carried over up to four tax years, Sec. 40-18-194 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends carryforward treatment for tax credits awarded to qualifying job-creating projects. This expands targeted development subsidies rather than cutting the generally applicable business tax rate.

title: Madison, ad valorem tax, increased, use for education purposes, referendum
description: Madison, ad valorem tax, increased, use for education purposes, referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Madison property-tax increase for education subject to referendum. It combines property-tax incidence, school funding, and local voter approval.

title: Taxation, one year income tax deduction for Medicaid providers authorized contingent upon rule change by Alabama Medicaid Agency
description: Taxation, one year income tax deduction for Medicaid providers authorized contingent upon rule change by Alabama Medicaid Agency
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a one-year income-tax deduction for Medicaid providers contingent on an agency rule change. It is targeted provider relief and may be tied to Medicaid financing mechanics; the synopsis is insufficient for a broader fiscal-ideology inference.

title: Income tax, tax credit for rehabilitation, preservation, and development of certain historic structures
description: Income tax, tax credit for rehabilitation, preservation, and development of certain historic structures
frontier_rationale: Creates a credit for rehabilitation and preservation of historic structures. This is a targeted preservation and development subsidy, not a general income-tax reduction.

title: Ad valorem tax, homestead exemption from local taxes, disabled and person over 65, exemption restored for disabled without regard to income, exemption for persons 65 and over further provided for based on state taxable income, effect to substantially repeal Act 2012-313, 2012 Reg. Sess., retroactive, Sec. 40-9-21.2 added, Secs. 40-9-19, 40-9-21, 40-9-21.1am'd.
description: Ad valorem tax, homestead exemption from local taxes, disabled and person over 65, exemption restored for disabled without regard to income, exemption for persons 65 and over further provided for based on state taxable income, effect to substantially repeal Act 2012-313, 2012 Reg. Sess., retroactive, Sec. 40-9-21.2 added, Secs. 40-9-19, 40-9-21, 40-9-21.1am'd.
frontier_rationale: Restores and revises homestead exemptions for disabled and older residents, including removing an income condition for disabled claimants. This is targeted property-tax relief for protected household groups.

title: Sales and use tax, aircraft parts used to refurbish cargo aircraft, use tax exemption further provided for, local government approval of local taxes, Sec. 40-23-62 am'd
description: Sales and use tax, aircraft parts used to refurbish cargo aircraft, use tax exemption further provided for, local government approval of local taxes, Sec. 40-23-62 am'd
frontier_rationale: Broadens an aircraft-parts exemption for cargo-aircraft refurbishment while requiring local approval for local-tax effects. It is an aviation-industry incentive with a local fiscal safeguard.

title: Auburn, ad valorem tax for educational use, authorized increase, referendum
description: Auburn, ad valorem tax for educational use, authorized increase, referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Auburn to increase property taxes for education subject to referendum. It combines property-tax incidence, school investment, and voter approval.

title: Taxation, aviation jet fuel purchased by international cargo air carriers, refund for excise tax paid on purchases of aviation jet fuel by exemption from sales and use tax, Secs. 40-17-329, 40-23-4, 40-23-62 am'd.
description: Taxation, aviation jet fuel purchased by international cargo air carriers, refund for excise tax paid on purchases of aviation jet fuel by exemption from sales and use tax, Secs. 40-17-329, 40-23-4, 40-23-62 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Refunds or exempts aviation-fuel taxes for international cargo carriers. This is a targeted logistics and air-cargo subsidy rather than general fuel-tax relief.

title: Supernumerary ad valorem tax officials, cap on compensation increased, Sec. 40-6-3 am'd.
description: Supernumerary ad valorem tax officials, cap on compensation increased, Sec. 40-6-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises the compensation cap for supernumerary property-tax officials. This concerns public-official compensation, not the amount or incidence of ad valorem taxation.

title: Midfield, additional ad valorem tax, authorized, referendum
description: Midfield, additional ad valorem tax, authorized, referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes an additional Midfield property tax subject to referendum. It combines local property-tax incidence with voter-controlled fiscal authority.

title: Agriculture, irrigation equipment, income tax credit for installation of, qualified reservoir defined, carry forward and pass through of tax credits, further provided for, shareholders authorized to claim pro rata share of tax credit, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
description: Agriculture, irrigation equipment, income tax credit for installation of, qualified reservoir defined, carry forward and pass through of tax credits, further provided for, shareholders authorized to claim pro rata share of tax credit, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broadens administration and pass-through availability of the irrigation-equipment credit. It expands a targeted agricultural investment subsidy rather than changing general income-tax burdens.

title: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
description: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Changes the monthly-liability threshold for estimated sales-tax payments. Without a change to final liability or the tax rate, this is tax administration rather than an ideological tax increase.

title: Income tax, married taxpayers, optional standard deduction authorized when filing separate tax returns, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
description: Income tax, married taxpayers, optional standard deduction authorized when filing separate tax returns, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows married taxpayers filing separately to take an optional standard deduction. This is targeted personal-income-tax relief addressing filing status, not a general rate reduction.

title: Supernumerary ad valorem tax officials, cap on compensation increased, Sec. 40-6-3 am'd.
description: Supernumerary ad valorem tax officials, cap on compensation increased, Sec. 40-6-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises the compensation cap for supernumerary property-tax officials. This is public-official compensation rather than a tax-incidence measure.

title: Income tax, tax credit for contributions to Postsecondary Education Department for high school students enrolled in Career-Technical Dual Enrollment Program, commencing in 2015
description: Income tax, tax credit for contributions to Postsecondary Education Department for high school students enrolled in Career-Technical Dual Enrollment Program, commencing in 2015
frontier_rationale: Credits contributions financing high-school career and technical dual enrollment. It is a tax expenditure supporting workforce education, with both donor-tax and education-program effects.

title: Sales tax exemption under certain conditions, effective date modified, Act 2013-443, 2013 Reg. Sess., am'd.; Sec. 40-9-39.1 am'd.
description: Sales tax exemption under certain conditions, effective date modified, Act 2013-443, 2013 Reg. Sess., am'd.; Sec. 40-9-39.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: The enrolled text advances Act 2013-443's exemption from October 1 to August 1, 2014. The incorporated section concerns durable medical equipment, prosthetics, orthotics, and covered medical supplies, so the bill accelerates targeted healthcare sales-tax relief by two months.

title: Adoptions, income tax credit authorized for private intrastate adoption or adoption of qualified foster child
description: Adoptions, income tax credit authorized for private intrastate adoption or adoption of qualified foster child
frontier_rationale: Creates an income-tax credit for private intrastate and qualifying foster-child adoptions. This is family-policy assistance delivered through a targeted tax expenditure, not broad income-tax relief.

title: Historic structures, Historical Commission, approval of tax credits for restoration further provided for, transfer of credits, amount of total credits, Act 2013-241, 2013 Reg. Sess, am'd.; Secs. 40-9F-3, 40-9F-4, 40-9F-5 am'd.
description: Historic structures, Historical Commission, approval of tax credits for restoration further provided for, transfer of credits, amount of total credits, Act 2013-241, 2013 Reg. Sess, am'd.; Secs. 40-9F-3, 40-9F-4, 40-9F-5 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises approval, transferability, and aggregate limits for historic-restoration credits. This is targeted preservation subsidy design rather than general tax relief.

title: Taxation, tax exemption for Class 1-5 municipalities cultural districts
description: Taxation, tax exemption for Class 1-5 municipalities cultural districts
frontier_rationale: Creates an exemption associated with cultural districts in larger municipalities. It is targeted cultural-development policy; exact tax base and beneficiaries require full-text confirmation.

title: Taxation, limited state income tax credit for qualified research expenses under certain conditions
description: Taxation, limited state income tax credit for qualified research expenses under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Creates a limited credit for qualified research expenses. This is a targeted business research subsidy rather than a generally applicable corporate-tax reduction.

title: Income tax, married taxpayers, optional standard deduction authorized when filing separate tax returns, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
description: Income tax, married taxpayers, optional standard deduction authorized when filing separate tax returns, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows married taxpayers filing separately to take an optional standard deduction. This is targeted personal-income-tax relief addressing filing status, not a general rate reduction.

title: Taxation, tax deduction for taxpayers who made contributions to a catastrophe savings account, increase in state tax deduction, technical corrections to remove ambiguities, Homeowner's Insurance Catastrophic Event Planning Act, Secs. 40-18-311, 40-18-312 am'd.
description: Taxation, tax deduction for taxpayers who made contributions to a catastrophe savings account, increase in state tax deduction, technical corrections to remove ambiguities, Homeowner's Insurance Catastrophic Event Planning Act, Secs. 40-18-311, 40-18-312 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases deductions for catastrophe-savings contributions and makes technical corrections. This is targeted residential disaster-risk relief rather than broad income-tax reduction.

title: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
description: Sales tax, estimated payments, average monthly tax liability threshold increased, Sec. 40-23-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Changes the monthly-liability threshold for estimated sales-tax payments. Without a change to final liability or the tax rate, this is tax administration rather than an ideological tax increase.

title: Taxation, income tax, tax credit for hiring certain persons under age 19 during school breaks, after school, or on weekends
description: Taxation, income tax, tax credit for hiring certain persons under age 19 during school breaks, after school, or on weekends
frontier_rationale: Creates an income-tax credit for hiring minors during non-school hours. This is a targeted youth-employment subsidy to employers rather than broad income-tax relief.

title: Sales tax, exemption for certain motor vehicles, motorcycles, trucks, and semi-trailers exported or removed from this state, eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
description: Sales tax, exemption for certain motor vehicles, motorcycles, trucks, and semi-trailers exported or removed from this state, eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates a sales-tax exemption for certain vehicles exported or removed from Alabama. The inherited decrease label reverses the fiscal direction: eliminating an exemption expands taxable liability under the stated conditions.

title: Taxation, tax credits for rehabilitation of qualified structures, credits extended until 2022, Secs.40-9F-4, 40-9F-7 am'd.
description: Taxation, tax credits for rehabilitation of qualified structures, credits extended until 2022, Secs.40-9F-4, 40-9F-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends rehabilitation credits for qualified structures through 2022. This continues a targeted preservation and development subsidy.

title: Sales tax, motor vehicles, exemption when exported or removed from this state eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
description: Sales tax, motor vehicles, exemption when exported or removed from this state eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates a sales-tax exemption for motor vehicles exported or removed from Alabama. The inherited decrease label reverses the fiscal direction because repeal of an exemption expands taxable liability.

title: Athens, ad valorem tax, additional levied
description: Athens, ad valorem tax, additional levied
frontier_rationale: Levies an additional Athens property tax. The synopsis identifies a direct local ad valorem increase, though it does not state the spending purpose.

title: Alabama Renewal Act, certain tax credits for the state's port facilities and other tax credits, authorized, Secs. 40-18-400 to 40-18-403, inclusive, 40-18-410 to 40-18-415, inclusive, added
description: Alabama Renewal Act, certain tax credits for the state's port facilities and other tax credits, authorized, Secs. 40-18-400 to 40-18-403, inclusive, 40-18-410 to 40-18-415, inclusive, added
frontier_rationale: Authorizes port and other economic-development credits under the Alabama Renewal Act. This is targeted industrial policy rather than broad tax relief.

title: Income tax withholding exemption repealed, Revenue Dept. to provide forms on-line, Taxpayer Fraud Prevention Act, Sec. 40-18-73 am'd.
description: Income tax withholding exemption repealed, Revenue Dept. to provide forms on-line, Taxpayer Fraud Prevention Act, Sec. 40-18-73 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Repeals a withholding exemption and changes Revenue Department forms as part of fraud prevention. The synopsis establishes collection and withholding treatment but not necessarily a change in final income-tax liability, so it should not be scored as tax relief.

title: Madison Co., levy an add'l sales tax, referendum
description: Madison Co., levy an add'l sales tax, referendum
frontier_rationale: Allows an additional Madison County sales tax subject to referendum. It authorizes a consumption-tax increase while reserving final approval to local voters.

title: Barbour Co., levy two mil ad valorem tax, distrib., election
description: Barbour Co., levy two mil ad valorem tax, distrib., election
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a two-mill Barbour County property tax with an election. It combines local property-tax incidence, earmarked distribution, and voter approval.

title: Taxation, tax credit, employer provided a tax credit for employing an apprentice, definitions, Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act
description: Taxation, tax credit, employer provided a tax credit for employing an apprentice, definitions, Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act
frontier_rationale: Creates an employer credit for apprentices. This is targeted workforce-training subsidy policy rather than a general employer-tax cut.

description: Taxation, tax deduction for taxpayers who made contributions to a catastrophe savings account, increase in state tax deduction, technical corrections to remove ambiguities, Homeowner's Insurance Catastrophic Event Planning Act, Secs. 40-18-311, 40-18-312 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases deductions for catastrophe-savings contributions and makes technical corrections. This is targeted residential disaster-risk relief.

title: Legislative Fiscal Office, tax exemptions, annual report to Legislature of "tax expenditures" from exemptions
description: Legislative Fiscal Office, tax exemptions, annual report to Legislature of "tax expenditures" from exemptions
frontier_rationale: Requires an annual legislative report identifying revenue foregone through tax expenditures. This increases fiscal transparency and does not itself decrease taxes.

title: Energy efficiency projects, financing by local governments authorized, non ad valorem tax assessments, liens, bonds authorized, Property Insurance and Energy Reduction Act of Alabama
description: Energy efficiency projects, financing by local governments authorized, non ad valorem tax assessments, liens, bonds authorized, Property Insurance and Energy Reduction Act of Alabama
frontier_rationale: Authorizes local PACE-style financing through non-ad-valorem assessments, liens, and bonds. It expands energy-efficiency finance and local assessment authority rather than cutting taxes.

title: Wallace-Folsom College Savings Investment Plan, named changed to Wallace-Folsom Savings Investment Plan, provide the Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) program, definitions relating to ABLE, provide tax exemptions, appropriations for development of ABLE program, Secs. 16-33C-1, 16-33C-2, 16-33C-2.1, 16-33C-3, 16-33C-4, 16-33C-5, 16-33C-10, 16-33C-11, 16-33C-12, 40-18-19 am'd.
description: Wallace-Folsom College Savings Investment Plan, named changed to Wallace-Folsom Savings Investment Plan, provide the Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) program, definitions relating to ABLE, provide tax exemptions, appropriations for development of ABLE program, Secs. 16-33C-1, 16-33C-2, 16-33C-2.1, 16-33C-3, 16-33C-4, 16-33C-5, 16-33C-10, 16-33C-11, 16-33C-12, 40-18-19 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Establishes Alabama's ABLE savings program with tax exemptions and development appropriations. It combines disability savings support, targeted tax relief, and public program funding.

title: Heroes for Hire Tax Credit Act of 2012, renamed, Veterans Employment Act, Secs. 40-18-320, 40-18-321, 40-18-322 am'd.
description: Heroes for Hire Tax Credit Act of 2012, renamed, Veterans Employment Act, Secs. 40-18-320, 40-18-321, 40-18-322 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Renames and amends the Heroes for Hire credit program as the Veterans Employment Act. The synopsis does not establish a net expansion or contraction, so it supports program orientation but not tax direction.

title: Barbour Co., levy two mil ad valorem tax, distrib., election
description: Barbour Co., levy two mil ad valorem tax, distrib., election
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a two-mill Barbour County property tax with an election. It combines local property-tax incidence and voter-controlled fiscal authority.

title: Sales tax, exemption for certain motor vehicles exported or removed from this state, eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
description: Sales tax, exemption for certain motor vehicles exported or removed from this state, eliminated under certain conditions, Sec. 40-23-2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates a sales-tax exemption for certain vehicles exported or removed from Alabama. The inherited decrease label reverses the fiscal direction because repeal of an exemption expands taxable liability.

title: Accountability Act of 2013, revised to clarify intent of educational choice, define academic year, define family, further provide for tax credits, limits amount of administrative and operating expenses paid from revenue, annual reporting to Department of Revenue, Secs. 16-6D-4, 16-6D-9 am'd.
description: Accountability Act of 2013, revised to clarify intent of educational choice, define academic year, define family, further provide for tax credits, limits amount of administrative and operating expenses paid from revenue, annual reporting to Department of Revenue, Secs. 16-6D-4, 16-6D-9 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises Accountability Act tax credits and definitions while limiting administrative expenses and adding reporting. It advances tax-supported educational choice with added accountability provisions, not generic tax relief.

title: Athens, ad valorem tax, additional levied
description: Athens, ad valorem tax, additional levied
frontier_rationale: Levies an additional Athens property tax. This is a direct local ad valorem increase, although the synopsis does not identify its spending purpose.

title: Health Savings Accounts, income tax deduction auth. for contributions to, Sec. 40-18-15.6 added.
description: Health Savings Accounts, income tax deduction auth. for contributions to, Sec. 40-18-15.6 added.
frontier_rationale: Allows deductions for Health Savings Account contributions. This is targeted tax support for individually controlled health savings rather than a broad income-tax reduction.

title: Taxation, tax credits for certain capital contributions to small businesses in Alabama, established, Dept. of Commerce to administer, Alabama Small Business Investment Company Act
description: Taxation, tax credits for certain capital contributions to small businesses in Alabama, established, Dept. of Commerce to administer, Alabama Small Business Investment Company Act
frontier_rationale: Creates credits for capital contributions to Alabama small businesses. This is targeted investment subsidy policy rather than a general tax cut.

title: Medicaid, prescription drugs, supplemental tax of 15 cents per prescription by Act 2015-537, refunds as tax credit against original prescription drug taxes due, commencing October 1, 2016, Act 2015-537, 2015 Second Sp. Sess., repealed
description: Medicaid, prescription drugs, supplemental tax of 15 cents per prescription by Act 2015-537, refunds as tax credit against original prescription drug taxes due, commencing October 1, 2016, Act 2015-537, 2015 Second Sp. Sess., repealed
frontier_rationale: Repeals a supplemental per-prescription tax and converts related amounts into credits against the original provider tax. This restructures Medicaid financing and reduces the supplemental provider burden, not household prescription taxes.

title: Alabama Renewal Act, certain tax credits for the state's port facilities and other tax credits, authorized, Secs. 40-18-400 to 40-18-403, inclusive, 40-18-410 to 40-18-416, inclusive, added
description: Alabama Renewal Act, certain tax credits for the state's port facilities and other tax credits, authorized, Secs. 40-18-400 to 40-18-403, inclusive, 40-18-410 to 40-18-416, inclusive, added
frontier_rationale: Authorizes port and other development credits under the Alabama Renewal Act. This is targeted industrial policy rather than broad tax relief.

title: Small Business Act, tax credits for small business employers authorized under certain conditions, Sec. 40-18-321 am'd.
description: Small Business Act, tax credits for small business employers authorized under certain conditions, Sec. 40-18-321 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Authorizes conditional credits for small-business employers. This is targeted employment subsidy policy rather than a general business-tax reduction.

title: Financial institution excise tax, tax credits, use only to offset state portion of tax and not county or municipal tax
description: Financial institution excise tax, tax credits, use only to offset state portion of tax and not county or municipal tax
frontier_rationale: Limits financial-institution credits to the state portion of the excise tax and prevents offsets against county or municipal revenue. This constrains a credit while protecting local tax collections.

title: Sumter Co., taxation, additional ad valorem tax providing for a referendum
description: Sumter Co., taxation, additional ad valorem tax providing for a referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes an additional Sumter County property tax subject to referendum. It combines local property-tax incidence and voter approval.

title: Randolph Co., sales tax, co. commission authorized to levy additional tax, distrib. for jail construction, referendum
description: Randolph Co., sales tax, co. commission authorized to levy additional tax, distrib. for jail construction, referendum
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Randolph County sales-tax increase for jail construction subject to referendum. It combines regressive local taxation, public-safety capital spending, and voter approval.

title: Chambers Co., county authorized to levy additional sales tax in areas of county outside of municipal corporate limits, general sales and use, motor vehicles, and farm equipment sales and use tax, distribution of tax proceeds
description: Chambers Co., county authorized to levy additional sales tax in areas of county outside of municipal corporate limits, general sales and use, motor vehicles, and farm equipment sales and use tax, distribution of tax proceeds
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Chambers County to levy additional sales and use taxes outside municipalities, including vehicle and farm-equipment taxes. This expands local taxing authority and taxable consumption.

title: Marion Co., provide for an additional 3 mill property tax for fire protection, const. amend.
description: Marion Co., provide for an additional 3 mill property tax for fire protection, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Proposes an additional Marion County property tax dedicated to fire protection through a constitutional amendment. It combines property-tax incidence, emergency-service funding, and voter ratification.

title: Taxation, tax credits for rehabilitation of qualified structures, credits extended until 2022, Secs.40-9F-4, 40-9F-7 am'd.
description: Taxation, tax credits for rehabilitation of qualified structures, credits extended until 2022, Secs.40-9F-4, 40-9F-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends rehabilitation credits for qualified structures through 2022. This continues a targeted preservation and development subsidy.

title: Physician's Assistants Service Program, created, administered by the Board of Medical Scholarship Awards, funding of program, tax credits for participation
description: Physician's Assistants Service Program, created, administered by the Board of Medical Scholarship Awards, funding of program, tax credits for participation
frontier_rationale: Creates a physician-assistant service program with participation credits and public administration. This is targeted health-workforce and training support.

title: Broadband telecommunication network facilities, tax credit for percentage of investment, Sec. 40-18-371.1 added; Sec. 40-18-370 am'd.
description: Broadband telecommunication network facilities, tax credit for percentage of investment, Sec. 40-18-371.1 added; Sec. 40-18-370 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates a credit based on investment in broadband facilities. This is targeted communications-infrastructure subsidy policy.

description: Heroes for Hire Tax Credit Act of 2012, renamed, Veterans Employment Act, Secs. 40-18-320, 40-18-321, 40-18-322 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Renames and amends the Heroes for Hire credit program as the Veterans Employment Act. The synopsis does not establish net expansion or contraction, so it supports program orientation but not tax direction.

description: Income tax credits, increase for rural physicians and dentists, Secs. 40-18-130 to 40-18-132, inclusive, am'd.

description: Taxation, tax credit for employers employing apprentices, Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act
frontier_rationale: Creates an employer credit for apprentices. This is targeted workforce-training subsidy policy rather than broad employer-tax relief.

description: United Way and united appeal funds, tax exemption from all taxes, certain existing funds deemed included, Tax Exemption Reform Act of 2017, Sec. 40-9-12 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends broad tax exemption treatment to qualifying United Way and united-appeal funds. This is targeted charitable-sector tax relief.

title: Water districts, tax exemption further provided for, Sec. 11-89-16 am'd.
description: Water districts, tax exemption further provided for, Sec. 11-89-16 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises tax exemptions for water districts. It concerns public-utility entity treatment, but the synopsis does not establish whether the exemption expands or narrows.

title: Taxation, financial institutions excise tax, formula for apportioning income from business activity inside and outside state, loans and credit cards receivables included as property in this state, Sec. 40-16-4 am'd.
description: Taxation, financial institutions excise tax, formula for apportioning income from business activity inside and outside state, loans and credit cards receivables included as property in this state, Sec. 40-16-4 am'd.
frontier_rationale: The enrolled text requires loans and credit-card receivables to count as Alabama property when Revenue uses a property factor, sourced consistently with Alabama interest receipts. It broadens the in-state property measure for multistate financial institutions and can increase Alabama's apportioned excise-tax base, subject to each institution's portfolio.

title: Historic buildings, income tax credit authorized for rehabilitation of qualified structures, standards by Historical Commission, rules, approval by Historic Tax Credit Evaluating Committee estab., limitations, expiration
description: Historic buildings, income tax credit authorized for rehabilitation of qualified structures, standards by Historical Commission, rules, approval by Historic Tax Credit Evaluating Committee estab., limitations, expiration
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a regulated and capped historic-rehabilitation credit. This is targeted preservation and development spending through the tax code.

description: Income tax, optional increased standard deduction for qualifying taxpayers, established, Sec. 40-18-15.7 added
frontier_rationale: Creates an increased standard deduction for qualifying individual taxpayers. This is personal-income-tax relief whose distribution depends on the qualification thresholds, not a corporate-tax measure.

description: Income tax, irrigation project tax credit, add'l credit authorized with cap, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Adds a capped irrigation-project credit. This expands a targeted agricultural investment subsidy rather than lowering general income-tax rates.

description: Income tax credits, increase for rural physicians and dentists, Secs. 40-18-130 to 40-18-132, inclusive, am'd.

description: Income tax credits, increase for rural physicians and dentists, Secs. 40-18-130 to 40-18-132, inclusive, am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases credits for rural physicians and dentists. This is a geographically targeted healthcare-workforce subsidy, not broad income-tax relief.

description: Neighborhood Infrastructure Authorities, municipalities, assessments for neighborhood infrastructure revitalization projects, income tax credits, expiration date deleted, Secs. 11-71-11, 11-71-12 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends credits and assessment authority for neighborhood infrastructure revitalization. It subsidizes place-based reinvestment and local infrastructure finance rather than reducing general tax burdens.

title: Alabama Renewal Act, new qualified broadband telecommunication network facilities, provided for, nonrefundable, transferable income tax credit, provided for, certain exemptions provided for, certain earned, unused credits, authorized to be carried forward, process for claiming and transferring credit and exemptions provided for, act repealed following close of certain fiscal year, Sec. 40-18-415.1 added; Sec. 40-18-416 am'd.
description: Alabama Renewal Act, new qualified broadband telecommunication network facilities, provided for, nonrefundable, transferable income tax credit, provided for, certain exemptions provided for, certain earned, unused credits, authorized to be carried forward, process for claiming and transferring credit and exemptions provided for, act repealed following close of certain fiscal year, Sec. 40-18-415.1 added; Sec. 40-18-416 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates transferable credits and exemptions for qualified broadband facilities. This is targeted industrial and infrastructure subsidy policy, not a general tax-rate reduction.

title: Irrigation projects, income tax credit, add'l credit authorized with cap, expiration, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
description: Irrigation projects, income tax credit, add'l credit authorized with cap, expiration, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Adds a capped irrigation-project credit and expiration. This expands a targeted agricultural investment subsidy rather than lowering general income-tax rates.

title: Taxation, certain public water, sewer, gas electric, and fire protection authorities, boards, and systems eligible as government entities for state and local sales and use tax exemptions, Sec. 40-9-14.1 am'd.
description: Taxation, certain public water, sewer, gas electric, and fire protection authorities, boards, and systems eligible as government entities for state and local sales and use tax exemptions, Sec. 40-9-14.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Makes specified public utility and fire-protection entities eligible for governmental sales-tax exemptions. This is targeted relief supporting public or quasi-public service provision.

title: Veterans, unemployed, tax credit created for hiring of, regardless of whether veteran was recently deployed, Sec. 40-18-320.1 added; Secs. 40-18-320, 40-18-321, 40-18-322, 40-18-324 am'd.
description: Veterans, unemployed, tax credit created for hiring of, regardless of whether veteran was recently deployed, Sec. 40-18-320.1 added; Secs. 40-18-320, 40-18-321, 40-18-322, 40-18-324 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broadens the unemployed-veteran hiring credit beyond recently deployed veterans. This is targeted veteran employment support rather than general employer-tax relief.

title: Individual income tax, providing for the deduction of prenatal medical expenses, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
description: Individual income tax, providing for the deduction of prenatal medical expenses, Sec. 40-18-15 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows a deduction for prenatal medical expenses. It provides targeted household tax relief and supports prenatal/family policy; the synopsis does not establish abortion restrictions and should not be coded as such.

title: Baldwin Co., gasoline and motor fuel, excise tax, add'l, county commission authorized to levy, Sec. 45-2-244.044 am'd.
description: Baldwin Co., gasoline and motor fuel, excise tax, add'l, county commission authorized to levy, Sec. 45-2-244.044 am'd.

title: Taxation, $5,000 income tax credit given to certain rural certified registered nurse practitioners
description: Taxation, $5,000 income tax credit given to certain rural certified registered nurse practitioners

title: Tax Exemption Reform Act, united appeal fund entities and supported charities, grace period to obtain or renew certificate of exemption from Dept. of Revenue provided through Sept. 30, 2018, Sec. 40-9-12.1added

title: Sales and use taxes, exemption for sale of fruit and agricultural products further provided for, all sales tax exemptions incorporated in use tax, Secs. 40-23-4, 40-23-62 am'd.
description: Sales and use taxes, exemption for sale of fruit and agricultural products further provided for, all sales tax exemptions incorporated in use tax, Secs. 40-23-4, 40-23-62 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broadens or clarifies sales and use-tax exemptions for fruit and agricultural products. The incidence favors agricultural sellers and purchasers, but exact coverage should be confirmed from the enacted text.

title: Home buyers, first-time, savings accounts authorized to save funds for a down payment and closing costs, income tax deduction for contributions
description: Home buyers, first-time, savings accounts authorized to save funds for a down payment and closing costs, income tax deduction for contributions
frontier_rationale: Creates tax-advantaged savings accounts for first-home down payments and closing costs. This is targeted homeownership assistance, not a general income-tax cut.

title: Irrigation equip. or reservoirs for agriculture purposes, income tax credit, eligibility for credit, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
description: Irrigation equip. or reservoirs for agriculture purposes, income tax credit, eligibility for credit, Sec. 40-18-342 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Changes eligibility for agricultural irrigation credits. This is targeted farm-investment subsidy policy rather than a general income-tax position.

title: Muscle Shoals, ad valorem tax, city council authorized to increase
description: Muscle Shoals, ad valorem tax, city council authorized to increase
frontier_rationale: Authorizes the Muscle Shoals city council to increase property taxes. This is a direct local ad valorem increase, although the synopsis does not state its use.

title: Income tax, filing requirement threshold to be sum of standard deduction and personal exemptions, Sec. 40-18-27 am'd.
description: Income tax, filing requirement threshold to be sum of standard deduction and personal exemptions, Sec. 40-18-27 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises the filing threshold to the combined standard deduction and personal exemptions. This primarily relieves filing obligations for people with little or no taxable income rather than changing rates broadly.

title: Income tax credit only offset tax liability derived from non-Alabama sources, Sec. 40-18-21 am'd.
description: Income tax credit only offset tax liability derived from non-Alabama sources, Sec. 40-18-21 am'd.
frontier_rationale: The text caps a resident's other-state tax credit at the share of Alabama liability attributable to taxed out-of-state income, preventing excess credit from offsetting Alabama-source liability and potentially increasing tax for multistate earners. It expressly protects timely 2013–2017 refund claims from the new limitation.

title: Taxation, income tax credit, against tax liability for the rehabilitation, preservation, or development of structures near certain higher education institutions, Historic University Neighborhood Rehabilitation Act
