description: Small Business Relief and Revitalization Act of 2022, cancellation of indebtedness income exempt from income tax, financial institution excise tax and corporate income tax due date extension, certain business tangible personal property ad valorem tax exemption, deposit of certified funds with Revenue in lieu of one-time surety bond for licensure, average monthly sales tax liability for estimated payments increased, Secs. 40-16-3.1, 40-18-39.1 added; Secs. 40-9-1, 40-23-6, 40-23-6.1, 40-23-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Exempts forgiven debt and some small-business tangible property, extends corporate filing deadlines, and relaxes sales-tax payment and licensing security procedures. It is a multi-component small-business relief package, not one generic income-tax decrease.

title: Income tax, optional standard deduction amount and adjusted gross income range allowable for maximum optional standard deduction and dependent exemption, increased, Secs. 40-18-15, 40-18-19 am'd.
description: Income tax, optional standard deduction amount and adjusted gross income range allowable for maximum optional standard deduction and dependent exemption, increased, Secs. 40-18-15, 40-18-19 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases the optional standard deduction, its full-benefit income range, and the dependent exemption. This is household personal-income-tax relief rather than business-tax policy.

title: Agriculture authorities, estab. by counties, power to sell property, contracts for sewer service, sales and use tax exemption, further provided for, Secs. 11-20-73, 11-20-80, 11-20-81 am'd.
description: Agriculture authorities, estab. by counties, power to sell property, contracts for sewer service, sales and use tax exemption, further provided for, Secs. 11-20-73, 11-20-80, 11-20-81 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands county agricultural-authority powers and revises their sales and use-tax treatment. It is agricultural development governance; exact exemption direction requires the amended text.

title: Relating to individual income taxes; to amend Section 40-18-5, Code of Alabama 1975, to phase-in a reduction in the top tax rate from five percent to four and ninety-five hundredths percent.
description: Relating to individual income taxes; to amend Section 40-18-5, Code of Alabama 1975, to phase-in a reduction in the top tax rate from five percent to four and ninety-five hundredths percent.
frontier_rationale: Phases the top individual income-tax rate from 5.00 to 4.95 percent. Unlike targeted credits, this is a direct reduction in the generally applicable top personal rate, although the magnitude is small.

title: Relating to sales and use tax; to add a new Section 40-23-4.5, Code of Alabama 1975, to exclude products under Chapter 2A of Title 20 from the producer value added sales and use tax exemption.
description: Relating to sales and use tax; to add a new Section 40-23-4.5, Code of Alabama 1975, to exclude products under Chapter 2A of Title 20 from the producer value added sales and use tax exemption.
frontier_rationale: Excludes products governed by Alabama's medical-cannabis chapter from a producer value-added sales-tax exemption. The inherited tax-decrease label is reversed: this narrows an exemption and expands taxable liability for medical-cannabis products.

title: Relating to state income tax; to establish the Preceptor Tax Incentive Program to provide income tax credit incentives for certain medical students who train in rural and underserved counties in the state.
description: Relating to state income tax; to establish the Preceptor Tax Incentive Program to provide income tax credit incentives for certain medical students who train in rural and underserved counties in the state.
frontier_rationale: Creates credits for medical preceptors training students in rural and underserved counties. This is targeted health-workforce and training policy, not broad income-tax relief.

title: Relating to tax exemptions, to amend Section 40-9-12, Code of Alabama 1975, to change the name of the National Foundation to reflect its current name, the March of Dimes Inc.
description: Relating to tax exemptions, to amend Section 40-9-12, Code of Alabama 1975, to change the name of the National Foundation to reflect its current name, the March of Dimes Inc.
frontier_rationale: Updates the statutory name of the March of Dimes within an existing exemption. It does not create or expand the exemption and provides no ideological tax signal.

title: Relating to income taxes; to provide a one-time refundable income tax credit to qualified taxpayers to partially offset the amount of sales taxes paid on groceries throughout the tax year; to create the Refundable Tax Credit Fund in the State Treasury; to provide that refundable credits would not be taxable for Alabama income tax purposes; and to provide an effective date.
description: Relating to income taxes; to provide a one-time refundable income tax credit to qualified taxpayers to partially offset the amount of sales taxes paid on groceries throughout the tax year; to create the Refundable Tax Credit Fund in the State Treasury; to provide that refundable credits would not be taxable for Alabama income tax purposes; and to provide an effective date.
frontier_rationale: Creates a refundable household credit to offset grocery sales taxes. Because refundability reaches taxpayers with low liability and offsets a regressive necessities tax, it is targeted progressive tax relief rather than generic tax reduction.

title: To enact the Pregnancy Resource Act; Relating to income tax; to provide a state income tax credit to individuals and businesses that make contributions to eligible charitable organizations that operate as a pregnancy center or residential maternity facility; and to specify the obligations of the Department of Revenue in implementing the act.
description: To enact the Pregnancy Resource Act; Relating to income tax; to provide a state income tax credit to individuals and businesses that make contributions to eligible charitable organizations that operate as a pregnancy center or residential maternity facility; and to specify the obligations of the Department of Revenue in implementing the act.
frontier_rationale: Credits donations to pregnancy centers and maternity facilities. It is a targeted charitable tax expenditure and supports the anti-abortion service infrastructure, so both fiscal mechanism and reproductive-policy direction matter.

title: Relating to volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads; to make legislative findings that volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads fulfill a public purpose; to authorize volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads to purchase kitchen equipment and supplies for their stations; to authorize a tax credit for mileage to firefighters and squad members; and to specify that county commissions are not responsible for the expenditures and activities of volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads.
description: Relating to volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads; to make legislative findings that volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads fulfill a public purpose; to authorize volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads to purchase kitchen equipment and supplies for their stations; to authorize a tax credit for mileage to firefighters and squad members; and to specify that county commissions are not responsible for the expenditures and activities of volunteer fire departments and volunteer rescue squads.
frontier_rationale: Creates mileage credits and authorizes station purchases for volunteer fire and rescue organizations while limiting county responsibility. This is targeted volunteer emergency-service support.

title: Relating to the Alabama Jobs Act and the Growing Alabama Act; to amend Sections 40-18-370, 40-18-372, 40-18-374, 40-18-375, 40-18-376, 40-18-376.1, 40-18-376.2, 40-18-376.3, 40-18-376.4, 40-18-377, 40-18-378, 40-18-382, 40-18-383, 40-18-417.1, 40-18-417.2, 40-18-417.3, 40-18-417.4, 40-18-417.7, and 40-9B-4.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to extend the Alabama Jobs Act sunset date to July 31, 2028; to increase the annualized cap on outstanding Alabama Jobs Act incentives by twenty-five million dollars each year for five years up to four hundred seventy-five million dollars; to increase the investment tax credit transfer time to provide that the first five years of the investment credit may be transferred by the incentivized company and applied by another person or company under the Alabama Jobs Act; to extend the Growing Alabama Act sunset date to July 31, 2028, to increase the annual cap on funding approved pursuant to the Growing Alabama Act to thirty-five million dollars; to remove certain programs from the Growing Alabama Act for the transfer to Innovate Alabama.
description: Relating to the Alabama Jobs Act and the Growing Alabama Act; to amend Sections 40-18-370, 40-18-372, 40-18-374, 40-18-375, 40-18-376, 40-18-376.1, 40-18-376.2, 40-18-376.3, 40-18-376.4, 40-18-377, 40-18-378, 40-18-382, 40-18-383, 40-18-417.1, 40-18-417.2, 40-18-417.3, 40-18-417.4, 40-18-417.7, and 40-9B-4.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to extend the Alabama Jobs Act sunset date to July 31, 2028; to increase the annualized cap on outstanding Alabama Jobs Act incentives by twenty-five million dollars each year for five years up to four hundred seventy-five million dollars; to increase the investment tax credit transfer time to provide that the first five years of the investment credit may be transferred by the incentivized company and applied by another person or company under the Alabama Jobs Act; to extend the Growing Alabama Act sunset date to July 31, 2028, to increase the annual cap on funding approved pursuant to the Growing Alabama Act to thirty-five million dollars; to remove certain programs from the Growing Alabama Act for the transfer to Innovate Alabama.
frontier_rationale: Extends and raises Alabama Jobs Act incentive capacity while revising development programs and safeguards. It expands targeted industrial subsidies rather than reducing generally applicable taxes.

title: Relating to economic development; to amend Sections 41-10-802 and 41-10-822, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for a name change for the Alabama Innovation Corporation and revise the residency requirements for certain grant recipients; to amend Section 41-10-805, Code of Alabama 1975, relating to the Board of Directors of the Alabama Innovation Corporation, to make conforming changes to accurately cite the Code of Alabama 1975; and to add a new Article 22, commencing with Section 41-10-840, to Chapter 10 of Title 41, Code of Alabama 1975, to reestablish the technology accelerator tax credit program and the underrepresented company tax credit program as the Innovating Alabama tax credit program; and to exempt working groups, task forces, and subcommittees of the Alabama Innovation Corporation from the Alabama Open Meetings Act.
description: Relating to economic development; to amend Sections 41-10-802 and 41-10-822, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for a name change for the Alabama Innovation Corporation and revise the residency requirements for certain grant recipients; to amend Section 41-10-805, Code of Alabama 1975, relating to the Board of Directors of the Alabama Innovation Corporation, to make conforming changes to accurately cite the Code of Alabama 1975; and to add a new Article 22, commencing with Section 41-10-840, to Chapter 10 of Title 41, Code of Alabama 1975, to reestablish the technology accelerator tax credit program and the underrepresented company tax credit program as the Innovating Alabama tax credit program; and to exempt working groups, task forces, and subcommittees of the Alabama Innovation Corporation from the Alabama Open Meetings Act.
frontier_rationale: Reorganizes innovation programs, residency rules, boards, and new workforce or grant provisions. The truncated synopsis does not support a single tax or ideological direction; component-level text review is required before scoring.

title: Relating to taxation; to amend Sections 40-9F-31, 40-9F-33, and 40-9F-38, Code of Alabama 1975; to further provide certain age restrictions for structures to qualify for tax credits; to allow rehabilitation credits to be tied to the year in which the reservation is allocated; to provide for additional rehabilitation credit allocations; to further provide for the membership of the Historic Tax Credit Evaluating Committee and the factors considered by the committee; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style.
description: Relating to taxation; to amend Sections 40-9F-31, 40-9F-33, and 40-9F-38, Code of Alabama 1975; to further provide certain age restrictions for structures to qualify for tax credits; to allow rehabilitation credits to be tied to the year in which the reservation is allocated; to provide for additional rehabilitation credit allocations; to further provide for the membership of the Historic Tax Credit Evaluating Committee and the factors considered by the committee; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style.
frontier_rationale: Expands historic rehabilitation allocations and revises eligibility timing, committee membership, and evaluation. This is targeted preservation subsidy expansion with administrative restructuring.

title: Relating to income taxes; to amend Section 40-18-15.3, Code of Alabama 1975, to revise the qualifications for employees and employers to receive the income tax deduction for health insurance premiums paid.
description: Relating to income taxes; to amend Section 40-18-15.3, Code of Alabama 1975, to revise the qualifications for employees and employers to receive the income tax deduction for health insurance premiums paid.
frontier_rationale: Revises qualifications for employee and employer health-premium deductions. The synopsis does not establish whether access expands or contracts for each group; full text is needed for directional incidence.

title: Relating to exemptions from ad valorem taxation; to amend Section 40-9-1, as last amended by Act 2022-199 of the 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975; to exempt certain aircraft from ad valorem taxation.
description: Relating to exemptions from ad valorem taxation; to amend Section 40-9-1, as last amended by Act 2022-199 of the 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975; to exempt certain aircraft from ad valorem taxation.
frontier_rationale: Exempts specified aircraft from property taxation. This is targeted aviation-asset tax relief.

title: Relating to sales and use taxes; to amend Sections 40-23-1, 40-23-2, 40-23-60, and 40-23-61, Code of Alabama 1975, to define "food" and begin reducing the state sales and use tax on food on September 1, 2023; to require certain growth targets in the Education Trust Fund for future sales tax reductions on food; to establish the sales and use tax rate on food for purposes of county and municipal sales and use taxes as the existing general or retail sales and use tax rate; and to provide for the levy of sales and use tax on food by counties and municipalities.
description: Relating to sales and use taxes; to amend Sections 40-23-1, 40-23-2, 40-23-60, and 40-23-61, Code of Alabama 1975, to define "food" and begin reducing the state sales and use tax on food on September 1, 2023; to require certain growth targets in the Education Trust Fund for future sales tax reductions on food; to establish the sales and use tax rate on food for purposes of county and municipal sales and use taxes as the existing general or retail sales and use tax rate; and to provide for the levy of sales and use tax on food by counties and municipalities.
frontier_rationale: Begins reducing the state food sales tax while conditioning later reductions on Education Trust Fund growth and preserving existing local rates. It combines progressive consumption-tax relief with an explicit education-revenue safeguard.

title: Relating to sales tax; to amend Section 40-23-7, as last amended by Section 5 of Act 2022-53 of the 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for an increase in the amount of the average monthly sales tax liability for required estimated payments.
description: Relating to sales tax; to amend Section 40-23-7, as last amended by Section 5 of Act 2022-53 of the 2022 Regular Session, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for an increase in the amount of the average monthly sales tax liability for required estimated payments.
frontier_rationale: Raises the liability threshold triggering estimated sales-tax payments. It changes remittance timing and compliance burden, not the sales-tax rate or final liability.

title: To amend Section 40-9-12, Code of Alabama 1975, regarding tax exemptions, to change the name of the National Foundation to reflect its current name, the March of Dimes Inc.
description: To amend Section 40-9-12, Code of Alabama 1975, regarding tax exemptions, to change the name of the National Foundation to reflect its current name, the March of Dimes Inc.
frontier_rationale: Updates the statutory name of the March of Dimes within an existing exemption. It does not create or expand the exemption.

title: To establish the ReEngage Alabama Grant Program; to provide grant award payments to eligible adult learners; to provide eligibility standards, and to provide for administration by the Alabama Commission on Higher Education; relating to grants for short-term credentials; to establish the Alabama Short-Term Credential Scholarship Program to provide grants to Alabama residents to help them earn short-term credentials; to determine eligible recipients; to establish procedures for administering the program; to set forth the process by which the program will be funded; and to repeal the Alabama Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act commencing with Section 40-18-422, Code of Alabama 1975.
description: To establish the ReEngage Alabama Grant Program; to provide grant award payments to eligible adult learners; to provide eligibility standards, and to provide for administration by the Alabama Commission on Higher Education; relating to grants for short-term credentials; to establish the Alabama Short-Term Credential Scholarship Program to provide grants to Alabama residents to help them earn short-term credentials; to determine eligible recipients; to establish procedures for administering the program; to set forth the process by which the program will be funded; and to repeal the Alabama Apprenticeship Tax Credit Act commencing with Section 40-18-422, Code of Alabama 1975.
frontier_rationale: Creates grants for adult learners and short-term credentials administered by the higher-education commission. Its substance is publicly funded education and workforce access, not tax reduction.

title: Relating to the Coal Production Tax Credit; to amend Section 40-18-220, Code of Alabama 1975, to allow the credit to be claimed against both income and utility services taxes; to allow the credits to be earned by all persons that increase their production of coal mined in Alabama from the prior year; to allow any unused credits to be carried forward for no more than five years;
description: Relating to the Coal Production Tax Credit; to amend Section 40-18-220, Code of Alabama 1975, to allow the credit to be claimed against both income and utility services taxes; to allow the credits to be earned by all persons that increase their production of coal mined in Alabama from the prior year; to allow any unused credits to be carried forward for no more than five years;
frontier_rationale: Broadens the coal-production credit across income and utility-services taxes, expands eligibility, and permits carryforwards. This is targeted fossil-fuel production subsidy policy.

title: Relating to income taxes; to provide a one-time refundable income tax credit to qualified taxpayers to partially offset the amount of sales taxes paid on groceries throughout the tax year; to create the Refundable Tax Credit Fund in the State Treasury; to provide that refundable credits would not be taxable for Alabama income tax purposes; and to provide an effective date.
description: Relating to income taxes; to provide a one-time refundable income tax credit to qualified taxpayers to partially offset the amount of sales taxes paid on groceries throughout the tax year; to create the Refundable Tax Credit Fund in the State Treasury; to provide that refundable credits would not be taxable for Alabama income tax purposes; and to provide an effective date.
frontier_rationale: Creates a refundable household credit to offset grocery sales taxes. Refundability and the regressive tax base make this targeted progressive relief rather than generic tax reduction.

title: Relating to sales and use tax; to add a new Section 40-23-4.5, Code of Alabama 1975, to exclude products under Chapter 2A of Title 20 from the producer value added sales and use tax exemption.
description: Relating to sales and use tax; to add a new Section 40-23-4.5, Code of Alabama 1975, to exclude products under Chapter 2A of Title 20 from the producer value added sales and use tax exemption.
frontier_rationale: Excludes medical-cannabis products from a producer value-added sales-tax exemption. This narrows an exemption and expands taxable liability, the opposite of the inherited decrease label.

title: Education, instruction about gender identity and sexual orientation in public K-12 schools, prohibited
description: Education, instruction about gender identity and sexual orientation in public K-12 schools, prohibited
frontier_rationale: Prohibits public-school instruction about sexual orientation and gender identity. It is a traditionalist sexuality-policy measure implemented through state curriculum control, not a generic civil-liberty or racial-civil-rights vote.

title: Tuscaloosa, ad valorem tax, add increase up to 11.5 mills auth for public school purposes
description: Tuscaloosa, ad valorem tax, add increase up to 11.5 mills auth for public school purposes
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Tuscaloosa to add up to 11.5 mills for public schools. It combines a substantial local property-tax increase with education investment.

title: Birmingham Host Committee 2025 World Police and Fire Games tax exemptions
description: Birmingham Host Committee 2025 World Police and Fire Games tax exemptions
frontier_rationale: Creates exemptions for the Birmingham host committee for the 2025 World Police and Fire Games. This is a temporary event-specific public subsidy.

title: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
description: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
frontier_rationale: Exempts diapers, infant necessities, maternity clothing, and menstrual products from sales tax. This is targeted household necessities relief with family and menstrual-equity incidence.

title: Income taxes, tax deduction for contributions to an ABLE savings account extended
description: Income taxes, tax deduction for contributions to an ABLE savings account extended
frontier_rationale: Extends the deduction for ABLE-account contributions. It is targeted disability and family savings support, not broad income-tax relief.

title: Tax credits, authorizes ADEM to issue  tax credits to persons using certain recyclable materials, sale and trade of recycle tax credits,  civil penalties for fraud.
description: Tax credits, authorizes ADEM to issue  tax credits to persons using certain recyclable materials, sale and trade of recycle tax credits,  civil penalties for fraud.
frontier_rationale: Creates tradable recycling credits administered by ADEM with fraud penalties. It combines environmental industrial subsidy with program-integrity enforcement.

title: National guard and reserve; state income tax exemption
description: National guard and reserve; state income tax exemption
frontier_rationale: Creates or broadens a state income-tax exemption for National Guard and reserve income. This is occupation- and service-targeted personal tax relief.

title: Establishes the Alabama Workforce Housing Tax Credit Act; creates the Alabama Workforce Housing Tax Credit
description: Establishes the Alabama Workforce Housing Tax Credit Act; creates the Alabama Workforce Housing Tax Credit
frontier_rationale: Creates a workforce-housing credit. This is targeted housing-supply and affordability subsidy policy rather than general tax relief.

title: Income tax, tax credit for voluntary cash contributions to pregnancy center or residential maternity facility
description: Income tax, tax credit for voluntary cash contributions to pregnancy center or residential maternity facility
frontier_rationale: Credits voluntary contributions to pregnancy centers or maternity facilities. It subsidizes a favored charitable network and supports anti-abortion service alternatives.

title: Relating to child care and workforce development; to establish the employer tax credit and child care provider tax credit; to make legislative findings.
description: Relating to child care and workforce development; to establish the employer tax credit and child care provider tax credit; to make legislative findings.
frontier_rationale: Creates employer and provider credits for childcare and workforce development. This is targeted childcare supply and employment support.

title: Taxation and revenue; income tax credit for storm shelter construction, extended
description: Taxation and revenue; income tax credit for storm shelter construction, extended
frontier_rationale: Extends the storm-shelter construction credit. This continues targeted household disaster-resilience assistance.

title: Autauga County, ad valorem tax, add 7 mills for public school purposes, exemption of certain parcels of 100 acres or more
description: Autauga County, ad valorem tax, add 7 mills for public school purposes, exemption of certain parcels of 100 acres or more
frontier_rationale: Adds seven Autauga County mills for public schools while exempting specified parcels of at least 100 acres. It combines education taxation with preferential protection for large landholdings.

title: Wilcox County, authorizes county commission to increase ad valorem tax
description: Wilcox County, authorizes county commission to increase ad valorem tax
frontier_rationale: Authorizes the Wilcox County Commission to increase property taxes. This directly expands local ad valorem authority.

title: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for purchases of hearing instruments, including hearing aids.
description: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for purchases of hearing instruments, including hearing aids.
frontier_rationale: Exempts hearing instruments from sales and use tax. It is targeted medical-device relief that reduces the cost of disability access.

title: National guard and reserve; state income tax exemption
description: National guard and reserve; state income tax exemption
frontier_rationale: Creates or broadens a state income-tax exemption for National Guard and reserve income. This is service-targeted personal tax relief.

title: Relating to sales taxes; to provide for the additional state sales tax rate in ABC retail stores.
description: Relating to sales taxes; to provide for the additional state sales tax rate in ABC retail stores.
frontier_rationale: Adds a state sales-tax rate in ABC retail stores. This directly increases taxation of alcohol purchases and belongs under a targeted excise/retail base rather than general sales taxation.

title: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
description: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
frontier_rationale: Exempts diapers, infant necessities, maternity clothing, and menstrual products from sales tax. This is targeted household necessities relief with family and menstrual-equity incidence.

title: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
description: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption provided for certain purchases of diapers, baby supplies, baby formula, maternity clothing, and menstrual hygiene products
frontier_rationale: Exempts diapers, infant necessities, maternity clothing, and menstrual products from sales tax. This is targeted household necessities relief with family and menstrual-equity incidence.

title: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption with local option provided for purchases of optical aids, including eyeglasses and contact lenses
description: Taxation, sales tax exemptions, sales and use tax exemption with local option provided for purchases of optical aids, including eyeglasses and contact lenses
frontier_rationale: Provides a state sales-tax exemption and local option for eyeglasses and contact lenses. It combines medical-device affordability with local discretion over revenue.

title: Public K-12 education, discussions of gender identity prohibited in grades preK-12, employees prohibited from displaying flags or insignia relating to sexual orientation or gender identity, employees prohibited from referring to student by pronouns inconsistent with student's biological sex
description: Public K-12 education, discussions of gender identity prohibited in grades preK-12, employees prohibited from displaying flags or insignia relating to sexual orientation or gender identity, employees prohibited from referring to student by pronouns inconsistent with student's biological sex
frontier_rationale: Restricts school discussion and expression concerning gender identity and sexual orientation and requires sex-conforming pronoun usage. It directly combines traditionalist sexuality policy with curricular and employee-speech restrictions.

title: Choctaw County; ad valorem tax on certain property increased
description: Choctaw County; ad valorem tax on certain property increased
frontier_rationale: Increases Choctaw County property taxes on specified property. This is a direct local ad valorem increase, with exact incidence defined by the bill text.

title: Sales tax on food, limit on local rate reduction and growth requirement removed
description: Sales tax on food, limit on local rate reduction and growth requirement removed
frontier_rationale: Removes constraints on local food-sales-tax reductions. This enables further relief from a regressive necessities tax without itself mandating a particular local rate.

title: Income tax, exemption for taxable retirement income increased
description: Income tax, exemption for taxable retirement income increased
frontier_rationale: Increases the retirement-income exemption. This is age-targeted personal-income-tax relief.

title: Income tax, optional standard deduction increased, adjusted gross income range allowed for maximum dependent exemption increased
description: Income tax, optional standard deduction increased, adjusted gross income range allowed for maximum dependent exemption increased
frontier_rationale: Increases the optional standard deduction and the income range receiving the maximum dependent exemption. This is household personal-income-tax relief.

title: Physicians, rural physicians income tax credit, replace existing credit
description: Physicians, rural physicians income tax credit, replace existing credit
frontier_rationale: Replaces the existing rural-physician credit. The policy remains targeted rural health-workforce support, but precise fiscal expansion requires comparison with the prior program.

title: Income Taxes; to make technical changes to the funding provisions of the CHOOSE Act credits and increase funding, and to extend the sunset date for deductions for ABLE contributions.
description: Income Taxes; to make technical changes to the funding provisions of the CHOOSE Act credits and increase funding, and to extend the sunset date for deductions for ABLE contributions.
frontier_rationale: Increases funding for CHOOSE Act school-choice credits and extends ABLE contribution deductions. These are distinct tax expenditures benefiting private-school choice and disability savings.

title: Rural Hospital Investment Program established, tax credits for donations to rural hospitals authorized
description: Rural Hospital Investment Program established, tax credits for donations to rural hospitals authorized
frontier_rationale: Creates credits for donations to rural hospitals. This is targeted rural-health financing through charitable tax expenditures.

title: International wire transfers; fee on wire transfers imposed; income tax credit for wire transfer fees paid, authorized; Securities Commission and Revenue Department to administer
description: International wire transfers; fee on wire transfers imposed; income tax credit for wire transfer fees paid, authorized; Securities Commission and Revenue Department to administer
frontier_rationale: Imposes a fee on international wire transfers and offers an income-tax credit for fees paid. Incidence differs sharply between filers able to claim the credit and other remitters, so one tax-direction score would be misleading.

title: Sex-based terms, defined; vital statistics, report sex as male or female at birth required, legislative policy regarding sex and gender identity established
description: Sex-based terms, defined; vital statistics, report sex as male or female at birth required, legislative policy regarding sex and gender identity established
frontier_rationale: Defines sex as male or female for vital statistics and declares state policy rejecting gender-identity-based classifications. This is a direct traditionalist sex-and-gender policy measure, not a generic civil-social-liberty vote.

title: Income tax; credit for donation to food banks.
description: Income tax; credit for donation to food banks.
frontier_rationale: Creates a credit for donations to food banks. It is a targeted charitable tax expenditure supporting food-security services, not broad income-tax relief.

title: Railroad Modernization Act of 2019, to increase the cap on income tax credits and extend the sunset date for five years through tax year 2032
description: Railroad Modernization Act of 2019, to increase the cap on income tax credits and extend the sunset date for five years through tax year 2032
frontier_rationale: Raises the cap and extends the railroad modernization credit through 2032. This expands a targeted private rail-infrastructure subsidy.

title: Walker County; senior property tax exemption authorized; constitutional amendment
description: Walker County; senior property tax exemption authorized; constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Walker County senior property-tax exemption by constitutional amendment. It is age-targeted local tax relief subject to voter ratification.

title: Fayette County; senior property tax exemption authorized, constitutional amendment
description: Fayette County; senior property tax exemption authorized, constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Fayette County senior property-tax exemption by constitutional amendment. It is age-targeted local tax relief subject to voter ratification.

title: Firefighters and rescue squad members, income tax credit for training under certain conditions expanded
description: Firefighters and rescue squad members, income tax credit for training under certain conditions expanded
frontier_rationale: Expands the training credit for firefighters and rescue-squad members. This is targeted emergency-workforce support rather than broad income-tax relief.

title: Taxation; to establish an income tax credit for oyster shell recycling
description: Taxation; to establish an income tax credit for oyster shell recycling
frontier_rationale: Creates a credit for oyster-shell recycling. It is a targeted environmental and coastal-resource incentive rather than general tax relief.

title: Mobile County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
description: Mobile County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Mobile County senior property-tax exemption by constitutional amendment. It is age-targeted local tax relief subject to voter ratification.

title: Limestone County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
description: Limestone County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Limestone County senior property-tax exemption by constitutional amendment. It is age-targeted local tax relief subject to voter ratification.

title: Blount County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
description: Blount County; senior property tax exemption, authorized; constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a Blount County senior property-tax exemption by constitutional amendment. It is age-targeted local tax relief subject to voter ratification.

title: Living organ donors; to prohibit discrimination in obtaining insurance coverage, provide paid medical leave for public employees who donate organs and a tax credit to private sector employers that provide similar paid leave to their employees
description: Living organ donors; to prohibit discrimination in obtaining insurance coverage, provide paid medical leave for public employees who donate organs and a tax credit to private sector employers that provide similar paid leave to their employees
frontier_rationale: Protects organ donors in insurance, provides paid leave to public employees, and credits private employers offering similar leave. This is donor protection and paid-medical-leave policy, not generic tax relief.

title: Lawrence County; senior property tax exemption authorized; constitutional amendment

frontier_rationale: Allows local school boards to use specified public-school funds for facility debt and insurance. This broadens permissible local fiscal uses rather than changing education funding levels.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board, notification of victims, procedures changed, supplying contact information for notification, victims authorized to choose not to be notified, Implementation Task Force established for statewide automated victim notification system, Sec. 15-22-36.2 added; Secs. 15-22-23, 15-22-36 am'd. (2011-20727)
description: Pardons and Paroles Board, notification of victims, procedures changed, supplying contact information for notification, victims authorized to choose not to be notified, Implementation Task Force established for statewide automated victim notification system, Sec. 15-22-36.2 added; Secs. 15-22-23, 15-22-36 am'd. (2011-20727)
frontier_rationale: Modernizes parole victim notification, creates an automated system, and lets victims decline notices. This expands victim services while respecting recipient choice.

title: Public School and College Authority, bonds authorized by Act 99-348, 1999 Reg. Sess. and Act 2002-240, 2002 Reg. Sess., certain unused proceeds, premium income, and investment income of bonds, expenditure for additional public education purposes and administrative costs authorized
description: Public School and College Authority, bonds authorized by Act 99-348, 1999 Reg. Sess. and Act 2002-240, 2002 Reg. Sess., certain unused proceeds, premium income, and investment income of bonds, expenditure for additional public education purposes and administrative costs authorized
frontier_rationale: Allows unused school-authority bond proceeds and earnings to support additional public-education purposes and administrative costs. It broadens use of existing education capital resources.

title: Data processing centers and warehousing and storage facilities locating in Alabama, certain ad valorem tax and construction related transaction tax abatements authorized, requirements, Data Processing Center Economic Incentive Enhancement Act, Secs. 40-9B-3, 40-9B-4, 40-18-190, 40-18-193 am'd.
description: Data processing centers and warehousing and storage facilities locating in Alabama, certain ad valorem tax and construction related transaction tax abatements authorized, requirements, Data Processing Center Economic Incentive Enhancement Act, Secs. 40-9B-3, 40-9B-4, 40-18-190, 40-18-193 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands property and transaction-tax abatements for data centers and warehousing facilities. This is targeted industrial subsidy policy.

title: Economic Development, incentive program authorized for projects that provide economic development and job creation, const. amend.
description: Economic Development, incentive program authorized for projects that provide economic development and job creation, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionally authorizes incentives for job-creating economic-development projects. This advances targeted industrial subsidy policy subject to voter ratification.

title: Physical therapists, referral by licensed health care providers, Sec. 34-24-210.1 added; Secs. 34-24-191, 34-24-217 am'd.
description: Physical therapists, referral by licensed health care providers, Sec. 34-24-210.1 added; Secs. 34-24-191, 34-24-217 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Adds or revises referral requirements for physical therapy. On the synopsis, this conditions access on another licensed provider and restricts direct-access autonomy.

title: Public schools, grades 9-12, textbooks and instructional materials, Education Department to provide in electronic format to each student as feasible
description: Public schools, grades 9-12, textbooks and instructional materials, Education Department to provide in electronic format to each student as feasible
frontier_rationale: Directs the Education Department to provide high-school textbooks and instructional materials electronically when feasible. This advances digital instructional access.

title: Industrial Development Authority, members, composition altered to include President Pro Tempore of Senate or designee and Speaker of the House or designee, Sec. 41-10-25 am'd.
description: Industrial Development Authority, members, composition altered to include President Pro Tempore of Senate or designee and Speaker of the House or designee, Sec. 41-10-25 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Adds legislative leaders or designees to the Industrial Development Authority. This shifts governance toward legislative participation.

title: Economic Development, entertain industry incentives, qualified production project, qualified expenditure available for rebate or exemption increased, Sec. 41-7A-43, 41-7A-45, 41-7A-48, am'd; Act 2011-695, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd (2012-20079)
description: Economic Development, entertain industry incentives, qualified production project, qualified expenditure available for rebate or exemption increased, Sec. 41-7A-43, 41-7A-45, 41-7A-48, am'd; Act 2011-695, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd (2012-20079)
frontier_rationale: Raises rebates or exemptions available to qualified entertainment productions. This expands targeted film-industry subsidy policy.

title: Health Insurance Exchange established, operated by a board, members, duties, repealed if federal health reform laws requiring exchange repealed or defunded or declared unconstitutional by the U.S. Supreme Court, Health Insurance Exchange Act
description: Health Insurance Exchange established, operated by a board, members, duties, repealed if federal health reform laws requiring exchange repealed or defunded or declared unconstitutional by the U.S. Supreme Court, Health Insurance Exchange Act
frontier_rationale: Creates a state-governed health-insurance exchange contingent on federal law. This implements regulated insurance-market access rather than rejecting the federal framework.

title: Crimes and Offenses, prisoners, prohibition against use of social networks
description: Crimes and Offenses, prisoners, prohibition against use of social networks
frontier_rationale: Prohibits prisoners from using social networks. This directly restricts incarcerated people's communication privileges.

title: Secondary metals recycler, additional records to be maintained, purchases of specified metal property limited, registration with ACJIC, required, database of metal property sales created, criminal penalties, purchase of specified metal property prohibited, Secs. 13A-8-30 to 13A-8-37, inclusive, 13A-8-39 am'd; Secs. 13A-8-31.1, 13A-8-31.2, 13A-8-35.1, 13A-8-37.1, 13A-8-37.2 added
description: Secondary metals recycler, additional records to be maintained, purchases of specified metal property limited, registration with ACJIC, required, database of metal property sales created, criminal penalties, purchase of specified metal property prohibited, Secs. 13A-8-30 to 13A-8-37, inclusive, 13A-8-39 am'd; Secs. 13A-8-31.1, 13A-8-31.2, 13A-8-35.1, 13A-8-37.1, 13A-8-37.2 added
frontier_rationale: Requires recycler records and registration, restricts purchases, creates a sales database, and adds penalties. It combines anti-theft enforcement with commercial regulation and monitoring.

title: Prisoners, escaped inmates, notification of state and local agencies and news media, liability limited, Joel Willmore Act, Sec. 14-3-58 am'd.
description: Prisoners, escaped inmates, notification of state and local agencies and news media, liability limited, Joel Willmore Act, Sec. 14-3-58 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires notice of escaped prisoners to agencies and media and limits government liability. This expands public-safety notification with official immunity.

title: Insurance fraud, defined, investigations by Insurance Department, civil immunity for reporting fraud, Insurance Fraud Unit and fund created in Insurance Department, civil and criminal penalties, six year filing limit, Secs. 27-12A-1 to 27-12A-9, incl., 27-12A-20 to 27-12A-24, incl., 27-12A-40 to 27-12A-42, incl., added; Secs. 10A-20-6.16, 27-21A-23 am'd.
description: Insurance fraud, defined, investigations by Insurance Department, civil immunity for reporting fraud, Insurance Fraud Unit and fund created in Insurance Department, civil and criminal penalties, six year filing limit, Secs. 27-12A-1 to 27-12A-9, incl., 27-12A-20 to 27-12A-24, incl., 27-12A-40 to 27-12A-42, incl., added; Secs. 10A-20-6.16, 27-21A-23 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Defines insurance fraud, creates an investigative unit and fund, adds penalties, and protects reports. This expands regulated-market enforcement rather than ordinary criminal sentencing.

title: Alabama Uniform Environmental Covenants Act, exempt underground and aboveground storage tanks storing motor fuel from requirements of, Sec. 35-19-2 am'd
description: Alabama Uniform Environmental Covenants Act, exempt underground and aboveground storage tanks storing motor fuel from requirements of, Sec. 35-19-2 am'd
frontier_rationale: Exempts qualifying motor-fuel storage tanks from uniform environmental-covenant requirements. This narrows environmental land-use controls for petroleum facilities.

title: Code of Alabama 1975, Acts of 2010 First Special Session and 2011 Regular Session as contained in 2011 supplements and replacement volumes, codified with certain corrections, local laws of certain counties codified, duties of Secretary of State, Secs. 17-14-70, 22-9A-13 am'd
description: Code of Alabama 1975, Acts of 2010 First Special Session and 2011 Regular Session as contained in 2011 supplements and replacement volumes, codified with certain corrections, local laws of certain counties codified, duties of Secretary of State, Secs. 17-14-70, 22-9A-13 am'd
frontier_rationale: Codifies prior acts and replacement volumes with corrections. This is statutory maintenance.

title: Law enforcement officers, firefighters, first responders, corrections officers, exposure to contagious, infectious, or communicable disease in the line of duty, blood and saliva testing of offender authorized, testing procedures, use of test results specified, notification of offender of positive results and availability of counseling and health care
description: Law enforcement officers, firefighters, first responders, corrections officers, exposure to contagious, infectious, or communicable disease in the line of duty, blood and saliva testing of offender authorized, testing procedures, use of test results specified, notification of offender of positive results and availability of counseling and health care
frontier_rationale: Authorizes blood or saliva testing after occupational exposure and provides notice, counseling, and care. It protects responders while compelling biological testing of accused or convicted people.

title: Absentee ballots, duplicated language deleted, Sec. 17-9-51 repealed
description: Absentee ballots, duplicated language deleted, Sec. 17-9-51 repealed
frontier_rationale: Repeals duplicated absentee-ballot language. The synopsis describes code cleanup without a substantive access or administration change.

title: United Ways of Alabama, authorized to participate in state health insurance coverage, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
description: United Ways of Alabama, authorized to participate in state health insurance coverage, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows United Ways of Alabama to participate in state health coverage. This expands public-plan access.

title: Digital Crime Act, computer crimes, cyberstalking, electronic harassment, phishing, data fraud, and computer tampering, criminal penalties, jurisdiction for prosecution, forfeiture of equipment, Secs. 13A-8-100, 13A-8-101, 13A-8-102, 13A-8-103 repealed
description: Digital Crime Act, computer crimes, cyberstalking, electronic harassment, phishing, data fraud, and computer tampering, criminal penalties, jurisdiction for prosecution, forfeiture of equipment, Secs. 13A-8-100, 13A-8-101, 13A-8-102, 13A-8-103 repealed
frontier_rationale: Creates or revises computer, stalking, harassment, phishing, and data crimes with penalties and forfeiture. It expands digital protections through punitive enforcement.

title: Public School and College Authorities, change baseline date, increase average salary, allow schools affected by closure of bases to receive proceeds from the authority, Secs. 16-16A-2, 16-16A-7, 16-16A-8 am'd
description: Public School and College Authorities, change baseline date, increase average salary, allow schools affected by closure of bases to receive proceeds from the authority, Secs. 16-16A-2, 16-16A-7, 16-16A-8 am'd
frontier_rationale: Revises school-authority eligibility, salary baselines, and assistance for schools affected by base closures. It is a mixed public-education resource measure, not a single funding-direction vote.

title: Colleges and Universities, new construction of building containing classrooms and dorm rooms at 2-year and 4-year institutions of higher education required to have Alabama Building Commission approved safe place
description: Colleges and Universities, new construction of building containing classrooms and dorm rooms at 2-year and 4-year institutions of higher education required to have Alabama Building Commission approved safe place
frontier_rationale: Requires approved safe places in new classroom and dormitory buildings at public two- and four-year institutions. This expands public-institution safety mandates.

title: Environmental Management Department, entities requesting permit for processing or treatment of toxic substances or hazardous waste, performance bond required
description: Environmental Management Department, entities requesting permit for processing or treatment of toxic substances or hazardous waste, performance bond required
frontier_rationale: Requires performance bonds from entities seeking toxic-substance or hazardous-waste treatment permits. This strengthens cleanup and financial-assurance regulation.

title: Abortions, ectopic pregnancies excluded from definition of "abortion" when used in Code of Alabama 1975 and the Alabama Administrative Code, certain requirements relating to probable post-fertilization age clarified
description: Abortions, ectopic pregnancies excluded from definition of "abortion" when used in Code of Alabama 1975 and the Alabama Administrative Code, certain requirements relating to probable post-fertilization age clarified
frontier_rationale: Excludes ectopic-pregnancy treatment from the legal definition of abortion and clarifies gestational-age requirements. It protects medically necessary ectopic treatment from abortion restrictions but is narrower than a general abortion-access expansion.

title: Hospitals and emergency medical services, statewide trauma system and council, council amended, coordination of pre-hospital and hospital care, regulated by Health Department and other systems and other health services for other illnesses, Secs. 22-11D-1 to 22-11D-9, inclusive, am'd; Sec. 22-11D-10 added
description: Hospitals and emergency medical services, statewide trauma system and council, council amended, coordination of pre-hospital and hospital care, regulated by Health Department and other systems and other health services for other illnesses, Secs. 22-11D-1 to 22-11D-9, inclusive, am'd; Sec. 22-11D-10 added
frontier_rationale: Expands and coordinates the statewide trauma and emergency-care system under Health Department regulation. This increases public healthcare-system capacity.

title: Prescription drugs, to provide a named federal health care center to fill certain prescriptions, Sec. 34-23-70 am'd
description: Prescription drugs, to provide a named federal health care center to fill certain prescriptions, Sec. 34-23-70 am'd
frontier_rationale: Allows a named federal health center to fill specified prescriptions. This expands dispensing access for that safety-net provider.

title: Russell County, mail order fee established for renewal of business licenses
description: Russell County, mail order fee established for renewal of business licenses
frontier_rationale: Creates a Russell County mail-order business-license renewal fee. This is local administrative cost recovery rather than substantive business regulation.

title: Montgomery Co., Montgomery Industrial Development Board, two additional members appointed by county commission
description: Montgomery Co., Montgomery Industrial Development Board, two additional members appointed by county commission
frontier_rationale: Adds county-appointed members to Montgomery's industrial-development board. This is local governance.

title: Troy University, standing committees of board allowed to meet via teleconference pursuant to Open Meetings Act, Sec. 16-56-5 am'd
description: Troy University, standing committees of board allowed to meet via teleconference pursuant to Open Meetings Act, Sec. 16-56-5 am'd
frontier_rationale: Allows Troy University board committees to meet by teleconference under the Open Meetings Act. This expands remote participation while retaining transparency-law coverage.

title: Medicaid, nursing facilities, monthly surcharge from May 20, 2012, until August 31, 2013, Secs. 40-26B-21, 40-26B-22 am'd
description: Medicaid, nursing facilities, monthly surcharge from May 20, 2012, until August 31, 2013, Secs. 40-26B-21, 40-26B-22 am'd
frontier_rationale: Imposes a temporary monthly nursing-facility surcharge used in Medicaid financing. It raises provider taxation to support coverage funding.

title: Calhoun Co., absentee ballots, county commission authorized to manage, const. amend.
description: Calhoun Co., absentee ballots, county commission authorized to manage, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionally authorizes the Calhoun County Commission to manage absentee ballots. This changes local administrative responsibility but supplies no clear general voting-access direction.

title: Franklin County, distribution of certain funds for economic development to the Franklin County Development Authority
description: Franklin County, distribution of certain funds for economic development to the Franklin County Development Authority
frontier_rationale: Distributes specified Franklin County funds to its development authority. This is local revenue allocation rather than general business ideology.

title: Private Investigation Board, established, members, terms, powers, vacancies, private investigators, licensure and regulation, subject to Administrative Procedure Act, civil and criminal penalties, Private Investigators Licensing and Regulatory Act
description: Private Investigation Board, established, members, terms, powers, vacancies, private investigators, licensure and regulation, subject to Administrative Procedure Act, civil and criminal penalties, Private Investigators Licensing and Regulatory Act
frontier_rationale: Creates a licensing board and regulatory regime for private investigators with civil and criminal penalties. This expands occupational regulation.

title: Health, abortion coverage by exchange participating health plans, State of Alabama opts out of authorizing, Federal Abortion Mandate Opt Out Act
description: Health, abortion coverage by exchange participating health plans, State of Alabama opts out of authorizing, Federal Abortion Mandate Opt Out Act
frontier_rationale: Opts Alabama out of abortion coverage in health plans participating in the federal exchange. This directly restricts insurance coverage for abortion services.

title: Criminal surveillance, enhanced criminal penalties for surveillance for purpose of sexual arousal or gratification, crime of aggravated criminal surveillance created
description: Criminal surveillance, enhanced criminal penalties for surveillance for purpose of sexual arousal or gratification, crime of aggravated criminal surveillance created
frontier_rationale: Creates aggravated criminal surveillance and enhances penalties for sexually motivated surveillance. It protects sexual privacy through punitive enforcement.

title: Public assistance, fraud in obtaining, crime established, penalties, theft of services, knowledge requirement deleted, Sec. 13A-8-10 am'd.
description: Public assistance, fraud in obtaining, crime established, penalties, theft of services, knowledge requirement deleted, Sec. 13A-8-10 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates public-assistance fraud crimes and deletes a knowledge requirement from theft-of-services law. This expands punitive welfare enforcement and weakens mens rea protection.

title: Alabama Prisoner Litigation Reform Act established, Montgomery County Circuit Court exclusive jurisdiction for all prisoners action, court guidelines established (2012-20522)
description: Alabama Prisoner Litigation Reform Act established, Montgomery County Circuit Court exclusive jurisdiction for all prisoners action, court guidelines established (2012-20522)
frontier_rationale: Creates special prisoner-litigation rules and exclusive Montgomery jurisdiction. This restricts and centralizes incarcerated people's access to civil courts.

title: Education, public school K-12, minimum mandatory age of attendance decreased from seven to six, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
description: Education, public school K-12, minimum mandatory age of attendance decreased from seven to six, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Lowers the mandatory school-attendance age from seven to six. This expands the state's compulsory-education requirement.

title: Secondary metals recycler, additional records to be maintained, purchases of specified metal property limited, registration with ACJIC, required, database of metal property sales created, criminal penalties, purchase of specified metal property prohibited, Secs. 13A-8-30 to 13A-8-37, inclusive, 13A-8-39 am'd; Secs. 13A-8-31.1, 13A-8-31.2, 13A-8-35.1, 13A-8-37.1, 13A-8-37.2 added (2012-20110)
description: Secondary metals recycler, additional records to be maintained, purchases of specified metal property limited, registration with ACJIC, required, database of metal property sales created, criminal penalties, purchase of specified metal property prohibited, Secs. 13A-8-30 to 13A-8-37, inclusive, 13A-8-39 am'd; Secs. 13A-8-31.1, 13A-8-31.2, 13A-8-35.1, 13A-8-37.1, 13A-8-37.2 added (2012-20110)
frontier_rationale: Requires recycler records and registration, restricts transactions, creates a database, and adds penalties. It combines anti-theft enforcement with commercial monitoring.

title: Criminal sentences, modification of sentencing standard effective after submission unless rejected, truth-in-sentencing standards to be submitted to Legislature, sentencing standards made presumptive subject to modification for certain mitigating and aggravating circumstances, Secs. 12-25-3, 12-25-32, 12-25-34, 12-25-36 am'd. (2012-20412)
description: Criminal sentences, modification of sentencing standard effective after submission unless rejected, truth-in-sentencing standards to be submitted to Legislature, sentencing standards made presumptive subject to modification for certain mitigating and aggravating circumstances, Secs. 12-25-3, 12-25-32, 12-25-34, 12-25-36 am'd. (2012-20412)
frontier_rationale: Makes sentencing standards presumptive while permitting departures for aggravating or mitigating circumstances. It restricts judicial discretion and favors consistency, but the synopsis does not establish net severity.

title: United Ways of Alabama, authorized to participate in state health insurance coverage, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
description: United Ways of Alabama, authorized to participate in state health insurance coverage, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows United Ways of Alabama to participate in state health coverage. This expands public-plan access.

title: Athlete Agents, student athletes, negotiating enrollment at specific educational institutions prohibited, criminal penalties, registration with proof of league players association required, commission authorized to issue reprimands and additional penalties, Secs. 8-26A-2, 8-26A-4, 8-26A-5, 8-26A-6, 8-26A-9, 8-26A-10, 8-26A-11, 8-26A-13, 8-26A-14, 8-26A-15, 8-26A-17, 8-26A-30 am'd
description: Athlete Agents, student athletes, negotiating enrollment at specific educational institutions prohibited, criminal penalties, registration with proof of league players association required, commission authorized to issue reprimands and additional penalties, Secs. 8-26A-2, 8-26A-4, 8-26A-5, 8-26A-6, 8-26A-9, 8-26A-10, 8-26A-11, 8-26A-13, 8-26A-14, 8-26A-15, 8-26A-17, 8-26A-30 am'd
frontier_rationale: Expands athlete-agent registration and conduct rules, prohibits enrollment negotiation, and adds administrative and criminal sanctions. This is consumer-style regulation protecting student athletes.

title: Environment, prohibit state, counties, etc., from developing environmental and developmental policies that would infringe on the due process of citizens
description: Environment, prohibit state, counties, etc., from developing environmental and developmental policies that would infringe on the due process of citizens
frontier_rationale: Bars environmental or development policies deemed to infringe citizen due process. It is an anti-regulatory constraint framed as property and procedural protection; operative breadth requires text.

title: Jackson Co., sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property, and firearms, distribution of funds for law enforcement purposes
description: Jackson Co., sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property, and firearms, distribution of funds for law enforcement purposes
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Jackson County's sheriff to sell recovered property and firearms for law-enforcement funding. It is local asset disposition rather than a broad gun-policy position.

title: Elections, campaign finance reporting, eliminate duplicate and multiple filings, provide full month and weeks reporting periods, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd
description: Elections, campaign finance reporting, eliminate duplicate and multiple filings, provide full month and weeks reporting periods, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd
frontier_rationale: Eliminates duplicate campaign reports and standardizes reporting periods. This streamlines compliance without reducing the stated disclosure content.

title: Third Party Prescription Program Act, not applicable to Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan, Sec. 34-23-116 am'd.
description: Third Party Prescription Program Act, not applicable to Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan, Sec. 34-23-116 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Exempts the Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan from the rule barring third-party prescription reimbursement below customary consumer rates. This expands the public plan's purchasing and cost-control flexibility while weakening the statutory reimbursement floor protecting pharmacies.

title: Jefferson County, Indigent Care Fund, distrib. to authority created in Class 1 municipality for health care, county commission to sell Cooper Green Hospital, Act 387, 1965 Reg Sess. am'd
description: Jefferson County, Indigent Care Fund, distrib. to authority created in Class 1 municipality for health care, county commission to sell Cooper Green Hospital, Act 387, 1965 Reg Sess. am'd
frontier_rationale: Redirects indigent-care money to a new authority and authorizes sale of Cooper Green Hospital. It combines safety-net funding with potential privatization or governance transfer.

title: Health, creation of health care authority in Class 1 municipality, powers, duties etc.
description: Health, creation of health care authority in Class 1 municipality, powers, duties etc.
frontier_rationale: Creates a healthcare authority in a Class 1 municipality with institutional powers. This expands public or quasi-public healthcare governance.

title: Corrections Department, prison industries, sale of products further provided for, operation of joint venture with private businesses, authorized, Secs. 14-7-7, 14-7-22 am'd.
description: Corrections Department, prison industries, sale of products further provided for, operation of joint venture with private businesses, authorized, Secs. 14-7-7, 14-7-22 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands prison-industry sales and authorizes private joint ventures. This increases economic use of incarcerated labor.

title: Law enforcement or corrections officers, crime of disarming, established, penalty
description: Law enforcement or corrections officers, crime of disarming, established, penalty
frontier_rationale: Creates a specific crime for disarming police or corrections officers. This expands punitive protection of law-enforcement authority.

title: Twenty-First Century Workforce Act, Public School and College Authority, issuance of bonds for public schools and colleges, proceeds used for career and technical education equipment, workforce fund and committee created
description: Twenty-First Century Workforce Act, Public School and College Authority, issuance of bonds for public schools and colleges, proceeds used for career and technical education equipment, workforce fund and committee created
frontier_rationale: Authorizes bonds for public-school and college career-technical equipment and creates a workforce fund and committee. It expands public vocational investment through debt finance.

title: Health Care Compact established, consent of U. S. Congress secured for return of authority to member states to regulate health care, Interstate Advisory Health Care Commission established, membership, duties, terms, funding
description: Health Care Compact established, consent of U. S. Congress secured for return of authority to member states to regulate health care, Interstate Advisory Health Care Commission established, membership, duties, terms, funding
frontier_rationale: Creates an interstate compact seeking congressional return of healthcare regulatory authority to states. This is a direct states-rights challenge to federal health governance.

title: Jefferson Co., accounting of proceeds from Indigent Health Care Fund to each member of Jefferson Co., Legislative Delegation, penalties
description: Jefferson Co., accounting of proceeds from Indigent Health Care Fund to each member of Jefferson Co., Legislative Delegation, penalties
frontier_rationale: Requires accounting of Jefferson County indigent-health fund proceeds to legislators with penalties. This expands fiscal transparency.

title: Prisoners, escaped inmates, notification of state and local agencies and news media, liability limited, Joel Willmore Act, Sec. 14-3-58 am'd.
description: Prisoners, escaped inmates, notification of state and local agencies and news media, liability limited, Joel Willmore Act, Sec. 14-3-58 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires escaped-prisoner notification and limits official liability. This expands public-safety communication with government immunity.

title: Controlled substances, deceptively obtaining same or similar substance from two or more practitioners prohibited, criminal penalties
description: Controlled substances, deceptively obtaining same or similar substance from two or more practitioners prohibited, criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes deceptively obtaining controlled substances from multiple practitioners. This expands punitive drug enforcement.

title: Certificates of Need, health care facilities, transfer of ownership, includes legal entities, retro. effect, Secs. 22-21-260, 22-21-263, 22-21-270 am'd.
description: Certificates of Need, health care facilities, transfer of ownership, includes legal entities, retro. effect, Secs. 22-21-260, 22-21-263, 22-21-270 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends certificate-of-need ownership-transfer rules to legal entities retroactively. This appears to close a transfer loophole and expand facility-market regulation.

title: Private Investigation Board, established, licensing and regulation of private investigators, members, terms, powers, vacancies, subject to Administrative Procedure Act, civil and criminal penalties, Private Investigators Licensing and Regulatory Act
description: Private Investigation Board, established, licensing and regulation of private investigators, members, terms, powers, vacancies, subject to Administrative Procedure Act, civil and criminal penalties, Private Investigators Licensing and Regulatory Act
frontier_rationale: Creates a private-investigator licensing board with civil and criminal enforcement. This expands occupational regulation.

title: Code of Alabama 1975, Acts of 2012 Regular Session and 2012 First Special Session as contained in 2012 supplements and replacement volumes, codified with certain corrections, local laws of certain counties codified, duties of Secretary of State, Secs. 34-17-21 am'd.
description: Code of Alabama 1975, Acts of 2012 Regular Session and 2012 First Special Session as contained in 2012 supplements and replacement volumes, codified with certain corrections, local laws of certain counties codified, duties of Secretary of State, Secs. 34-17-21 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Codifies prior acts and replacement volumes with corrections. This is statutory maintenance.

title: State Health Insurance Board, Alabama Network of Children Advocacy Centers and member centers authorized to participate in, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
description: State Health Insurance Board, Alabama Network of Children Advocacy Centers and member centers authorized to participate in, Sec. 36-29-14 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows child-advocacy centers to participate in state health insurance. This expands public-plan eligibility for nonprofit workers.

title: Animals, criminal penalties for the purchase or sale of domestic animals or fowl between sunrise and sunset, repealed, Sec. 3-1-20 repealed
description: Animals, criminal penalties for the purchase or sale of domestic animals or fowl between sunrise and sunset, repealed, Sec. 3-1-20 repealed
frontier_rationale: Repeals an archaic criminal prohibition on buying or selling domestic animals or fowl during specified hours. This reduces criminalization.

title: Child abuse and neglect, mandatory reporting by education employees, postsecondary and higher education employees, and physical therapists included, protection of employees for reporting, criminal penalties, Sec. 26-14-3 am'd.
description: Child abuse and neglect, mandatory reporting by education employees, postsecondary and higher education employees, and physical therapists included, protection of employees for reporting, criminal penalties, Sec. 26-14-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands mandatory child-abuse reporting to additional education and therapy employees, protects reporters, and retains penalties. This strengthens child protection and reporting duties.

title: Medicaid, Medicaid copayments, Medicaid Agency waiver request to increase copayments for health care services
description: Medicaid, Medicaid copayments, Medicaid Agency waiver request to increase copayments for health care services
frontier_rationale: Directs Medicaid to seek authority to increase patient copayments. This raises financial barriers for low-income beneficiaries.

title: Medicaid, Legislative committees on, Permanent Joint Medicaid Committee estab., Joint Legislative Interim Committee and Permanent Joint Legislative Committee on Medicaid Policy abolished, duties, members, expenses, Medicaid Advisory Commission estab. composed of health care providers
description: Medicaid, Legislative committees on, Permanent Joint Medicaid Committee estab., Joint Legislative Interim Committee and Permanent Joint Legislative Committee on Medicaid Policy abolished, duties, members, expenses, Medicaid Advisory Commission estab. composed of health care providers
frontier_rationale: Creates a permanent legislative Medicaid committee and provider advisory commission while abolishing predecessor bodies. This restructures and formalizes oversight and stakeholder participation.

title: Elections, absentee ballots, Sec. of State by emergency rule may permit first responders to vote absentee, expenses paid by state, Secs. 17-11-3, 17-11-7 am'd.
description: Elections, absentee ballots, Sec. of State by emergency rule may permit first responders to vote absentee, expenses paid by state, Secs. 17-11-3, 17-11-7 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows emergency absentee-voting rules for first responders and funds associated expenses. This directly expands ballot access for an occupational group facing emergency deployment.

title: Randolph Co., sheriff's pistol permit fee, waiver for active or retired law enforcement officers, Act 89-446, 1989 Reg. Sess., am'd.

title: Employees' Retirement System, retirement benefits for Tier II plan members modified to provide 30-year service retirement, conversion of sick leave, and hazardous duty time for firefighters, law enforcement, and correctional officers, contribution rate increased, Secs. 36-26-36.1, 36-27-16, 36-27-24, 36-27-59 am'd.
description: Employees' Retirement System, retirement benefits for Tier II plan members modified to provide 30-year service retirement, conversion of sick leave, and hazardous duty time for firefighters, law enforcement, and correctional officers, contribution rate increased, Secs. 36-26-36.1, 36-27-16, 36-27-24, 36-27-59 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands Tier II retirement eligibility and hazardous-duty credit while increasing contributions. Benefit and current-pay effects conflict.

title: Retirement System, firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers, hazardous duty time, removing the time limit for purchasing for prior eligible service, Sec. 36-27-59 am'd.
description: Retirement System, firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers, hazardous duty time, removing the time limit for purchasing for prior eligible service, Sec. 36-27-59 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Removes the deadline for public-safety employees to buy eligible prior hazardous-duty service. This expands retirement-benefit access.

title: Public schools, require a child successfully complete kindergarten before being admitted to the first grade, Sec. 16-28-4 am'd.
description: Public schools, require a child successfully complete kindergarten before being admitted to the first grade, Sec. 16-28-4 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires successful kindergarten completion before first-grade admission. This expands compulsory early-education requirements.

title: Crimes and offenses, to revise the criminal penalties for violations of fleeing or attempting to elude law enforcement, Sec. 13A-10-52 am'd.
description: Crimes and offenses, to revise the criminal penalties for violations of fleeing or attempting to elude law enforcement, Sec. 13A-10-52 am'd.
frontier_rationale: The introduced text adds Class C felony exposure when an officer has a warrant or reasonable suspicion for a felony and flight causes death or crosses state lines, and preserves felony treatment for injury or serious injury. It expands punitive fleeing-and-eluding liability based partly on police suspicion of another felony.

title: Alcoholic beverages, Hospitality Management Program license at certain state universities, activities under license authorized, license fee
description: Alcoholic beverages, Hospitality Management Program license at certain state universities, activities under license authorized, license fee
frontier_rationale: Creates an alcohol license for university hospitality-management programs. This is vocational and alcohol-business licensing, not healthcare.

title: Schools, public K-12, State Board of Education required to phase in the employment of auxiliary teachers to assist classroom teachers
description: Schools, public K-12, State Board of Education required to phase in the employment of auxiliary teachers to assist classroom teachers
frontier_rationale: Requires phased employment of auxiliary classroom teachers. This expands public-school staffing and instructional support.

title: Economic development, counties and municipalities, requirements revised for incurring indebtedness and for selling or granting public property for private economic development and for certain public notices, Amendment 772, Constitution of Alabama of 1901, am'd., const. amend.
description: Economic development, counties and municipalities, requirements revised for incurring indebtedness and for selling or granting public property for private economic development and for certain public notices, Amendment 772, Constitution of Alabama of 1901, am'd., const. amend.
frontier_rationale: The constitutional amendment broadens and clarifies county and municipal authority to fund, convey property to, and incur obligations for private economic development; treats non-general-obligation instruments outside ordinary borrowing limits; allows notice in any circulating newspaper rather than the largest; and validates prior agreements not already challenged. It expands industrial-policy flexibility while weakening debt and notice safeguards.
