description: Relating to public contracts; to prohibit governmental entities from entering into certain contracts with companies that boycott businesses because the business engages in certain sectors or does not meet certain environmental or corporate governance standards or does not facilitate certain activities; to provide that no company in the state shall be required by a governmental entity, nor penalized by a governmental entity for declining to engage in economic boycotts or other actions that further social, political, or ideological interests; to require the Attorney General to take actions to prevent federal laws or actions from penalizing, inflicting harm on, limiting commercial relations with, or changing or limiting the activities of companies or residents of the state based on the furtherance of economic boycott criteria; and to authorize the Attorney General to investigate and enforce this act; and to provide definitions.
frontier_rationale: Bars government contracting decisions and penalties based on specified environmental, social, or ideological boycotts and directs resistance to federal action. It is a direct anti-ESG measure favoring protected industries and limiting values-based public procurement.

title: Relating to environmental covenants; to amend Section 35-19-2, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that work regarding aboveground storage tanks registered for eligibility under the Alabama Underground and Aboveground Storage Tank Trust Fund does not constitute an environmental response project for environmental covenant purposes.
description: Relating to environmental covenants; to amend Section 35-19-2, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that work regarding aboveground storage tanks registered for eligibility under the Alabama Underground and Aboveground Storage Tank Trust Fund does not constitute an environmental response project for environmental covenant purposes.
frontier_rationale: Excludes qualifying aboveground-tank work from environmental-response-project status. This narrows environmental covenant application.

title: Relating to Macon County; to amend Section 45-44-90 of the Code of Alabama 1975, establishing the Macon County Economic Development Authority, to further provide for the operation of the authority; and to authorize the formation of a successor authority under certain conditions.
description: Relating to Macon County; to amend Section 45-44-90 of the Code of Alabama 1975, establishing the Macon County Economic Development Authority, to further provide for the operation of the authority; and to authorize the formation of a successor authority under certain conditions.
frontier_rationale: Revises Macon County's development authority and permits a successor authority. This is local governance.

title: Relating to political action committees; to amend Section 17-5-15, Code of Alabama 1975, to permit PACs to make contributions to political parties in certain circumstances.
description: Relating to political action committees; to amend Section 17-5-15, Code of Alabama 1975, to permit PACs to make contributions to political parties in certain circumstances.
frontier_rationale: Permits PAC contributions to political parties in specified circumstances. This relaxes an existing campaign-finance transfer restriction.

title: Relating to motor vehicles; to add Section 32-5A-350.1 to the Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for the prohibition against using a wireless telecommunications device while operating a motor vehicle; to further provide for the prohibition; to further provide exceptions; to further provide criminal penalties for a violation; to provide a warning period for a violation; to amend Section 32-5A-351, Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for the assessment of administrative penalties; to repeal Section 32-5A-350, Code of Alabama 1975; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to motor vehicles; to add Section 32-5A-350.1 to the Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for the prohibition against using a wireless telecommunications device while operating a motor vehicle; to further provide for the prohibition; to further provide exceptions; to further provide criminal penalties for a violation; to provide a warning period for a violation; to amend Section 32-5A-351, Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for the assessment of administrative penalties; to repeal Section 32-5A-350, Code of Alabama 1975; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: Strengthens handheld-device restrictions, exceptions, administrative and criminal penalties, and a warning period. This is traffic-safety regulation.

title: Relating to the Employees' Retirement System; to amend Section 36-27-8.2, Code of Alabama 1975, as last amended by Act 2023-334 of the 2023 Regular Session, to temporarily permit certain retired state police officers performing duties as school resource officers or as correctional officers to serve without suspension of their retirement allowance.
description: Relating to the Employees' Retirement System; to amend Section 36-27-8.2, Code of Alabama 1975, as last amended by Act 2023-334 of the 2023 Regular Session, to temporarily permit certain retired state police officers performing duties as school resource officers or as correctional officers to serve without suspension of their retirement allowance.
frontier_rationale: Temporarily lets retired state police serve in school-resource or correctional roles without pension suspension. This expands staffing flexibility and retiree compensation.

title: Relating to boards of registrars; to amend Sections 17-3-2 and 17-3-5, Code of Alabama 1975, to increase the salary of each board of registrar; to provide that a county may allow any member of the county board of registrars to participate in any health insurance program provided by the county; to further provide for the employment status of members of the boards of registrars and for regular hours of operation for the boards of registrars; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style.
description: Relating to boards of registrars; to amend Sections 17-3-2 and 17-3-5, Code of Alabama 1975, to increase the salary of each board of registrar; to provide that a county may allow any member of the county board of registrars to participate in any health insurance program provided by the county; to further provide for the employment status of members of the boards of registrars and for regular hours of operation for the boards of registrars; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style.
frontier_rationale: Raises registrar salaries, permits county health coverage, clarifies employment, and regularizes hours. This expands compensation and election-administration capacity.

title: Relating to the Board of Pardons and Paroles; to amend Section 15-22-30.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to require that at least one residential transition center established by the board to be a women's facility.
description: Relating to the Board of Pardons and Paroles; to amend Section 15-22-30.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to require that at least one residential transition center established by the board to be a women's facility.
frontier_rationale: Requires at least one residential transition center for women. This expands gender-specific reentry infrastructure.

title: Relating to public K-12 schools; to add Section 16-39-13 to the Code of Alabama 1975; to require local boards of education to install, maintain, and operate video cameras in certain self-contained classrooms providing special education services, if the funding to do so is available; and to provide protections for the use of video recordings.
description: Relating to public K-12 schools; to add Section 16-39-13 to the Code of Alabama 1975; to require local boards of education to install, maintain, and operate video cameras in certain self-contained classrooms providing special education services, if the funding to do so is available; and to provide protections for the use of video recordings.
frontier_rationale: Requires cameras in certain self-contained special-education classrooms when funded and protects recordings. It expands safeguarding and oversight while implicating privacy protections.

title: Relating to the Board of Nursing; to add a new Article 8 to Title 34, Chapter 21, Code of Alabama 1975, to create the Alabama Loan Repayment Program for Nursing Education; to establish and describe the program; to provide for program funding from the Education Trust Fund; to provide definitions; to outline the procedure for the board to award loans to applicants who contract with the board to work as an instructor in a prelicense nursing education program; and to provide further for the powers of the board under the program.
description: Relating to the Board of Nursing; to add a new Article 8 to Title 34, Chapter 21, Code of Alabama 1975, to create the Alabama Loan Repayment Program for Nursing Education; to establish and describe the program; to provide for program funding from the Education Trust Fund; to provide definitions; to outline the procedure for the board to award loans to applicants who contract with the board to work as an instructor in a prelicense nursing education program; and to provide further for the powers of the board under the program.
frontier_rationale: Creates publicly funded loan repayment for nursing instructors who accept service obligations. It expands professional education capacity and workforce support.

title: Relating to motor vehicles; to prohibit certain motor vehicle speed contests, motor vehicle exhibitions of speed, and motor vehicle sideshows; to provide criminal penalties for a violation; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to motor vehicles; to prohibit certain motor vehicle speed contests, motor vehicle exhibitions of speed, and motor vehicle sideshows; to provide criminal penalties for a violation; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes motor-vehicle speed contests, exhibitions, and sideshows. This expands traffic-safety enforcement.

title: Relating to disclosure of certain personal information; to prohibit public agencies from collecting, disclosing, or releasing certain personal information about members of, volunteers for, and financial and nonfinancial donors to nonprofit organizations, except as required by law; and to provide civil and criminal penalties for violation of these prohibitions; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to disclosure of certain personal information; to prohibit public agencies from collecting, disclosing, or releasing certain personal information about members of, volunteers for, and financial and nonfinancial donors to nonprofit organizations, except as required by law; and to provide civil and criminal penalties for violation of these prohibitions; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: Bars public agencies from collecting or disclosing nonprofit member and donor information and penalizes violations. It expands associational privacy while reducing government access and transparency.

title: Relating to the Retirement Systems of Alabama; to amend Section 36-27-59, Code of Alabama 1975, to remove the time limit for purchasing hazardous duty time for prior eligible service for certain firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers covered under the Employees' Retirement System or the Teachers' Retirement System as Tier I plan members.
description: Relating to the Retirement Systems of Alabama; to amend Section 36-27-59, Code of Alabama 1975, to remove the time limit for purchasing hazardous duty time for prior eligible service for certain firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers covered under the Employees' Retirement System or the Teachers' Retirement System as Tier I plan members.
frontier_rationale: Removes the deadline for Tier I public-safety employees to buy prior hazardous-duty service credit. This expands pension access.

title: Relating to the Alabama Forestry Commission; to establish the Rural Logging Efficiency Act of 2023; to create the Logging Efficiency Grant Fund to be administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; and to provide for the distribution of funding to the Alabama Forestry Commission to support rural economic development.
description: Relating to the Alabama Forestry Commission; to establish the Rural Logging Efficiency Act of 2023; to create the Logging Efficiency Grant Fund to be administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; and to provide for the distribution of funding to the Alabama Forestry Commission to support rural economic development.
frontier_rationale: Creates a publicly administered logging-efficiency grant fund for rural development. This is targeted rural industrial subsidy policy.

title: FY24 Education Trust Fund - Governor's Rec.
description: FY24 Education Trust Fund - Governor's Rec.
frontier_rationale: Contains the Governor's recommended Education Trust Fund budget. An omnibus appropriations bill cannot be assigned one ideological direction without line-item and baseline comparisons.

title: Relating to the Alabama Medical Liability Act of 1996; to amend Section 6-5-549.1 of the Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that the term "health care provider" as used in that act and the Alabama Medical Liability Act of 1987 would include emergency medical services personnel and any emergency medical provider service.
description: Relating to the Alabama Medical Liability Act of 1996; to amend Section 6-5-549.1 of the Code of Alabama 1975, to provide that the term "health care provider" as used in that act and the Alabama Medical Liability Act of 1987 would include emergency medical services personnel and any emergency medical provider service.
frontier_rationale: Extends Medical Liability Act provider status to EMS personnel and services. This broadens liability protection for emergency providers.

title: Sex-based terms, defined;  vital statistics, report sex as male or female at birth required, legislative policy regarding sex and gender identity established
description: Sex-based terms, defined;  vital statistics, report sex as male or female at birth required, legislative policy regarding sex and gender identity established
frontier_rationale: Defines sex as male or female for vital statistics and establishes state policy concerning sex and gender identity. This is a direct traditionalist sex-and-gender measure, not an unscorable LGBTQ reference.

title: Public K-12 education, creates uniform process for suspension and expulsion of public school students,  requires disciplinary hearing following long-term suspension or expulsion, St. Bd. of Ed. required to adopt rules
description: Public K-12 education, creates uniform process for suspension and expulsion of public school students,  requires disciplinary hearing following long-term suspension or expulsion, St. Bd. of Ed. required to adopt rules
frontier_rationale: Creates a uniform suspension and expulsion process and requires hearings after long-term exclusion. This expands student disciplinary due process.

title: Lauderdale County, further provides for pistol permit fees
description: Lauderdale County, further provides for pistol permit fees
frontier_rationale: The enrolled local act sets Lauderdale permit fees at $10 annually, $50 for five years, $300 lifetime, or $150 lifetime for applicants 60 and older; exempts specified military and law-enforcement applicants; and dedicates proceeds to an audited sheriff fund. Comparison with the repealed 1969 rate is unavailable, but the resulting cost structure is explicit.

title: Prisoners, increases the money paid by the state to counties to feed prisoners and the money deposited into the Emergency Prisoner Feeding Fund
description: Prisoners, increases the money paid by the state to counties to feed prisoners and the money deposited into the Emergency Prisoner Feeding Fund
frontier_rationale: Raises state payments to counties for prisoner food and the emergency feeding fund. This expands basic jail subsistence funding.

title: Sentencing, habitual felony offenders sentencing further provided for; resentence in certain circumstances
description: Sentencing, habitual felony offenders sentencing further provided for; resentence in certain circumstances
frontier_rationale: Creates or expands resentencing for people sentenced under habitual-offender law. This reduces sentence severity for eligible cases.

title: Public and nonpublic schools, sudden cardiac arrest, required to develop and implement cardiac emergency response plan
description: Public and nonpublic schools, sudden cardiac arrest, required to develop and implement cardiac emergency response plan
frontier_rationale: Requires public and nonpublic schools to develop cardiac emergency-response plans. This expands institutional health and safety mandates.

title: Public K-12 schools; nonpublic school transfer students excluded from certain assessments determining school or school district grade.
description: Public K-12 schools; nonpublic school transfer students excluded from certain assessments determining school or school district grade.
frontier_rationale: Excludes nonpublic-school transfer students from specified school-grade assessments. This changes accountability attribution rather than expanding school choice itself.

title: Crimes and offenses; operation of unmanned aircraft system over or near a Department of Corrections facility; penalties provided; exceptions provided
description: Crimes and offenses; operation of unmanned aircraft system over or near a Department of Corrections facility; penalties provided; exceptions provided
frontier_rationale: Restricts drone operation near correctional facilities with exceptions and penalties. This expands institutional security regulation.

title: Lawrence County, establishing a work release and community corrections program
description: Lawrence County, establishing a work release and community corrections program
frontier_rationale: Establishes a Lawrence County work-release and community-corrections program. This expands structured alternatives and reentry employment.

title: Cleburne County, further provides for service of process, jail telephone system, and pistol permit fees
description: Cleburne County, further provides for service of process, jail telephone system, and pistol permit fees
frontier_rationale: Combines Cleburne County service of process, jail telephone, and permit-fee provisions. The synopsis gives no component details and cannot support a firearm ideology score.

title: RSA, full-time emergency medical services technicians and paramedics  allowed to purchase hazardous duty time for prior eligible service the ERS in same manner as firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers, Tier I
description: RSA, full-time emergency medical services technicians and paramedics  allowed to purchase hazardous duty time for prior eligible service the ERS in same manner as firefighters, law enforcement officers, and correctional officers, Tier I
frontier_rationale: Allows full-time emergency medical personnel to purchase hazardous-duty retirement credit. This expands public-employee pension benefits.

title: Child labor, increasing civil and criminal penalties for employers who violate child labor laws
description: Child labor, increasing civil and criminal penalties for employers who violate child labor laws
frontier_rationale: Increases civil and criminal penalties on employers violating child-labor laws. This strengthens worker and child protection.

title: Prisoners, increases the money paid by the state to counties to feed prisoners and the money deposited into the Emergency Prisoner Feeding Fund
description: Prisoners, increases the money paid by the state to counties to feed prisoners and the money deposited into the Emergency Prisoner Feeding Fund
frontier_rationale: Raises state payments to counties for prisoner food and emergency feeding. This expands basic jail subsistence funding.

title: Public education employees; exclusion of students from classroom, provided for; principal authorized to suspend, expel, or recommend for alternative school certain students excluded from classroom; civil and criminal immunity provided to education employees; local boards of education authorized to reimburse or compensate employees for certain legal fees; rebuttable presumption, created; Board of Education, required to adopt rules
description: Public education employees; exclusion of students from classroom, provided for; principal authorized to suspend, expel, or recommend for alternative school certain students excluded from classroom; civil and criminal immunity provided to education employees; local boards of education authorized to reimburse or compensate employees for certain legal fees; rebuttable presumption, created; Board of Education, required to adopt rules
frontier_rationale: Strengthens exclusion, suspension, expulsion, alternative-school authority, immunity, fee reimbursement, and evidentiary presumptions for educators. This is a punitive discipline and employee-protection measure.

title: Prohibit the use of any ranked-choice voting method in elections except for electors who vote by absentee ballot pursuant to the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act
description: Prohibit the use of any ranked-choice voting method in elections except for electors who vote by absentee ballot pursuant to the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act
frontier_rationale: Prohibits ranked-choice voting except where necessary for military and overseas absentee ballots. This directly restricts alternative electoral systems while preserving the federal-access exception.

title: Public school teacher salary schedule, experience credit provided to certain certified teachers for experience as paraprofessional or teacher's aide
description: Public school teacher salary schedule, experience credit provided to certain certified teachers for experience as paraprofessional or teacher's aide
frontier_rationale: Credits certified teachers' prior paraprofessional or aide service on the salary schedule. This expands recognized experience and public-employee compensation.

title: Alabama Farm Center created, vested with powers and privileges, deemed economic development organization
description: Alabama Farm Center created, vested with powers and privileges, deemed economic development organization
frontier_rationale: Creates the Alabama Farm Center as an economic-development organization with public powers. This advances institutionally supported agricultural development.

title: Labor organizations, employer's eligibility for economic development incentives conditioned upon employer refraining from certain practices relating to labor organizations, oversight provided
description: Labor organizations, employer's eligibility for economic development incentives conditioned upon employer refraining from certain practices relating to labor organizations, oversight provided
frontier_rationale: The enrolled act denies and claws back state or local development incentives when an employer voluntarily recognizes a union solely through signed authorization cards instead of an available NLRB secret ballot or voluntarily shares employee contact information without written consent. It uses public subsidies to discourage card-check recognition and materially restrict union-organizing agreements, framed as ballot and privacy protection.

title: Economic development; state law authorizing counties and municipalities to provide for innovation districts as public corporations authorized; innovation district use of public funds for public or private persons authorized; Constitutional Amendment
description: Economic development; state law authorizing counties and municipalities to provide for innovation districts as public corporations authorized; innovation district use of public funds for public or private persons authorized; Constitutional Amendment
frontier_rationale: Authorizes public innovation-district corporations and use of public funds for public or private beneficiaries through constitutional amendment. This expands place-based development authority and subsidy powers.

title: Corrections Department; rename Investigation and Intelligence Division; add correctional canine classifications to state law enforcement
description: Corrections Department; rename Investigation and Intelligence Division; add correctional canine classifications to state law enforcement
frontier_rationale: Renames Corrections' investigative division and adds correctional canine classifications to state law enforcement. This formalizes and modestly expands correctional enforcement capacity.

title: Counties, agriculture authorities, authorized to establish and promote agriculture businesses, economic development, and other purposes, power further specified to develop commercial facilities and use revenue for authority's mission
description: Counties, agriculture authorities, authorized to establish and promote agriculture businesses, economic development, and other purposes, power further specified to develop commercial facilities and use revenue for authority's mission
frontier_rationale: Expands county agricultural authorities' commercial-development powers and revenue uses. This advances publicly supported agricultural business development.

title: Houston County, Houston County Health Care Authority, board members to be appointed by county commission
description: Houston County, Houston County Health Care Authority, board members to be appointed by county commission
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Houston County appointments to its healthcare-authority board. This is local governance.

title: Off-label medical treatment; adverse action by occupational licensing board because of recommendation, prohibited; patient informed consent, required; cause of action, provided
description: Off-label medical treatment; adverse action by occupational licensing board because of recommendation, prohibited; patient informed consent, required; cause of action, provided
frontier_rationale: Protects clinicians from licensing retaliation for recommending off-label treatment while requiring informed consent and creating a cause of action. It expands treatment autonomy with patient safeguards.

title: Occupational Licensing Boards, consideration of criminal conviction when licensing restricted
description: Occupational Licensing Boards, consideration of criminal conviction when licensing restricted
frontier_rationale: Restricts licensing boards' use of criminal convictions. This expands occupational access and reintegration for people with records.

title: State waters; persons commercially cutting aquatic plants required to remove cut plants, criminal penalties established
description: State waters; persons commercially cutting aquatic plants required to remove cut plants, criminal penalties established
frontier_rationale: Requires commercial aquatic-plant cutters to remove cut vegetation and penalizes violations. This is environmental and water-use regulation.

title: Firearms; firearm hold agreements defined; civil immunity therefrom provided
description: Firearms; firearm hold agreements defined; civil immunity therefrom provided
frontier_rationale: Defines voluntary firearm-hold agreements and provides civil immunity, facilitating temporary third-party storage. This supports voluntary gun-safety arrangements without mandating surrender.

title: Pardons and paroles, sharing of electronic monitoring data in certain circumstances authorized
description: Pardons and paroles, sharing of electronic monitoring data in certain circumstances authorized
frontier_rationale: Authorizes sharing electronic-monitoring data in specified circumstances. This expands criminal-justice surveillance and interagency information access.

title: Crimes and offenses; making a terrorist threat in the second degree, elements revised, criminal penalties further provided for
description: Crimes and offenses; making a terrorist threat in the second degree, elements revised, criminal penalties further provided for
frontier_rationale: Removes the existing credible-threat and immediate-prospect elements from second-degree terrorist threat and makes a second or subsequent conviction a Class D felony rather than retaining misdemeanor treatment. This is a public-order expansion with a countervailing speech and due-process cost.

title: Convicted felons; restrictions on obtaining occupational licenses by convicted felons revised; certificate of employability for convicted felons created; immunity to employers provided
description: Convicted felons; restrictions on obtaining occupational licenses by convicted felons revised; certificate of employability for convicted felons created; immunity to employers provided
frontier_rationale: Revises licensing restrictions for people with felony convictions, creates employability certificates, and protects employers. This expands reentry and labor-market access.

title: Alabama Department of Environmental Management; water well drillers, licenses and licensees, fees therefore, revised and further provides for; continuing education required
description: Alabama Department of Environmental Management; water well drillers, licenses and licensees, fees therefore, revised and further provides for; continuing education required
frontier_rationale: Revises driller licenses and fees and requires continuing education. This expands professional environmental regulation.

title: Public schools; athletic associations required to adjust athletic classification under certain circumstances
description: Public schools; athletic associations required to adjust athletic classification under certain circumstances
frontier_rationale: Requires public-school athletic classifications to discount English-language-learner students who do not participate in athletics and adds legislative nonvoting representation, including a House minority-party member, to the association's governing structure. The measure addresses competitive classification and oversight rather than imposing an immigration restriction.

title: Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Board; required to renegotiate contracts for Medicare retiree health benefit plans every five years
description: Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Board; required to renegotiate contracts for Medicare retiree health benefit plans every five years
frontier_rationale: Requires PEEHIP to renegotiate Medicare retiree-plan contracts every five years. This expands periodic purchasing accountability.

title: Hospitals, private hospital assessment and Medicaid funding program extended for fiscal year 2028
description: Hospitals, private hospital assessment and Medicaid funding program extended for fiscal year 2028
frontier_rationale: Extends hospital assessments and Medicaid funding through fiscal 2028. This maintains public coverage finance.

title: Fair Campaign Practices Act; prohibit campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals
description: Fair Campaign Practices Act; prohibit campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals
frontier_rationale: Prohibits campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals. This is a campaign-integrity restriction on foreign participation, not a general voting-access measure.

title: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
description: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
frontier_rationale: Adds a five-year Jefferson County pistol permit at $37.50 alongside the existing $7.50 annual permit, preserving the annualized cost and existing revenue allocations. This is a local administrative convenience rather than a meaningful statewide gun-access direction.

title: Crimes and offenses; human cloning prohibited, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses; human cloning prohibited, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Prohibits human cloning and creates criminal penalties. This is restrictive bioethics policy enforced through criminal law.

title: Economic development, references to outdated economic development plan and North American Industry Classification System Codes updated
description: Economic development, references to outdated economic development plan and North American Industry Classification System Codes updated
frontier_rationale: Updates references to an obsolete development plan and industry-classification codes. This is technical maintenance.

title: Colbert County, pistol permit fees further provided for
description: Colbert County, pistol permit fees further provided for
frontier_rationale: Adds proportional five-year permit options of $75 for applicants under 60 and $25 for applicants 60 or older while retaining the corresponding $15 and $5 annual rates and existing revenue allocation. The change is local permit administration, not a directional gun-policy shift.

title: Washington County; sheriff, authorized to sell or destroy certain abandoned, stolen, or unclaimed firearms
description: Washington County; sheriff, authorized to sell or destroy certain abandoned, stolen, or unclaimed firearms
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Washington County's sheriff to sell or destroy recovered firearms. This is local asset disposition.

title: Pike County, pistol permit fee further provided for
description: Pike County, pistol permit fee further provided for
frontier_rationale: Adds a $100 five-year Pike County pistol permit alongside the $20 annual permit, preserving the annualized fee. The marked-up text revises local allocation language but does not establish a meaningful directional change in firearm access; the exact distribution comparison remains textually ambiguous.

title: Board of Pardons and Paroles; probation and parole officers specified as state law enforcement officers
description: Board of Pardons and Paroles; probation and parole officers specified as state law enforcement officers
frontier_rationale: Designates probation and parole officers as state law-enforcement officers. This expands or formalizes enforcement status and associated authority.

title: Pardons and paroles, sharing of electronic monitoring data in certain circumstances authorized
description: Pardons and paroles, sharing of electronic monitoring data in certain circumstances authorized
frontier_rationale: Authorizes sharing electronic-monitoring data in specified circumstances. This expands criminal-justice surveillance and interagency information access.

title: Convicted felons; restrictions on obtaining occupational licenses by convicted felons revised; certificate of employability for convicted felons created; immunity to employers provided
description: Convicted felons; restrictions on obtaining occupational licenses by convicted felons revised; certificate of employability for convicted felons created; immunity to employers provided
frontier_rationale: Revises licensing restrictions for people with felony convictions, creates employability certificates, and protects employers. This expands reentry employment access.

title: Restoration of Voting Rights; notification to convicted individuals seeking restoration; Pardons and Paroles Board required to notify individuals and Secretary of State when voting rights restored
description: Restoration of Voting Rights; notification to convicted individuals seeking restoration; Pardons and Paroles Board required to notify individuals and Secretary of State when voting rights restored
frontier_rationale: Requires notice to applicants and the Secretary of State when rights are restored. This makes reenfranchisement more transparent and administratively effective.

title: Sentencing; habitual felony offender act, resentencing procedures, established
description: Sentencing; habitual felony offender act, resentencing procedures, established
frontier_rationale: Establishes resentencing procedures under the habitual-felony-offender law. This creates a decarcerative review pathway.

title: Navigable and non-navigable waters; operating motor vehicles on submerged lands prohibited, subject to exceptions; criminal penalties provided
description: Navigable and non-navigable waters; operating motor vehicles on submerged lands prohibited, subject to exceptions; criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Prohibits motor-vehicle operation on submerged lands with exceptions and penalties. This is waterway and habitat-use regulation.

title: Health care policies; eliminate cost-sharing for prostate screening coverage of high risk men
description: Health care policies; eliminate cost-sharing for prostate screening coverage of high risk men
frontier_rationale: Eliminates cost sharing for prostate screening among high-risk men. This expands preventive-care affordability.

title: Clay County; authorize sheriff to dispose of certain abandoned, stolen or unclaimed property and firearms
description: Clay County; authorize sheriff to dispose of certain abandoned, stolen or unclaimed property and firearms
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Clay County's sheriff to dispose of recovered firearms and property. This is local asset administration.

title: Powering Growth Act established, Alabama Energy Infrastructure Bank and the Strategic Energy Procurement Fund established under the State Industrial Development Authority to assist in obtaining equipment and providing financing for qualified energy infrastructure projects
description: Powering Growth Act established, Alabama Energy Infrastructure Bank and the Strategic Energy Procurement Fund established under the State Industrial Development Authority to assist in obtaining equipment and providing financing for qualified energy infrastructure projects
frontier_rationale: Creates a state energy-infrastructure bank and procurement fund to finance qualified projects. This is active public industrial and energy-development policy.

title: Alabama Drycleaning Response Trust Fund Board, requirement that the Alabama Department of Environmental Management prevent involvement of other units of government in contamination problems deleted; required minimum balance in Alabama Drycleaning Environmental Response Trust Fund reduced from one million to two hundred fifty thousand dollars
description: Alabama Drycleaning Response Trust Fund Board, requirement that the Alabama Department of Environmental Management prevent involvement of other units of government in contamination problems deleted; required minimum balance in Alabama Drycleaning Environmental Response Trust Fund reduced from one million to two hundred fifty thousand dollars
frontier_rationale: Allows involvement by other government units in contamination matters while sharply reducing the cleanup fund's required reserve. Oversight expands but fiscal buffering contracts.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board; increase members on board; further provide for selection of chair; parole consideration guidelines after denial of parole established
description: Pardons and Paroles Board; increase members on board; further provide for selection of chair; parole consideration guidelines after denial of parole established
frontier_rationale: Expands parole-board membership and establishes consideration guidelines after denial. This strengthens process structure but does not itself establish a more lenient release standard.

title: School safety, permits sheriffs and chiefs of police to contract with nonpublic schools to provide school resource officers
description: School safety, permits sheriffs and chiefs of police to contract with nonpublic schools to provide school resource officers
frontier_rationale: Allows sheriffs and police chiefs to contract with nonpublic schools for resource officers. It expands school-security services through public-private contracting.

title: Firearms; firearm hold agreements defined; civil immunity therefrom provided
description: Firearms; firearm hold agreements defined; civil immunity therefrom provided
frontier_rationale: Defines voluntary firearm-hold agreements and provides civil immunity, facilitating temporary third-party storage without mandatory surrender.

title: Health care providers; prohibit enforcement of contractual terms that restrict sharing cost information to patients and consumers
description: Health care providers; prohibit enforcement of contractual terms that restrict sharing cost information to patients and consumers
frontier_rationale: Voids contractual restrictions on sharing cost information with patients. This expands healthcare price transparency.

title: Class 2 municipalities, scrap tires, enforcement of Scrap Tire Environmental Quality Act, jurisdiction of municipality court, criminal penalties
description: Class 2 municipalities, scrap tires, enforcement of Scrap Tire Environmental Quality Act, jurisdiction of municipality court, criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Expands Class 2 municipal enforcement and court jurisdiction under scrap-tire environmental law. This is local environmental enforcement.

title: Alabama Corrections Institutions Finance Authority, maximum bonding authority increased
description: Alabama Corrections Institutions Finance Authority, maximum bonding authority increased
frontier_rationale: Raises the correctional finance authority's bonding limit. This expands capacity to finance prisons through public debt.

title: State waters; persons commercially cutting aquatic plants required to remove cut plants, criminal penalties established
description: State waters; persons commercially cutting aquatic plants required to remove cut plants, criminal penalties established
frontier_rationale: Requires commercial aquatic-plant cutters to remove cut vegetation and creates penalties. This is environmental regulation.

title: Criminal procedure; warrants served on inmates in Department of Corrections
description: Criminal procedure; warrants served on inmates in Department of Corrections
frontier_rationale: Provides procedures for serving warrants on people already in Corrections custody. This is criminal-process administration.

title: Motor vehicle registration; military combat action license plate, criminal penalty for falsely obtaining, established
description: Motor vehicle registration; military combat action license plate, criminal penalty for falsely obtaining, established
frontier_rationale: Creates a penalty for falsely obtaining a military combat-action license plate. This protects a symbolic veteran benefit through narrow fraud enforcement.

title: Crimes and offenses; human cloning prohibited, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses; human cloning prohibited, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Prohibits human cloning and creates criminal penalties. This is restrictive bioethics policy.

title: Crimes and offenses; making a terrorist threat in the second degree, elements revised, criminal penalties further provided for
description: Crimes and offenses; making a terrorist threat in the second degree, elements revised, criminal penalties further provided for
frontier_rationale: Removes the existing credible-threat and immediate-prospect elements from second-degree terrorist threat and makes a second or subsequent conviction a Class D felony. This broadens public-order enforcement while reducing speech-related limiting elements.

title: Fair Campaign Practices Act; prohibit campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals
description: Fair Campaign Practices Act; prohibit campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals
frontier_rationale: Prohibits campaign contributions and expenditures from foreign nationals. This is a campaign-integrity restriction on foreign participation.

title: Children's Health Insurance Fund, distributions further provided
description: Children's Health Insurance Fund, distributions further provided
frontier_rationale: Makes funding sufficient for the Children's Health Insurance Program an annual first charge against specified General Fund sales-and-use-tax allocations. This protects and prioritizes public children's health coverage rather than merely making an administrative transfer.

title: Rural Hospital Investment Program amended; to require the Department of Revenue to oversee the operations
description: Rural Hospital Investment Program amended; to require the Department of Revenue to oversee the operations
frontier_rationale: Places Rural Hospital Investment Program operations under Revenue Department oversight. This expands program accountability rather than necessarily funding.

title: Alabama Business and Nonprofit Entities Code; revisions made to clarify procedures, make technical corrections, and codify common law
description: Alabama Business and Nonprofit Entities Code; revisions made to clarify procedures, make technical corrections, and codify common law
frontier_rationale: Clarifies procedures, makes technical corrections, and codifies common law for business entities. This is legal maintenance.

title: Crimes and offenses; crime of reckless endangerment expanded, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses; crime of reckless endangerment expanded, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Expands the crime of reckless endangerment and associated penalties. This broadens punitive liability.

title: Department of Corrections; mitigation of unmanned aircraft systems authorized, exemptions on prohibition further provided for
description: Department of Corrections; mitigation of unmanned aircraft systems authorized, exemptions on prohibition further provided for
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Corrections to mitigate unmanned aircraft and revises exemptions. This expands institutional counter-drone enforcement authority.

title: Board of Pardons and Paroles; commencement date changed to March 1
description: Board of Pardons and Paroles; commencement date changed to March 1
frontier_rationale: Changes a parole-board commencement date. This is implementation timing without substantive release direction.

title: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
description: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
frontier_rationale: Adds a five-year Jefferson County pistol permit at $37.50 alongside the existing $7.50 annual permit and preserves proportional revenue distribution. This is local administrative convenience, not a meaningful firearm-access direction.

title: 2nd Amendment Sales Tax Holiday created; to exempt certain items from sales tax during the last weekend of August
description: 2nd Amendment Sales Tax Holiday created; to exempt certain items from sales tax during the last weekend of August
frontier_rationale: Creates a sales-tax holiday for Second Amendment-related items. This subsidizes firearm or related purchases and expands practical gun access.

title: Crimes; crime of disruption of a worship service, established; criminal penalty, provided
description: Crimes; crime of disruption of a worship service, established; criminal penalty, provided
frontier_rationale: Creates a crime for disrupting worship services. It protects religious exercise while criminally restricting disruptive expressive conduct.

title: Elmore County; pistol permit fee, revised
description: Elmore County; pistol permit fee, revised
frontier_rationale: Recasts Elmore County's existing $20 additional pistol-permit fee as the issuance fee while preserving the amount and its $1 county and $19 sheriff allocation. The operative economic burden is unchanged and local.

title: Cleburne County; Cleburne County Economic Development Authority, established
description: Cleburne County; Cleburne County Economic Development Authority, established
frontier_rationale: Creates the Cleburne County Economic Development Authority. This is local institutional governance.

title: Crimes and offenses; discharging a firearm into an occupied school bus or building, penalty increased
description: Crimes and offenses; discharging a firearm into an occupied school bus or building, penalty increased
frontier_rationale: Increases penalties for firing into an occupied school bus or building. This is a punitive violent-firearm offense measure, not a restriction on lawful ownership.

title: Campaign finance statements; redaction required of residential addresses of candidates and officials
description: Campaign finance statements; redaction required of residential addresses of candidates and officials
frontier_rationale: Requires redaction of candidates' and officials' residential addresses from campaign statements. This protects personal safety and privacy while narrowing disclosure detail.

title: Class 2 municipalities; industrial development boards, powers amended
description: Class 2 municipalities; industrial development boards, powers amended
frontier_rationale: Broadens Class 2 municipal industrial-development boards to finance and operate commercial, residential, parking, utility, and other projects through bonds, loans, grants, leases, and asset transactions, including workforce housing. This is an expansion of public industrial-policy and development-subsidy authority rather than general free-market deregulation.

title: Department of Commerce; Alabama Industrial Development Training Institute; exemptions from state procurement law and contract review, provided
description: Department of Commerce; Alabama Industrial Development Training Institute; exemptions from state procurement law and contract review, provided
frontier_rationale: Exempts the industrial-training institute from procurement law and contract review. It increases operating autonomy for workforce development while reducing ordinary contracting oversight.

title: Public health, authorized forms of single-dose epinephrine used by public schools and authorized entities expanded
description: Public health, authorized forms of single-dose epinephrine used by public schools and authorized entities expanded
frontier_rationale: Expands forms of single-dose epinephrine available to schools and other authorized entities. This broadens emergency allergy-treatment access.

title: Incarceration; to provide required time periods in the administration of the Lawrence County Community Corrections and Court Services Fund
description: Incarceration; to provide required time periods in the administration of the Lawrence County Community Corrections and Court Services Fund
frontier_rationale: Sets administrative time periods for the Lawrence County community-corrections fund. This is local program administration.

title: State Health Planning and Development Agency; Rural Health Antitrust Immunity Act created, collaboration among rural health care providers authorized; certification and supervision framework established, limited immunity from state and federal antitrust laws provided
description: State Health Planning and Development Agency; Rural Health Antitrust Immunity Act created, collaboration among rural health care providers authorized; certification and supervision framework established, limited immunity from state and federal antitrust laws provided
frontier_rationale: Creates supervised antitrust immunity for certified rural-provider collaboration. It expands rural coordination while limiting competition enforcement under state oversight.

title: Covington County; sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property and firearms, auction and disposition of funds provided, constitutional amendment
description: Covington County; sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property and firearms, auction and disposition of funds provided, constitutional amendment
frontier_rationale: Constitutionally authorizes Covington County's sheriff to auction recovered property and firearms and distribute proceeds. This is local asset administration.

title: Alabama Department of Environmental Management; water well drillers, license types and fees revised
description: Alabama Department of Environmental Management; water well drillers, license types and fees revised
frontier_rationale: Expands regulated well-related activities and license categories, establishes $1,000 unrestricted and $500 restricted biennial licenses plus a $500 business license, requires eight hours of continuing education, and authorizes residential well permit fees up to $250. This materially increases environmental and occupational regulation and regulated-party costs.

title: Parole; criteria for parole consideration revised
description: Parole; criteria for parole consideration revised
frontier_rationale: Requires the parole board to consider an inmate's prison employment and completed education while permitting consideration of low assessed recidivism risk. It adds rehabilitation-oriented factors without creating a right to release and retains written reasons for decisions.

title: Greene County; county racing commission, further provided; simulcast racing, pari-mutuel wagering, further provided
description: Greene County; county racing commission, further provided; simulcast racing, pari-mutuel wagering, further provided
frontier_rationale: Expands or revises Greene County racing, simulcast racing, and pari-mutuel wagering authority. This directly favors legalized gambling availability.

title: Hospitals, private hospital assessment and Medicaid funding program sunset clause removed.
description: Hospitals, private hospital assessment and Medicaid funding program sunset clause removed.
frontier_rationale: Removes the sunset from hospital assessments supporting Medicaid. This makes provider-financed public coverage funding permanent.

title: Campaign finance; require preservation of campaign records for specified period of time
description: Campaign finance; require preservation of campaign records for specified period of time
frontier_rationale: Requires campaign records to be preserved for a specified period. This strengthens auditability and enforcement.

title: Health insurance, safe harbor created
description: Health insurance, safe harbor created
frontier_rationale: Creates a safe harbor for HSA-qualified high-deductible plans so state benefit mandates and copay-accumulator requirements do not apply before the federal minimum deductible is met when needed to preserve federal HSA eligibility. This favors HSA plan design and limits state insurance mandates in the identified conflict.

title: Board of Pardons and Paroles; commencement date changed to March 1
description: Board of Pardons and Paroles; commencement date changed to March 1
frontier_rationale: Changes a parole-board commencement date. This is implementation timing.

title: Ethics, eliminate certain notification requirement for candidates to Ethics Commission when otherwise in compliance with law
description: Ethics, eliminate certain notification requirement for candidates to Ethics Commission when otherwise in compliance with law
frontier_rationale: Eliminates an Ethics Commission notice for candidates otherwise compliant with law. This appears to remove duplicative procedure rather than substantive disclosure.

title: Crimes and procedure; crimes of indecent exposure and other sex crimes further provided to include additional victims; crime of inpatient custodial sexual misconduct, established; domestic violence offenses, further provided to include additional victims and criminal penalties
description: Crimes and procedure; crimes of indecent exposure and other sex crimes further provided to include additional victims; crime of inpatient custodial sexual misconduct, established; domestic violence offenses, further provided to include additional victims and criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Broadens victims covered by sex and domestic-violence crimes and creates inpatient custodial sexual-misconduct offenses. This expands protection through punitive enforcement.

title: Campaign contributions; using contributions on certain security expenses to protect candidate, elected official, family members, and staff authorized
description: Campaign contributions; using contributions on certain security expenses to protect candidate, elected official, family members, and staff authorized
frontier_rationale: Allows campaign funds to pay specified security expenses for candidates, officials, relatives, and staff. This is a narrow personal-use exception motivated by safety rather than a broad campaign-finance ideology signal.

title: Restoration of Voting Rights; Pardons and Paroles Board required to post application for individuals seeking restoration; board required to notify individuals and Secretary of State when voting rights restored
description: Restoration of Voting Rights; Pardons and Paroles Board required to post application for individuals seeking restoration; board required to notify individuals and Secretary of State when voting rights restored
frontier_rationale: Requires publication of restoration applications and notice to individuals and election officials after restoration. This improves reenfranchisement access and implementation.

title: Parole, remote inmate participation at parole hearings, authorized, conditions established
description: Parole, remote inmate participation at parole hearings, authorized, conditions established
frontier_rationale: Authorizes incarcerated people to participate remotely in parole hearings under stated conditions. This expands meaningful hearing access.

title: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
description: Jefferson County, pistol permits further provided for
frontier_rationale: Adds a five-year Jefferson County pistol permit at $37.50 alongside the existing $7.50 annual permit and preserves proportional revenue distribution. This is the local administrative companion to HB335, not a directional firearm-access change.

title: Insurance; to allow reorganization of a nonprofit health care service corporation under the control of a nonprofit holding company
description: Insurance; to allow reorganization of a nonprofit health care service corporation under the control of a nonprofit holding company
frontier_rationale: Allows board-authorized nonprofit holding-company reorganization without ordinary acquisition or change-of-control approval and permits an initial transfer of up to 25 percent of admitted assets, subject to capital requirements and departmental notice. Later large transactions receive notice, comment, and commissioner-disapproval review. The measure expands corporate restructuring flexibility while weakening ex ante oversight.

title: Board of Pardons and Paroles; discretion whether to grant or deny parole, further provided; review of parole violations, procedure further provided to require consideration of totality of circumstances; penalties for certain parole-violations, increased
description: Board of Pardons and Paroles; discretion whether to grant or deny parole, further provided; review of parole violations, procedure further provided to require consideration of totality of circumstances; penalties for certain parole-violations, increased
frontier_rationale: Reaffirms grant-or-deny discretion, requires totality-of-circumstances review for violations, and increases some violation penalties. It combines individualized review with harsher sanctions.

title: Ground ambulance services; to prohibit balance billing and set minimum reimbursement rates by health care insurers to emergency medical service providers
description: Ground ambulance services; to prohibit balance billing and set minimum reimbursement rates by health care insurers to emergency medical service providers
frontier_rationale: Prohibits ground-ambulance balance billing and sets insurer reimbursement floors. This protects patients while regulating insurer-provider prices.

title: Growing Alabama Act amended to allow sites owned by more than one local economic development organization to qualify
description: Growing Alabama Act amended to allow sites owned by more than one local economic development organization to qualify
frontier_rationale: Allows jointly owned economic-development sites to qualify under the Growing Alabama Act. This broadens eligibility for targeted development subsidies.

title: Municipalities; business license for certain businesses in the building trade provided for
description: Municipalities; business license for certain businesses in the building trade provided for
frontier_rationale: Expressly authorizes municipalities to license listed construction and building trades and to calculate charges from gross receipts earned at local job sites, while barring taxation of receipts earned in other jurisdictions and exempting specified county projects. It combines expanded local taxing authority with territorial and intergovernmental limits.

title: Department of Commerce; Alabama Industrial Development Training Institute; references to applicable comprehensive statewide economic development strategic plan, revised; exemptions from state procurement law and contract review, provided
description: Department of Commerce; Alabama Industrial Development Training Institute; references to applicable comprehensive statewide economic development strategic plan, revised; exemptions from state procurement law and contract review, provided
frontier_rationale: Updates the industrial-training institute's strategic-plan references and exempts it from procurement and contract review. It increases operating autonomy while reducing oversight.

title: Class 2 municipalities; industrial development boards, powers amended
description: Class 2 municipalities; industrial development boards, powers amended
frontier_rationale: Broadens Class 2 municipal industrial-development boards to finance and operate commercial, residential, parking, utility, and other projects through bonds, loans, grants, leases, and asset transactions, including workforce housing. This is the Senate companion expansion of public industrial-policy authority.

title: Dogs; tethering and confinement requirements provided; persons and activities exempted; criminal penalties for, animal control officer enforcement of, violations established
description: Dogs; tethering and confinement requirements provided; persons and activities exempted; criminal penalties for, animal control officer enforcement of, violations established
frontier_rationale: Creates dog tethering and confinement standards, exemptions, enforcement, and penalties. This expands animal-welfare regulation.

title: Public Corruption; convicted public servant's retirement contributions forfeited to pay restitution; convicted public servant's compensation while on leave with pay forfeited
description: Public Corruption; convicted public servant's retirement contributions forfeited to pay restitution; convicted public servant's compensation while on leave with pay forfeited
frontier_rationale: Forfeits convicted officials' retirement contributions and paid-leave compensation to restitution. This strengthens corruption sanctions while imposing punitive loss of earned compensation.

title: Criminal procedure; Department of Corrections, outstanding warrant check procedures on inmates, provided; virtual hearings on inmates, required under certain conditions
description: Criminal procedure; Department of Corrections, outstanding warrant check procedures on inmates, provided; virtual hearings on inmates, required under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Requires outstanding-warrant checks and virtual hearings for people in Corrections custody. It combines enforcement administration with improved court access.

title: Health care plans; to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in determinations of coverage
description: Health care plans; to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in determinations of coverage
frontier_rationale: Regulates AI use in coverage determinations. This expands human accountability and patient process while restricting automated insurer discretion.

title: Incarceration; to require the Alabama Department of Public Health to adopt and enforce sanitation standards for food services in corrections facilities, county, and municipal jails
description: Incarceration; to require the Alabama Department of Public Health to adopt and enforce sanitation standards for food services in corrections facilities, county, and municipal jails
frontier_rationale: Requires public-health sanitation standards and enforcement for food service in prisons and jails. This expands basic health protection for incarcerated people.

title: Campaign contributions; contributions made with credit card with billing address outside U.S. prohibited, exceptions provided
description: Campaign contributions; contributions made with credit card with billing address outside U.S. prohibited, exceptions provided
frontier_rationale: Bars most card contributions with billing addresses outside the United States. It is an enforcement proxy against foreign campaign money, although it may also burden lawful overseas donors covered only by stated exceptions.

title: Ten Commandments; required to be displayed in certain public schools, subject to the availability of donations
description: Ten Commandments; required to be displayed in certain public schools, subject to the availability of donations
frontier_rationale: Requires Ten Commandments displays in specified public schools when privately donated. This is stronger than permissive accommodation and directly mandates a religious display.

title: Municipal elections, further provided for, statements of candidacy, provisional voting, absentee ballots, recount provisions, certain voter identification provisions not to apply, Sec. 17-9-30(f), Code of Alabama 1975, relating to voter identification, not to apply to municipal elections, Sec. 17-9-30 impliedly amended, Secs. 11-46-25, 11-46-27, 11-46-39, 11-46-44, 11-46-45, 11-46-46, 11-46-50, 11-46-55, 11-46-55.1, 11-46-57, 11-46-58, 11-46-67, 17-7-25, 17-11-14, 17-11-15 am'd.
description: Municipal elections, further provided for, statements of candidacy, provisional voting, absentee ballots, recount provisions, certain voter identification provisions not to apply, Sec. 17-9-30(f), Code of Alabama 1975, relating to voter identification, not to apply to municipal elections, Sec. 17-9-30 impliedly amended, Secs. 11-46-25, 11-46-27, 11-46-39, 11-46-44, 11-46-45, 11-46-46, 11-46-50, 11-46-55, 11-46-55.1, 11-46-57, 11-46-58, 11-46-67, 17-7-25, 17-11-14, 17-11-15 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises numerous municipal-election procedures and exempts municipal elections from specified voter-identification provisions. The access effect of the ID exemption is directionally permissive, while the broader package cannot be reduced from the synopsis to generic 'integrity controls.'

title: Ethics Commission, granted subpoena power, Secs. 36-25-3 am'd.; Act 2009-225, 2009 Reg. Sess. am'd. (2010-20001)
description: Ethics Commission, granted subpoena power, Secs. 36-25-3 am'd.; Act 2009-225, 2009 Reg. Sess. am'd. (2010-20001)
frontier_rationale: Grants subpoena power to the Ethics Commission, strengthening investigatory enforcement authority; it is not specifically a campaign-finance restriction.

title: Elections, public employees, payroll deductions, state and local governmental agencies, including school boards, prohibited from arranging for payments by payroll deduction to political action committees or dues for membership organizations that use funds for political activities, Sec. 17-17-5 am'd. (2010-21197)
description: Elections, public employees, payroll deductions, state and local governmental agencies, including school boards, prohibited from arranging for payments by payroll deduction to political action committees or dues for membership organizations that use funds for political activities, Sec. 17-17-5 am'd. (2010-21197)
frontier_rationale: Bars public bodies from processing payroll deductions for PAC contributions or dues to membership organizations using funds politically. The burden principally restricts public-employee unions and allied membership organizations.

title: Food stamps and welfare (TANF), persons with felony drug conviction, federal law provisions making ineligible, provision for persons to be eligible under certain conditions
description: Food stamps and welfare (TANF), persons with felony drug conviction, federal law provisions making ineligible, provision for persons to be eligible under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows people with felony drug convictions to receive food and TANF benefits under specified conditions despite the federal default ban. The inherited stronger-conditions label missed the net eligibility expansion.

title: Firearms and ammunition in motor vehicles, certain persons and entities prohibited from establishing policies against persons transporting or storing firearms or ammunition in motor vehicles under certain conditions
description: Firearms and ammunition in motor vehicles, certain persons and entities prohibited from establishing policies against persons transporting or storing firearms or ammunition in motor vehicles under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Prohibits employers and other entities from banning lawful firearm storage in vehicles under specified conditions. This expands gun rights while restricting private workplace property and policy autonomy.

title: Human trafficking, crime established, coercion or deception to perform labor or certain sexual activities, prohibited, criminal penalties
description: Human trafficking, crime established, coercion or deception to perform labor or certain sexual activities, prohibited, criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Creates human-trafficking crimes covering coerced labor and sexual activity. This expands protection against exploitation through punitive enforcement.

title: Franklin Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, distrib., Act 514, 1978 Reg. Sess. am'd.
description: Franklin Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, distrib., Act 514, 1978 Reg. Sess. am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises Franklin County pistol-permit fees and distributes proceeds. This is local fee administration, not general purchase regulation.

title: Public School and College Authority, bonds, issuance for new school construction and renovation of existing school facilities in school systems directly impacted by 2005 Base Realignment and Closure, local school districts required to provide dollar for dollar match (2010-20875)
description: Public School and College Authority, bonds, issuance for new school construction and renovation of existing school facilities in school systems directly impacted by 2005 Base Realignment and Closure, local school districts required to provide dollar for dollar match (2010-20875)
frontier_rationale: Authorizes school-construction and renovation bonds for districts affected by military base realignment, conditioned on dollar-for-dollar local matching funds.

title: Birmingham, security personnel employed by city board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
description: Birmingham, security personnel employed by city board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows Birmingham school-board security personnel to carry firearms under conditions. This expands armed school-security authority.

title: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
description: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows Mobile County school security and resource officers to carry firearms. This expands armed school-security authority.

title: Environmental Management Department, civil penalties for violations, certain minimum penalties removed, Sec. 22-22A-5 am'd. (2011-20079)
description: Environmental Management Department, civil penalties for violations, certain minimum penalties removed, Sec. 22-22A-5 am'd. (2011-20079)
frontier_rationale: Removes specified minimum civil penalties for environmental violations. This increases agency discretion but weakens mandatory enforcement floors.

title: Sports, youth athletes, concussions and head injuries, each sport or recreational organization governing body to develop guidelines regarding medical evaluation, removal from practice or game, written clearance from health care provider to return to play, athletic head injury safety training required (2011-20301)
description: Sports, youth athletes, concussions and head injuries, each sport or recreational organization governing body to develop guidelines regarding medical evaluation, removal from practice or game, written clearance from health care provider to return to play, athletic head injury safety training required (2011-20301)
frontier_rationale: Requires concussion protocols, removal from play, professional clearance, and safety training for youth sports organizations, expanding health-and-safety regulation and patient protection.

title: Solid waste, application filed with Environmental Management Department for new facility, local governing body approval, deemed denied if not approved within certain number of days, Sec. 22-27-48 am'd.
description: Solid waste, application filed with Environmental Management Department for new facility, local governing body approval, deemed denied if not approved within certain number of days, Sec. 22-27-48 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires local governing-body approval before ADEM may act on a new solid-waste facility and treats failure to approve within the statutory period as denial. This strengthens local siting control and a facility-development constraint.

title: Abortion, prohibited on or after 20 weeks postfertilization, exceptions for health of mother, Legislative findings regarding pain felt by unborn child, reports to Office of Vital Statistics, civil and criminal penalties, Alabama Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act, Sec. 22-9A-13 am'd. (2011-20570)
description: Abortion, prohibited on or after 20 weeks postfertilization, exceptions for health of mother, Legislative findings regarding pain felt by unborn child, reports to Office of Vital Statistics, civil and criminal penalties, Alabama Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act, Sec. 22-9A-13 am'd. (2011-20570)
frontier_rationale: Bans most abortions at or after twenty weeks based on fetal-pain findings, with narrow maternal-health exceptions and penalties. This directly restricts abortion access.

title: Capital offenses, sex crimes, certain against children included, sentencing to life imprisonment without parole, Sec. 13A-5-6 am'd. (2011-20458)
description: Capital offenses, sex crimes, certain against children included, sentencing to life imprisonment without parole, Sec. 13A-5-6 am'd. (2011-20458)
frontier_rationale: Adds specified child sex crimes to capital-offense treatment with life without parole. This substantially increases punishment severity.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board, requirement for unanimous affirmative vote to grant parole to a prisoner who has not served certain amount of sentence, eliminated, Sec. 15-22-28 am'd.
description: Pardons and Paroles Board, requirement for unanimous affirmative vote to grant parole to a prisoner who has not served certain amount of sentence, eliminated, Sec. 15-22-28 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates a unanimous-vote requirement for parole before a specified sentence threshold. This lowers an institutional barrier to release; the inherited due-process weakening label was misleading.

title: Environmental Management Department, issuance of permits to certain solid waste landfills, 24-month moratorium on issuance, duties to Environmental Management Department and Health Department (2011-20385)
description: Environmental Management Department, issuance of permits to certain solid waste landfills, 24-month moratorium on issuance, duties to Environmental Management Department and Health Department (2011-20385)
frontier_rationale: Imposes a 24-month moratorium on specified landfill permits. The inherited weakening label was reversed; this temporarily strengthens siting restrictions.

title: Firearms, soliciting or encouraging a licensed dealer or private seller of firearms or ammunition to transfer a firearm or ammunition if the person knows the transfer violates state and federal law and providing false information to dealer or seller of firearms or ammunition with intent to deceive, crimes established, exceptions, penalties
description: Firearms, soliciting or encouraging a licensed dealer or private seller of firearms or ammunition to transfer a firearm or ammunition if the person knows the transfer violates state and federal law and providing false information to dealer or seller of firearms or ammunition with intent to deceive, crimes established, exceptions, penalties
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes knowingly inducing unlawful firearm transfers or deceiving sellers, with exceptions. This strengthens anti-straw-purchase regulation.

title: Illegal immigrants, presence, employment, and benefits regulated, concealing, or protecting illegal aliens, prohibited, verification of legal status, penalties, Alabama Department of Homeland Security to establish E-Verify employer agent service, citizenship status of students required, eligibility and requirements for voter registration, certain business transactions prohibited, Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act, Sec. 32-6-9 am'd. (2011-21101)
description: Illegal immigrants, presence, employment, and benefits regulated, concealing, or protecting illegal aliens, prohibited, verification of legal status, penalties, Alabama Department of Homeland Security to establish E-Verify employer agent service, citizenship status of students required, eligibility and requirements for voter registration, certain business transactions prohibited, Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act, Sec. 32-6-9 am'd. (2011-21101)
frontier_rationale: Comprehensive Beason-Hammon enforcement regulates presence, employment, benefits, education, transactions, and voting with penalties. This is a maximal restrictive immigration package.
