title: Madison Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, Act 489, 1975 Reg. Sess. am'd.
description: Madison Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, Act 489, 1975 Reg. Sess. am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises Madison County pistol-permit fees. This modestly raises access costs but is local fee administration.

title: Public officials or spouses of public officials, names and compensation of those who are employed by or have contracts with a municipality, a county, or the state, public disclosure required, filing with Ethics Commission, Sec. 36-25-5.1 added
description: Public officials or spouses of public officials, names and compensation of those who are employed by or have contracts with a municipality, a county, or the state, public disclosure required, filing with Ethics Commission, Sec. 36-25-5.1 added
frontier_rationale: Requires disclosure of public officials' and spouses' compensated relationships with state and local government. This is an ethics-transparency rule, not specifically campaign-finance regulation.

title: Education, public school K-12, minimum mandatory age of attendance decreased from seven to six, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
description: Education, public school K-12, minimum mandatory age of attendance decreased from seven to six, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Lowers the mandatory school-attendance age from seven to six, simultaneously expanding early public-school participation and state compulsory-attendance obligations.

title: Health care, persons, employers, or health care providers, mandatory participation in any health care system prohibited, const. amend.
description: Health care, persons, employers, or health care providers, mandatory participation in any health care system prohibited, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionally prohibits compulsory participation by individuals, employers, or providers in a healthcare system. It protects market autonomy while restricting universal or mandatory public-health system authority.

title: Macon Co., business licenses, county commission authorized to set fees
description: Macon Co., business licenses, county commission authorized to set fees
frontier_rationale: Allows Macon County to set business-license fees. This expands local regulatory authority but is not a general market-governance signal.

title: Corrections Department, prescription medication, unused, redispensing authorized under certain conditions
description: Corrections Department, prescription medication, unused, redispensing authorized under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Corrections to redispense unused prescription medication under specified conditions. This is medication reuse and cost administration, not expansion of addiction treatment.

title: Public assistance, fraudulent means to establish eligibility, prohibited, penalties
description: Public assistance, fraudulent means to establish eligibility, prohibited, penalties
frontier_rationale: Prohibits fraudulent eligibility claims and adds penalties. This expands punitive welfare-integrity enforcement.

title: Elections, campaign finance disclosure reports, electronic filing, frequency increased, Section 527 organization filing requirements, filing of large contributions required, Secretary of State to establish and maintain electronic database, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd. (2011-21174)
description: Elections, campaign finance disclosure reports, electronic filing, frequency increased, Section 527 organization filing requirements, filing of large contributions required, Secretary of State to establish and maintain electronic database, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd. (2011-21174)
frontier_rationale: Requires electronic campaign-finance reporting, more frequent reports, large-contribution reporting, and Section 527 disclosures through a public state database.

title: Judicial system officer or employee, threatening harm or violence against, crime established, death penalty, Secs. 13A-5-40, 13A-5-49 am'd.
description: Judicial system officer or employee, threatening harm or violence against, crime established, death penalty, Secs. 13A-5-40, 13A-5-49 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates offenses for threats against judicial-system workers and adds capital/death-penalty treatment. This expands punitive protection of state justice personnel.

title: Businesses or public employers, required to verify legal status of new employees through federal E-Verify program, penalties
description: Businesses or public employers, required to verify legal status of new employees through federal E-Verify program, penalties
frontier_rationale: Requires businesses and public employers to use E-Verify with penalties. This expands employment-based immigration enforcement.

title: Health, abortion coverage by exchange participating health plans, State of Alabama opts out of authorizing, Federal Abortion Mandate Opt Out Act
description: Health, abortion coverage by exchange participating health plans, State of Alabama opts out of authorizing, Federal Abortion Mandate Opt Out Act
frontier_rationale: Opts Alabama out of abortion coverage in exchange-participating plans. This restricts insurance access to abortion.

title: Illegal immigrants, presence, employment, and benefits regulated, concealing, or protecting illegal aliens, prohibited, verification of legal status, penalties, Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act, Sec. 32-6-9 am'd. (2011-20575)
description: Illegal immigrants, presence, employment, and benefits regulated, concealing, or protecting illegal aliens, prohibited, verification of legal status, penalties, Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act, Sec. 32-6-9 am'd. (2011-20575)
frontier_rationale: Comprehensively regulates undocumented presence, employment, benefits, concealment, and verification. This strongly expands immigration enforcement.

title: Abortions, health insurance coverage of elective abortions, prohibited, exceptions, Abortion Coverage Prohibition Act
description: Abortions, health insurance coverage of elective abortions, prohibited, exceptions, Abortion Coverage Prohibition Act
frontier_rationale: Prohibits health-insurance coverage of elective abortion with exceptions. This directly restricts financial access.

title: Abortion, physician guidelines prior to administering an abortion-inducing drug, civil and criminal penalties, Abortion-Inducing Drug Safety Act
description: Abortion, physician guidelines prior to administering an abortion-inducing drug, civil and criminal penalties, Abortion-Inducing Drug Safety Act
frontier_rationale: Imposes physician protocols and penalties for abortion-inducing medication. This restricts medication-abortion access.

title: Abortion, physician required to perform ultrasound prior to performing abortion, medical emergency excepted, civil and criminal penalties, Right to Know and See Act
description: Abortion, physician required to perform ultrasound prior to performing abortion, medical emergency excepted, civil and criminal penalties, Right to Know and See Act
frontier_rationale: Requires pre-abortion ultrasound procedures with penalties. This directly adds a barrier to abortion access.

title: Industrial Development Authority, requirement that fair market value must be received for transfers of land owned by authority, removed, Sec. 41-10-27 am'd.
description: Industrial Development Authority, requirement that fair market value must be received for transfers of land owned by authority, removed, Sec. 41-10-27 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Removes the requirement that an industrial development authority receive fair market value when transferring its land, expanding targeted development-subsidy flexibility while weakening a public-asset safeguard.

title: Economic development, financial commitments to build or expand in Alabama, written contracts required within certain time period, existing commitments without written contract void after certain period of time
description: Economic development, financial commitments to build or expand in Alabama, written contracts required within certain time period, existing commitments without written contract void after certain period of time
frontier_rationale: Requires written contracts for development commitments and voids stale unwritten promises. This strengthens formal accountability for industrial recruitment commitments.

title: Dale Co., sheriff, pistol permit, fee, distrib., Act 85-608, 1985 Reg. Sess. repealed
description: Dale Co., sheriff, pistol permit, fee, distrib., Act 85-608, 1985 Reg. Sess. repealed
frontier_rationale: The enrolled act establishes Dale County pistol-permit fees of $20, or $10 for people 65 and older, and dedicates all proceeds to a sheriff-controlled law-enforcement fund. The new burden and allocation are clear, although comparison with the repealed 1985 fee requires that older act.

title: Abortion, require physician involvement, define terms, express intent, require certain standard in treatment and care, require reporting, require Board of Health adopt rules and provide penalties
description: Abortion, require physician involvement, define terms, express intent, require certain standard in treatment and care, require reporting, require Board of Health adopt rules and provide penalties
frontier_rationale: Requires physician involvement, standards, reporting, rules, and penalties for abortion care. This expands provider regulation and restricts access.

title: Health Care Sharing Ministries Freedom to Share Act, program for matching of health care and financial needs, disclaimers required, program not subject to Insurance Department regulations
description: Health Care Sharing Ministries Freedom to Share Act, program for matching of health care and financial needs, disclaimers required, program not subject to Insurance Department regulations
frontier_rationale: Authorizes health-care sharing ministries outside Insurance Department regulation with mandated disclaimers, favoring voluntary private risk sharing and regulatory exemption over conventional insurance oversight.

title: Methamphetamines, further regulation of the sale of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine products, licensed pharmacies solely authorized to sell, criminal penalties enhanced, membership of Alabama Drug Abuse Task Force revised, Alabama Criminal Justice Information Center to create an electronic drug offender tracking system, Secs. 13A-12-260, 20-2-190 am'd; Sec. 20-2-190.2 added
description: Methamphetamines, further regulation of the sale of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine products, licensed pharmacies solely authorized to sell, criminal penalties enhanced, membership of Alabama Drug Abuse Task Force revised, Alabama Criminal Justice Information Center to create an electronic drug offender tracking system, Secs. 13A-12-260, 20-2-190 am'd; Sec. 20-2-190.2 added
frontier_rationale: Restricts precursor sales to pharmacies, enhances penalties, and creates electronic offender tracking. This combines commercial controls with punitive drug enforcement and surveillance.

title: Immigration, legal status and/or proof of citizenship, verification of eligibility to enter into business transactions with state or political subdivision, Uniformed Services Privilege and Identification card authorized, Act 2011-535, 2011 Reg. Sess. am'd.; Sec. 31-13-29 am'd.
description: Immigration, legal status and/or proof of citizenship, verification of eligibility to enter into business transactions with state or political subdivision, Uniformed Services Privilege and Identification card authorized, Act 2011-535, 2011 Reg. Sess. am'd.; Sec. 31-13-29 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Amends Alabama's immigration law governing proof of legal status for government business transactions and accepts military privilege-and-identification cards. It is not an election-integrity measure.

title: Insurance, State Employees' Insurance Board to include one year of hazardous duty time for every five years as a correctional officer awarded to correctional officers under Employees' Retirement System and Teachers' Retirement System, Sec. 36-29-19.7 am'd; Act 2011-698, 2011 Regular Sesssion am'd (2012-20347)
description: Insurance, State Employees' Insurance Board to include one year of hazardous duty time for every five years as a correctional officer awarded to correctional officers under Employees' Retirement System and Teachers' Retirement System, Sec. 36-29-19.7 am'd; Act 2011-698, 2011 Regular Sesssion am'd (2012-20347)
frontier_rationale: Awards correctional officers hazardous-duty service credit for retirement. The inherited punitive label was wrong; this is public-employee compensation.

title: Probation and parole, supervision fee raised, requirement that employer submit by fifth of month eliminated, Sec. 15-22-2 am'd
description: Probation and parole, supervision fee raised, requirement that employer submit by fifth of month eliminated, Sec. 15-22-2 am'd
frontier_rationale: Raises probation and parole supervision fees while eliminating an employer submission deadline. It increases burdens on supervised people but reduces employer administration.

title: Solid waste landfill, permits, prohibition against issuance by Alabama Department of Environmental Management and local governments of new permits pursuant to Act 2011-297 extended until after May 31, 2014, Act 2011-297, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd; Sec. 22-27-5.2 am'd
description: Solid waste landfill, permits, prohibition against issuance by Alabama Department of Environmental Management and local governments of new permits pursuant to Act 2011-297 extended until after May 31, 2014, Act 2011-297, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd; Sec. 22-27-5.2 am'd
frontier_rationale: Extends the prohibition on new landfill permits through May 2014. This strengthens or prolongs environmental siting controls.

title: Tires, environmental fees on scrap tires, fees previously paid to ADEM redistributed to State General Fund, Sec. 22-40A-15 am'd
description: Tires, environmental fees on scrap tires, fees previously paid to ADEM redistributed to State General Fund, Sec. 22-40A-15 am'd
frontier_rationale: Redirects scrap-tire environmental fees from ADEM to the General Fund. This weakens dedicated environmental funding while increasing unrestricted revenue.

title: Immigration law, provision barring unlawfully present alien from attending postsecondary school clarified, lawsuits for failure to enforce laws, procedures revised, documentation for lawful presence, military identification authorized, voter registration provisions modified, certain lawful presence verification for certain subsequent issuance and renewals of certain licenses, procedures and penalties for employing unauthorized alien, penalties for certain lawsuits relating to employment practices, Secs. 31-13-3, 31-13-5, 31-13-6, 31-13-8, 31-13-9, 31-13-13, 31-13-19, 31-13-20, 31-13-23, 31-13-26, 31-13-28, 31-13-29, 32-6-9, 32-6-10.1 am'd; Act 2011-535, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd
description: Immigration law, provision barring unlawfully present alien from attending postsecondary school clarified, lawsuits for failure to enforce laws, procedures revised, documentation for lawful presence, military identification authorized, voter registration provisions modified, certain lawful presence verification for certain subsequent issuance and renewals of certain licenses, procedures and penalties for employing unauthorized alien, penalties for certain lawsuits relating to employment practices, Secs. 31-13-3, 31-13-5, 31-13-6, 31-13-8, 31-13-9, 31-13-13, 31-13-19, 31-13-20, 31-13-23, 31-13-26, 31-13-28, 31-13-29, 32-6-9, 32-6-10.1 am'd; Act 2011-535, 2011 Reg. Sess., am'd
frontier_rationale: Revises the broad 2011 immigration law across college exclusion, enforcement lawsuits, lawful-presence documentation, employment, voting, and military IDs. It remains restrictive overall but contains technical and potentially moderating changes requiring component treatment.

title: Geneva Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, Act 94-461, 1994 Reg. Sess. am'd.
description: Geneva Co., sheriff, pistol permits, fee increased, Act 94-461, 1994 Reg. Sess. am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises Geneva County pistol-permit fees. This is local fee administration.

title: Corrections Department, inmates prohibited from possessing mobile telephones, wireless communication devices, visitors, giving or selling device to inmate, prohibited, search and confiscation provisions, notice, contracts for detection, penalties
description: Corrections Department, inmates prohibited from possessing mobile telephones, wireless communication devices, visitors, giving or selling device to inmate, prohibited, search and confiscation provisions, notice, contracts for detection, penalties
frontier_rationale: Bans inmate wireless devices, penalizes suppliers, and authorizes detection, searches, and confiscation. This expands prison control and restricts communication, not incarceration capacity itself.

title: Alabama Trust Fund, unrealized capital gains, oil and gas capital payments received during fiscal year, excluded from the calculation, clarified, realized gains from a public exchange traded equity asset, purchased and sold in same fiscal year, calculation method established, Amendment 666 (Section 219.04, Recompiled Constitution of Alabama of 1901, as amended), am'd., const. amend.
description: Alabama Trust Fund, unrealized capital gains, oil and gas capital payments received during fiscal year, excluded from the calculation, clarified, realized gains from a public exchange traded equity asset, purchased and sold in same fiscal year, calculation method established, Amendment 666 (Section 219.04, Recompiled Constitution of Alabama of 1901, as amended), am'd., const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Changes constitutional accounting treatment for unrealized gains and oil-and-gas capital payments in the Alabama Trust Fund. The synopsis does not establish a directional climate or energy policy.

title: Education Options Act; provides for establishment of innovative schools and school systems via flexibility contracts with State Department of Education, authorizes establishment of public charter schools as part of public education system
description: Education Options Act; provides for establishment of innovative schools and school systems via flexibility contracts with State Department of Education, authorizes establishment of public charter schools as part of public education system
frontier_rationale: Authorizes flexibility-contract schools and public charter schools. This expands alternatives within the public-education system.

title: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
description: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows Mobile County school security and resource officers to carry firearms. This expands armed school-security authority.

title: Religious Liberty Act, allow employers who are religiously affiliated or motivated to exclude health insurance coverage for contraceptive or abortifacient drugs, devices, methods to its employees
description: Religious Liberty Act, allow employers who are religiously affiliated or motivated to exclude health insurance coverage for contraceptive or abortifacient drugs, devices, methods to its employees
frontier_rationale: Allows religiously affiliated or motivated employers to exclude contraception and abortifacient coverage. It expands employer conscience at employees' expense.

title: Medicaid fraud, crime further defined, criminal penalties, statute of limitation, Medicaid Agency, access to Health Department Controlled Substances Data Base, Secs. 20-2-214, 22-1-11 am'd.
description: Medicaid fraud, crime further defined, criminal penalties, statute of limitation, Medicaid Agency, access to Health Department Controlled Substances Data Base, Secs. 20-2-214, 22-1-11 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broadens Medicaid-fraud crimes and penalties and gives the Medicaid Agency access to the controlled-substances database. This is fraud enforcement and surveillance, not drug criminalization itself.

title: Escambia Co., Oil and Gas Severance Trust, loans to county authorized for economic development and roads and bridges, const. amend.
description: Escambia Co., Oil and Gas Severance Trust, loans to county authorized for economic development and roads and bridges, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Authorizes loans from Escambia County's oil-and-gas severance trust for economic development and transportation infrastructure. This redirects resource revenue toward public development financing rather than expanding extraction itself.

title: Police animals, search and rescue animals, fire detection and protection animals, criminal penalties for harassing, interfering, taunting, attacking, or entering containment area of, restitution, Sec. 13A-11-15 repealed
description: Police animals, search and rescue animals, fire detection and protection animals, criminal penalties for harassing, interfering, taunting, attacking, or entering containment area of, restitution, Sec. 13A-11-15 repealed
frontier_rationale: Creates or revises criminal protections and restitution for police, search-and-rescue, and fire-service animals. It is a narrow animal-protection offense rather than a general expansion of police authority.

title: Capital offenses, defendant's guilty plea, state to prove guilt only when death penalty to be imposed, guilty plea to waive all non-jurisdictional defects in cases where death penalty or life without parole to be imposed, Sec. 13A-5-42 am'd.
description: Capital offenses, defendant's guilty plea, state to prove guilt only when death penalty to be imposed, guilty plea to waive all non-jurisdictional defects in cases where death penalty or life without parole to be imposed, Sec. 13A-5-42 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Limits the state's post-plea proof obligation to death cases and broadens waiver of nonjurisdictional defects in death or life-without-parole cases. This restricts capital-case procedural protections.

title: Public School and College Authority, bonds, issuance of $30,000,000 million for schools damaged in tornados for improvements
description: Public School and College Authority, bonds, issuance of $30,000,000 million for schools damaged in tornados for improvements
frontier_rationale: Authorizes school-facility bonds for tornado-damaged schools, expanding targeted public capital investment.

title: Educators' associations, equal access to public school districts and their employees required, equal access to public institutions of higher learning and their employees, required
description: Educators' associations, equal access to public school districts and their employees required, equal access to public institutions of higher learning and their employees, required
frontier_rationale: Requires equal workplace and institutional access for educators' associations. The synopsis regulates parity among associations rather than establishing a general pro- or anti-labor rule.

title: Abortion, physician involvement and admitting privileges at local hospital required, certain standard in treatment and care required, reporting of name of minor child to Human Resources Department and law enforcement under certain conditions, criminal penalties, Women's Health and Safety Act
description: Abortion, physician involvement and admitting privileges at local hospital required, certain standard in treatment and care required, reporting of name of minor child to Human Resources Department and law enforcement under certain conditions, criminal penalties, Women's Health and Safety Act
frontier_rationale: Requires local hospital privileges and additional treatment and minor-reporting rules with penalties. This substantially restricts abortion-provider access.

title: Secure School Facilities Act, Alabama Public School and College Authority, bond issue of $50,000,000 authorized for public K-12 building renovations
description: Secure School Facilities Act, Alabama Public School and College Authority, bond issue of $50,000,000 authorized for public K-12 building renovations
frontier_rationale: Authorizes a $50 million bond issue for public K-12 security renovations, expanding public capital investment in school facilities.

title: Jefferson Co.,municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
description: Jefferson Co.,municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Jefferson County municipal warrant-recall fees. This is local justice financing through defendant fees, not general punishment ideology.

title: Schools, Accountability Act of 2013 amended, definition of failing school, school flexibility contracts, and calculation of tax credits for parents of children assigned to or enrolled in failing school, further provided for, revises tax credit for corporate donors to scholarship program, retoactive, Act 2013-64, 2013 Reg. Sess., am'd.
description: Schools, Accountability Act of 2013 amended, definition of failing school, school flexibility contracts, and calculation of tax credits for parents of children assigned to or enrolled in failing school, further provided for, revises tax credit for corporate donors to scholarship program, retoactive, Act 2013-64, 2013 Reg. Sess., am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises failing-school definitions, flexibility contracts, family credits, and corporate scholarship credits. This expands tax-supported public and private school choice.

title: Shelby Co.,municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
description: Shelby Co.,municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Shelby County municipal warrant-recall fees. This is local justice financing through defendant fees.

title: Firearms, right to bear arms, strict scrutiny standard required for certain denials of right, const. amend.
description: Firearms, right to bear arms, strict scrutiny standard required for certain denials of right, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Requires strict scrutiny for infringements of the right to bear arms. This constitutionally strengthens gun-rights protection.

title: Schools, Accountability Act of 2013, State Board of Education and local boards, procedures for exemption of public schools from state rules, tax credits for families with students in failing schools to attend another public or private school and for scholarship donations
description: Schools, Accountability Act of 2013, State Board of Education and local boards, procedures for exemption of public schools from state rules, tax credits for families with students in failing schools to attend another public or private school and for scholarship donations
frontier_rationale: Creates school rule waivers and tax credits for transfers, private attendance, and scholarships. This directly expands market-oriented education choice.

title: Prisoner Litigation Reform Act, created, administrative remedies for certain claims for prisoners required to be exhausted prior to filing suit, procedures adopted by the Department of Corrections, repayment of certain costs when proceeding in forma pauperis, maintenance of certain records required, resolution of certain prison condition claims by three-judge panel
description: Prisoner Litigation Reform Act, created, administrative remedies for certain claims for prisoners required to be exhausted prior to filing suit, procedures adopted by the Department of Corrections, repayment of certain costs when proceeding in forma pauperis, maintenance of certain records required, resolution of certain prison condition claims by three-judge panel
frontier_rationale: Requires administrative exhaustion, repayment of costs for indigent litigants, and special judicial procedures for prison claims. This restricts incarcerated people's access to courts.

title: Judge of probate, mental commitments, report to Alabama Criminal Justice Information Center, use for federal background checks regarding purchase of firearms, petition for reinstatement after release from mental commitment to circuit court, appeals to circuit court, use of ACJIC records by probate court, Law Enforcement Information Act, Sec. 22-52-10.8 am'd.
description: Judge of probate, mental commitments, report to Alabama Criminal Justice Information Center, use for federal background checks regarding purchase of firearms, petition for reinstatement after release from mental commitment to circuit court, appeals to circuit court, use of ACJIC records by probate court, Law Enforcement Information Act, Sec. 22-52-10.8 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires involuntary-commitment reporting for firearm background checks while creating petition and appeal procedures for rights restoration. It combines stronger purchase screening with due process.

title: Human Resources Department, public assistance, drug testing for applicants and recipients required upon reasonable suspicion, ineligibility under certain conditions, department to implement, rulemaking authority
description: Human Resources Department, public assistance, drug testing for applicants and recipients required upon reasonable suspicion, ineligibility under certain conditions, department to implement, rulemaking authority
frontier_rationale: Requires suspicion-based drug testing and imposes ineligibility. This conditions aid and reduces recipient privacy and access.

title: Schools, security personnel and resource officers employed by local board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions, Sec. 13A-11-72 am'd.
description: Schools, security personnel and resource officers employed by local board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions, Sec. 13A-11-72 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows local school-board security and resource officers to carry firearms under conditions. This expands armed school security.

title: Right to work, policy declared, cause of action declared, const. amend.
description: Right to work, policy declared, cause of action declared, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionalizes right-to-work policy and creates a cause of action, strengthening limits on compulsory union membership or financial support.

title: Public Benefits, purchase of alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, and lottery tickets with benefit funds prohibited, use of public funds in retail stores selling primarily alcoholic beverages, casinos and certain adult-oriented entertainment establishments prohibited, penalties for violations
description: Public Benefits, purchase of alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, and lottery tickets with benefit funds prohibited, use of public funds in retail stores selling primarily alcoholic beverages, casinos and certain adult-oriented entertainment establishments prohibited, penalties for violations
frontier_rationale: Restricts benefit purchases and use at specified establishments with penalties. This expands behavioral conditions on public assistance.

title: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
description: Mobile Co., security personnel and resource officers employed by county board of education authorized to carry a firearm under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows Mobile County school security and resource officers to carry firearms. This expands armed school security.

title: Firearms, infringement on the right to keep and bear arms by federal government prohibited, federal acts violating Second Amendment declared void, Second Amendment Preservation Act
description: Firearms, infringement on the right to keep and bear arms by federal government prohibited, federal acts violating Second Amendment declared void, Second Amendment Preservation Act
frontier_rationale: Declares specified federal firearm restrictions void and bars state recognition. The inherited 'strengthen purchase regulation' label was directionally wrong; this expands gun rights through anti-federal preemption.

title: Local Government Health Insurance Program, established, transfer from State Employees' Health Insurance Board
description: Local Government Health Insurance Program, established, transfer from State Employees' Health Insurance Board
frontier_rationale: Creates a separate Local Government Health Insurance Program by transferring administration from the state employee board. This is institutional reorganization, not necessarily coverage expansion.

title: Pelham, prisoner transport fee authorized for transporting defendants on misdemeanor warrants from another municipal jail
description: Pelham, prisoner transport fee authorized for transporting defendants on misdemeanor warrants from another municipal jail
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Pelham prisoner-transport fees on misdemeanor defendants. This is local justice finance, not incarceration expansion.

title: Pelham, municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
description: Pelham, municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Pelham warrant-recall fees. This is local court finance, not a broad punitive stance.

title: Class 2 municipalities (Mobile), program for All Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE program), assessments for Alabama Health Care Trust Fund, use to fund Medicaid, licensure by Health Department
description: Class 2 municipalities (Mobile), program for All Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE program), assessments for Alabama Health Care Trust Fund, use to fund Medicaid, licensure by Health Department
frontier_rationale: Creates a Mobile PACE program and assessments supporting a healthcare trust fund and Medicaid. It expands elder care financed through provider taxation.

title: School attendance, a child who withdraws from public school to attend an accredited online school, prohibited from being considered a drop-out or non-graduate for determining graduation rates, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
description: School attendance, a child who withdraws from public school to attend an accredited online school, prohibited from being considered a drop-out or non-graduate for determining graduation rates, Sec. 16-28-3 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Prevents accredited online-school transfers from counting as public-school dropouts. This legitimizes online alternatives and corrects graduation-rate attribution.

title: Rape, sodomy, burglary in the first degree, person convicted of these crimes under certain conditions sentenced to minimum of 20 yrs in prison if victim is 65 yrs old or older, Secs. 13A-6-61, 13A-6-63, 13A-7-5 am'd.
description: Rape, sodomy, burglary in the first degree, person convicted of these crimes under certain conditions sentenced to minimum of 20 yrs in prison if victim is 65 yrs old or older, Secs. 13A-6-61, 13A-6-63, 13A-7-5 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Imposes a twenty-year minimum for specified violent crimes against victims age 65 or older. This expands mandatory punitive sentencing.

title: Sex offenders, sex offender convicted of crime with a minor prohibited within 500 feet of public school K-12 property during instructional hours, Class C felony, Sec. 15-20A-17 am'd.
description: Sex offenders, sex offender convicted of crime with a minor prohibited within 500 feet of public school K-12 property during instructional hours, Class C felony, Sec. 15-20A-17 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates a felony-backed 500-foot school exclusion zone for sex offenders during instructional hours. This is punitive public-order and school-safety policy, not a restriction on educational access generally.

title: Abortions, information required to be provided to a woman prior to abortion, time period increased from 24 hours to 48 hours, Sec. 26-23A-4 am'd.
description: Abortions, information required to be provided to a woman prior to abortion, time period increased from 24 hours to 48 hours, Sec. 26-23A-4 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Doubles the mandatory abortion waiting period from 24 to 48 hours. This directly restricts timely access.

title: Fetal Heartbeat Act, prohibits physician from performing abortion without first determining fetal heartbeat, physician who does not make determination or who performs abortion when heartbeat detected is guilty of Class C felony
description: Fetal Heartbeat Act, prohibits physician from performing abortion without first determining fetal heartbeat, physician who does not make determination or who performs abortion when heartbeat detected is guilty of Class C felony
frontier_rationale: Requires heartbeat testing and criminalizes abortion after detection. This is a broad early-pregnancy abortion restriction.

title: Abortions, pregnant woman may not receive an abortion based on lethal fetal anomaly, unless made aware of perinatal hospice services, penalties, civil sanctions, Perinatal Hospice Information Act
description: Abortions, pregnant woman may not receive an abortion based on lethal fetal anomaly, unless made aware of perinatal hospice services, penalties, civil sanctions, Perinatal Hospice Information Act
frontier_rationale: Requires lethal-anomaly patients to receive perinatal-hospice information before abortion and creates sanctions. It adds a narrower informational condition to access.

title: Abortion, minors, definition of alt., written parental consent required, procedure by physicians required, Secs. 26-21-1 to 26-21-4, inclusive, 26-21-7 am'd., Secs. 26-21-6.1 added
description: Abortion, minors, definition of alt., written parental consent required, procedure by physicians required, Secs. 26-21-1 to 26-21-4, inclusive, 26-21-7 am'd., Secs. 26-21-6.1 added
frontier_rationale: Strengthens written parental-consent and physician procedures for minors. This restricts minors' abortion access and expands parental authority.

title: Animals, criminal penalties for the purchase or sale of domestic animals or fowl between sunrise and sunset, repealed, Sec. 3-1-20 repealed
description: Animals, criminal penalties for the purchase or sale of domestic animals or fowl between sunrise and sunset, repealed, Sec. 3-1-20 repealed
frontier_rationale: Repeals an antiquated time-of-day criminal prohibition on buying or selling domestic animals or fowl, reducing a narrow commercial criminal regulation rather than restricting police power generally.

title: Judges, recusals, appearance of impartiality based on campaign contribution, rebuttable presumption if contribution represents 25 percent of total contribution for election cycle, Secs. 12-24-1, 12-24-2 repealed
description: Judges, recusals, appearance of impartiality based on campaign contribution, rebuttable presumption if contribution represents 25 percent of total contribution for election cycle, Secs. 12-24-1, 12-24-2 repealed
frontier_rationale: Repeals statutory judicial-recusal provisions based on campaign-contribution thresholds, weakening a campaign-finance-related judicial conflict safeguard.

title: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), applicants for required to apply for at least three positions of unsubsidized employment, ineligibility under certain conditions, Secs.38-4-2, 38-4-4, 38-11A-2 am'd.
description: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), applicants for required to apply for at least three positions of unsubsidized employment, ineligibility under certain conditions, Secs.38-4-2, 38-4-4, 38-11A-2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires TANF applicants to seek at least three unsubsidized jobs and makes applicants ineligible under specified failures, tightening work-search conditions and access to cash assistance.

title: Public assistance benefits, purchase of alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, and lottery tickets with, prohibited, use of benefit funds in certain establishments prohibited, penalties for violations, Human Resources Department required to perform monthly matches to determine eligibility regarding incarceration or whether recipient is deceased
description: Public assistance benefits, purchase of alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, and lottery tickets with, prohibited, use of benefit funds in certain establishments prohibited, penalties for violations, Human Resources Department required to perform monthly matches to determine eligibility regarding incarceration or whether recipient is deceased
frontier_rationale: Restricts purchases and establishments, adds penalties, and mandates monthly incarceration and death matches. This expands welfare conditionality and surveillance.

title: Voter identification, penalties for crime of falsifying or fraudulently making an application for Alabama photo voter ID card reduced, Sec. 17-9-30 am'd.
description: Voter identification, penalties for crime of falsifying or fraudulently making an application for Alabama photo voter ID card reduced, Sec. 17-9-30 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Reduces penalties for falsifying a state voter-ID application. This is a narrow reduction in election-related criminal punishment.

title: Health insurance, licensing of physicians, dentists, chiropractors, and optometrists, not to be conditioned on participation in health insurance plans
description: Health insurance, licensing of physicians, dentists, chiropractors, and optometrists, not to be conditioned on participation in health insurance plans
frontier_rationale: Prohibits conditioning professional licenses on insurance-plan participation. This protects provider autonomy, not patient coverage directly.

title: Food stamps and welfare, Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), persons with felony drug conviction, federal law provisions making ineligible, provision for persons to be eligible under certain conditions
description: Food stamps and welfare, Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), persons with felony drug conviction, federal law provisions making ineligible, provision for persons to be eligible under certain conditions
frontier_rationale: Allows people with felony drug convictions to qualify for food and TANF benefits under conditions. This relaxes the federal categorical ban.

title: Disorderly conduct, definition revised, carrying a pistol in a vehicle without a pistol permit, authorized, discretion of sheriff in concealed pistol licensing eliminated under certain conditions, certain provisions of concealed pistol licensing revised, Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-75 am'd.
description: Disorderly conduct, definition revised, carrying a pistol in a vehicle without a pistol permit, authorized, discretion of sheriff in concealed pistol licensing eliminated under certain conditions, certain provisions of concealed pistol licensing revised, Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-75 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows vehicle carry without a permit and reduces sheriff discretion in concealed licensing. This directly expands gun access.

title: Oil and Gas Board, oil and gas wells, drainage or production units, regulation of horizontal wells in oil reservoirs and offshore wells in gas reservoirs, Secs. 9-17-1, 9-17-12 am'd.
description: Oil and Gas Board, oil and gas wells, drainage or production units, regulation of horizontal wells in oil reservoirs and offshore wells in gas reservoirs, Secs. 9-17-1, 9-17-12 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends or clarifies Oil and Gas Board regulation of horizontal and offshore production units. The inherited weakening label was unsupported; this expands structured regulation.

title: Schools, nonpublic, including private and church schools, State Department of Education prohibited from regulating or licensing, public colleges and universities prohibted from denying admittance to students based on attendance at nonpublic schools, department may not deny certification to a person because of employment by a nonpublic school, Secs. 16-1-11, 16-28-1, 16-28-7, 16-46-1 to 16-46-10, inclusive, am'd.
description: Schools, nonpublic, including private and church schools, State Department of Education prohibited from regulating or licensing, public colleges and universities prohibted from denying admittance to students based on attendance at nonpublic schools, department may not deny certification to a person because of employment by a nonpublic school, Secs. 16-1-11, 16-28-1, 16-28-7, 16-46-1 to 16-46-10, inclusive, am'd.
frontier_rationale: Bars state licensing of private and church schools and protects their students and employees from public-system discrimination. This strongly expands nonpublic education autonomy.

title: Virtual Public Schools Act, local boards of education may provide alternative choice for education via the Internet
description: Virtual Public Schools Act, local boards of education may provide alternative choice for education via the Internet
frontier_rationale: Allows local boards to offer Internet-based virtual public schools. This expands delivery choice within public education.

title: Medicaid, Regional Care Organizations, membership and eligibility of board of directors revised, appointment of executive committee, creation of provider standards committee, establishment of minimum reimbursement rates by the Medicaid Agency, review of provider contract terms, rulemaking authority of the Medicaid Agency, Secs. 22-6-151, 22-6-153, 22-6-155, 22-6-158, 22-6-163, 22-6-164 am'd.
description: Medicaid, Regional Care Organizations, membership and eligibility of board of directors revised, appointment of executive committee, creation of provider standards committee, establishment of minimum reimbursement rates by the Medicaid Agency, review of provider contract terms, rulemaking authority of the Medicaid Agency, Secs. 22-6-151, 22-6-153, 22-6-155, 22-6-158, 22-6-163, 22-6-164 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises regional Medicaid governance, provider standards, minimum rates, contract review, and agency rules. This is managed-care restructuring with provider protections, not a simple access expansion.

title: Human Resources Department, public assistance, drug testing for applicants and recipients required upon reasonable suspicion, ineligibility under certain conditions, department to implement, rulemaking authority
description: Human Resources Department, public assistance, drug testing for applicants and recipients required upon reasonable suspicion, ineligibility under certain conditions, department to implement, rulemaking authority
frontier_rationale: Requires suspicion-based applicant and recipient drug tests with ineligibility. This conditions and restricts public assistance.

title: Consumer, regulate the lending of money, provide criminal penalties
description: Consumer, regulate the lending of money, provide criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Regulates consumer lawsuit lending with criminal penalties. This is financial consumer-protection regulation, not generic punitive ideology.

title: Death penalty, execution by electrocution required under certain conditions, Sec. 15-18-82.1 am'd.
description: Death penalty, execution by electrocution required under certain conditions, Sec. 15-18-82.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires electrocution under specified execution conditions. This preserves or mandates an additional execution method and is strongly pro-capital-punishment.

title: Crime of theft of valor, created, criminal penalties, limitation period tolled, Alabama Stolen Valor Act of 2015, Sec. 13A-8-10.5 added
description: Crime of theft of valor, created, criminal penalties, limitation period tolled, Alabama Stolen Valor Act of 2015, Sec. 13A-8-10.5 added
frontier_rationale: Creates a stolen-valor crime and tolls its limitations period. This protects military honor through criminal law.

title: Corrections Institute Finance Authority, authorized to issue additional bonds, Secs. 14-2-12, 14-2-19 am'd.
description: Corrections Institute Finance Authority, authorized to issue additional bonds, Secs. 14-2-12, 14-2-19 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Authorizes additional correctional-facility bonds. This expands prison capital financing and potential capacity.

title: Firearms, pistols, sale of or delivery to minor, record-keeping and administrative requirements, certain provisions eliminated, Secs. 13A-11-57, 13A-11-61.2, 13A-11-72, 13A-11-76, 13A-11-79, 22-52-10.8, 40-12-143 am'd.
description: Firearms, pistols, sale of or delivery to minor, record-keeping and administrative requirements, certain provisions eliminated, Secs. 13A-11-57, 13A-11-61.2, 13A-11-72, 13A-11-76, 13A-11-79, 22-52-10.8, 40-12-143 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates specified recordkeeping and administrative provisions governing pistol transfer to minors. This weakens purchase regulation.

title: Economic development, incentives under the Alabama Jobs Act further provided for, loans in targeted counties by the State Industrial Development Authority authorized, Alabama Veterans and Targeted Counties Act, Secs. 40-18-376.1, 40-18-376.2 , 41-10-45.1 to 41-10-45.6, inclusive, added
description: Economic development, incentives under the Alabama Jobs Act further provided for, loans in targeted counties by the State Industrial Development Authority authorized, Alabama Veterans and Targeted Counties Act, Secs. 40-18-376.1, 40-18-376.2 , 41-10-45.1 to 41-10-45.6, inclusive, added
frontier_rationale: Expands Jobs Act incentives and state-authority loans for veterans and targeted counties. This is active industrial and regional subsidy policy.

title: Lobbying, prohibiting certain public officials from serving as a lobbyist for a two-year period, Secs. 36-25-13, 36-25-23 am'd.
description: Lobbying, prohibiting certain public officials from serving as a lobbyist for a two-year period, Secs. 36-25-13, 36-25-23 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends or strengthens the prohibition on specified public officials becoming lobbyists for two years, restricting the government-to-lobbying revolving door.

title: Jackson Co., firearms, sheriff authorize to sell abandoned or stolen firearms to highest bidder under certain conditions, Sec. 45-36-231.02 am'd.
description: Jackson Co., firearms, sheriff authorize to sell abandoned or stolen firearms to highest bidder under certain conditions, Sec. 45-36-231.02 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows Jackson County's sheriff to auction recovered firearms. This is local asset disposition, not general gun access.

title: Corrections Department, appropriation in 2014-2015 General Fund budget, earmarking for Wetumpka Women's Facility deleted, Act 2014-284, 2014 Reg. Sess., am'd.
description: Corrections Department, appropriation in 2014-2015 General Fund budget, earmarking for Wetumpka Women's Facility deleted, Act 2014-284, 2014 Reg. Sess., am'd.
frontier_rationale: Removes a facility-specific Tutwiler funding earmark during a budget crisis. A yes vote favors administrative flexibility and anti-earmark budgeting but weakens legislative guarantees for a vulnerable women's prison; it is only marginally conservative on social justice and conservative on fiscal control.

title: Charter schools, public charter schools authorized, Alabama Public Charter School Commission created, application, accountability, operation, funding, School Choice and Student Opportunity Act
description: Charter schools, public charter schools authorized, Alabama Public Charter School Commission created, application, accountability, operation, funding, School Choice and Student Opportunity Act
frontier_rationale: Authorizes public charter schools and a statewide commission with application, funding, and accountability rules. This is a major charter-choice expansion.

title: Employment, Alabama Uniform Minimum Wage and Right to Work Act, prohibit local governmental entities from requiring minimum wage or other benefits
description: Employment, Alabama Uniform Minimum Wage and Right to Work Act, prohibit local governmental entities from requiring minimum wage or other benefits
frontier_rationale: Preempts local governments from setting minimum wages or employment benefits, restricting local labor standards and expanding state preemption.

title: Sonogram, specific information regarding unborn child, required notice, penalty for violation, Ultrasound Access Act
description: Sonogram, specific information regarding unborn child, required notice, penalty for violation, Ultrasound Access Act
frontier_rationale: Requires specified sonogram information and penalties. This adds a mandatory abortion-care condition.

title: Children, criminal penalties for distrib. of harmful material to minor by school employee, out of court statements by minors allowed under certain conditions, certain individuals with certain credentials auth. to work in child care facilities, criminal penaties for sexual abuse by foster parents, Sec. 38-7-20 added; Secs. 13A-12-200.5, 15-25-31, 26-14-3, 38-7-2 am'd.
description: Children, criminal penalties for distrib. of harmful material to minor by school employee, out of court statements by minors allowed under certain conditions, certain individuals with certain credentials auth. to work in child care facilities, criminal penaties for sexual abuse by foster parents, Sec. 38-7-20 added; Secs. 13A-12-200.5, 15-25-31, 26-14-3, 38-7-2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Omnibus child-protection legislation expands penalties and evidentiary rules while changing childcare-worker eligibility. It cannot be represented as one punitive scalar.

title: Right to work public, policy declared, membership in or payment of dues to labor union may not be required for employment, const. amend.
description: Right to work public, policy declared, membership in or payment of dues to labor union may not be required for employment, const. amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionalizes right-to-work policy by barring employment requirements to join or pay dues to a union.

title: Muscle, Shoals, warrant recall fee in municipal court cases, deposit of proceeds into Corrections Fund
description: Muscle, Shoals, warrant recall fee in municipal court cases, deposit of proceeds into Corrections Fund
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Muscle Shoals warrant-recall fees. This is local justice finance, not general due process.

title: Firearms, pistol permits, retired military, lifetime permit provided at no cost, power of sheriff to revoke
description: Firearms, pistol permits, retired military, lifetime permit provided at no cost, power of sheriff to revoke
frontier_rationale: Creates free lifetime permits for retired military while retaining or revising sheriff revocation power. It expands access for a favored group with a regulatory safeguard.

title: Firearms, possession of does not constitute disorderly conduct, possession of in a vehicle or on certain property authorized under certain conditions, exception, Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-75 am'd.
description: Firearms, possession of does not constitute disorderly conduct, possession of in a vehicle or on certain property authorized under certain conditions, exception, Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-75 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Provides that possession alone is not disorderly conduct and broadens vehicle and property possession. This expands gun rights.

title: Abortion, Department of Public Health may not issue or renew licenses of clinics located near schools
description: Abortion, Department of Public Health may not issue or renew licenses of clinics located near schools
frontier_rationale: Bars licensure of abortion clinics near schools. This restricts clinic availability through location rules.

title: Fraudulent claims, treble damages for persons filing false claims, civil penalties, Attorney General required to investigate and initiate civil actions, retaliatory action by employers prohibited, limitation of actions, Medicaid False Claims Act
description: Fraudulent claims, treble damages for persons filing false claims, civil penalties, Attorney General required to investigate and initiate civil actions, retaliatory action by employers prohibited, limitation of actions, Medicaid False Claims Act
frontier_rationale: Creates strong civil enforcement against Medicaid false claims, requires Attorney General action, and protects employees from retaliation. This is public-program integrity and whistleblower policy, not a broad public-versus-private healthcare allocation rule.

title: Medicaid fraud, crime of further provided for, statutes of limitations revised for certain fraudulent activity, Sec. 22-1-11 am'd.
description: Medicaid fraud, crime of further provided for, statutes of limitations revised for certain fraudulent activity, Sec. 22-1-11 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises Medicaid fraud offenses and limitations periods. This is punitive program-integrity enforcement, not healthcare-access restriction itself.

title: Abortion, Alabama Unborn Child Protection from Dismemberment Abortion Act, prohibits and punishes person performing unless necessary to prevent serious health risk to mother
description: Abortion, Alabama Unborn Child Protection from Dismemberment Abortion Act, prohibits and punishes person performing unless necessary to prevent serious health risk to mother
frontier_rationale: Bans and penalizes a specified abortion procedure except for serious maternal health risks. This directly restricts abortion access.

title: Transportation Department, contracts, public to private firms, construction and maintenance of road and public improvement projects, Sec. 23-1-40 am'd.
description: Transportation Department, contracts, public to private firms, construction and maintenance of road and public improvement projects, Sec. 23-1-40 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands or revises Transportation Department contracting with private firms for construction and maintenance of roads and public improvements, favoring private delivery of public works.

title: Americans First Act, clarifying status of institutions of higher education as agencies of state under Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act and required to comply with all immigration laws or be subject to forfeiture of certain funds, Sec. 31-13-5.1 added
description: Americans First Act, clarifying status of institutions of higher education as agencies of state under Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act and required to comply with all immigration laws or be subject to forfeiture of certain funds, Sec. 31-13-5.1 added
frontier_rationale: Conditions higher-education funding on compliance with state and federal immigration laws. This expands immigration enforcement through fiscal leverage.

title: Oil and gas, drilling and production units, pooling of interests, deduction from proceeds due nonconsenting owners, assessment of risk compensation fee against nonconsenting owners further provided for, Sec. 9-17-13 am'd.
description: Oil and gas, drilling and production units, pooling of interests, deduction from proceeds due nonconsenting owners, assessment of risk compensation fee against nonconsenting owners further provided for, Sec. 9-17-13 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises compulsory pooling, deductions, and risk-compensation charges affecting nonconsenting owners in drilling units. It facilitates collective extraction while burdening dissenting ownership interests; precise direction depends on the amended terms.

title: Medicaid, inmates in county jails and under juvenile court, Medicaid eligibility suspended, not terminated, temporary reinstatement for medical care, payment of court
description: Medicaid, inmates in county jails and under juvenile court, Medicaid eligibility suspended, not terminated, temporary reinstatement for medical care, payment of court
frontier_rationale: Suspends rather than terminates Medicaid for jailed adults and juveniles and permits temporary care reinstatement. This preserves coverage continuity.

title: Child Placing Agency Inclusion Act, state prohibited from discriminating against child care service providers based on religious beliefs, civil remedies
description: Child Placing Agency Inclusion Act, state prohibited from discriminating against child care service providers based on religious beliefs, civil remedies
frontier_rationale: Bars state adverse action against child-placement providers acting on religious beliefs and creates civil remedies. It protects traditionalist religious agencies while permitting service exclusion that can reduce equal access, particularly for LGBTQ applicants.

title: Attorneys, encouraging litigation, criminal penalties increased, Secs. 34-3-24, 34-3-35 am'd.
description: Attorneys, encouraging litigation, criminal penalties increased, Secs. 34-3-24, 34-3-35 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises penalties for attorneys improperly encouraging litigation. It strengthens professional regulation but may chill access-promoting solicitation.

title: Churches, security program established, authorizing designated members to carry firearms, Alabama Peace Officers' Training Commission to administer training, Alabama Church Protection Act
description: Churches, security program established, authorizing designated members to carry firearms, Alabama Peace Officers' Training Commission to administer training, Alabama Church Protection Act
frontier_rationale: Creates armed church-security programs with state-administered training. It expands armed self-protection in religious institutions with qualification requirements.

title: Children, Alabama's commitment to the right to life of unborn children, affirmed, const amend.
description: Children, Alabama's commitment to the right to life of unborn children, affirmed, const amend.
frontier_rationale: Constitutionally affirms a right to life for unborn children. This creates a foundational anti-abortion constitutional principle.

title: Accountability Act of 2013, cap on income tax credits increased, credit against utility gross receipts tax liability for donations to scholarship granting organizations created, audits of scholarship granting entities required, Secs. 16-6D-3, 16-6D-4, 16-6D-6, 16-6D-8, 16-6D-9 am'd.
description: Accountability Act of 2013, cap on income tax credits increased, credit against utility gross receipts tax liability for donations to scholarship granting organizations created, audits of scholarship granting entities required, Secs. 16-6D-3, 16-6D-4, 16-6D-6, 16-6D-8, 16-6D-9 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises scholarship-credit caps and adds a utility-tax credit while requiring audits. It expands tax-supported school choice with oversight.

title: Firearms, possession and carrying of, certain requirements for, repealed or deleted, Secs. 9-11-304, 13A-11-50, 13A-11-51, 13A-11-52, 13A-11-59, 13A-11-71, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, repealed; Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
description: Firearms, possession and carrying of, certain requirements for, repealed or deleted, Secs. 9-11-304, 13A-11-50, 13A-11-51, 13A-11-52, 13A-11-59, 13A-11-71, 13A-11-73, 13A-11-74, repealed; Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Repeals multiple firearm possession and carrying requirements. This directly expands gun rights.

title: Medicaid, inmates in co. jails and under juvenile court, Medicaid eligibility suspended, not terminated, temporary reinstatement for med. care, payment of costs
description: Medicaid, inmates in co. jails and under juvenile court, Medicaid eligibility suspended, not terminated, temporary reinstatement for med. care, payment of costs
frontier_rationale: Suspends rather than terminates Medicaid during jail or juvenile custody and allows temporary reinstatement. This preserves coverage continuity.

title: Firearm, possession prohibited at certain places including by persons with a valid pistol permit, exception for qualified retired law enforcement officers, Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
description: Firearm, possession prohibited at certain places including by persons with a valid pistol permit, exception for qualified retired law enforcement officers, Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Prohibits firearm possession in specified places even for permit holders, with a retired-officer exception. This strengthens location-based gun restrictions.

title: Homicide, crime of homicide by vehicle or vessel, created, penalties, Marshall James Walton Highway Safety Act
description: Homicide, crime of homicide by vehicle or vessel, created, penalties, Marshall James Walton Highway Safety Act
frontier_rationale: Creates vehicular or vessel homicide offenses. This expands traffic-safety protection through criminal punishment.

title: Criminal sex offenders over age 21, sex offenses against child 12 years of age or younger, surgical castration required prior to release from custody of Corrections Department
description: Criminal sex offenders over age 21, sex offenses against child 12 years of age or younger, surgical castration required prior to release from custody of Corrections Department
frontier_rationale: Requires surgical castration before release for specified adult sex offenders. This is an exceptionally punitive and bodily intrusive sanction.

title: Attorneys, encouraging litigation, criminal penalties increased, Secs. 34-3-24, 34-3-35 am'd.
description: Attorneys, encouraging litigation, criminal penalties increased, Secs. 34-3-24, 34-3-35 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises penalties for attorneys improperly encouraging litigation. It expands professional enforcement and may chill solicitation.

title: Baldwin Co., sheriff and deputies, retirement, furnishing firearm, Sec. 45-2-234.40 am'd.
description: Baldwin Co., sheriff and deputies, retirement, furnishing firearm, Sec. 45-2-234.40 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows Baldwin County to furnish retiring sheriffs or deputies a firearm. This is a narrow retirement benefit, not general gun access.

title: Forestry Commission, rules concerning state forests and other land it controls, criminal penalties for violations; Sec. 9-13-10.2 added
description: Forestry Commission, rules concerning state forests and other land it controls, criminal penalties for violations; Sec. 9-13-10.2 added
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Forestry Commission rules for state lands with criminal enforcement. This is public-land regulation rather than ordinary criminal justice.

title: Campaign finance reports, electronic filing required without exceptions, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd.
description: Campaign finance reports, electronic filing required without exceptions, Sec. 17-5-8 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates exceptions to electronic campaign-finance filing, strengthening standardized disclosure.

title: Legislature, members of, providing consulting services, persons compensating members to notify Ethics Commission of certain arrangements, Sec. 36-25-7.1 added
description: Legislature, members of, providing consulting services, persons compensating members to notify Ethics Commission of certain arrangements, Sec. 36-25-7.1 added
frontier_rationale: Requires disclosure when legislators provide compensated consulting services. This concerns public-official conflicts and transparency rather than campaign financing.

title: Environment, Alabama Legacy for Environmental Research Trust, use of hazardous waste fees for environmental research and education at public colleges and universities abolished, reversion of funds to Public Health Dept., Sec. 22-30B-19 repealed
description: Environment, Alabama Legacy for Environmental Research Trust, use of hazardous waste fees for environmental research and education at public colleges and universities abolished, reversion of funds to Public Health Dept., Sec. 22-30B-19 repealed
frontier_rationale: Abolishes hazardous-waste-fee support for university environmental research and redirects funds to Public Health. This weakens dedicated environmental research.

title: Human trafficking, increase criminal penalties for obstructing enforcement of, Secs. 13A-6-152, 13A-6-153 am'd.
description: Human trafficking, increase criminal penalties for obstructing enforcement of, Secs. 13A-6-152, 13A-6-153 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases penalties for obstructing human-trafficking enforcement. This strengthens anti-trafficking enforcement.

title: Cherokee Co., sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property, and firearms, notice, record keeping requirement, distribution of funds for law enforcement purposes
description: Cherokee Co., sheriff authorized to sell certain abandoned, unclaimed, or stolen property, and firearms, notice, record keeping requirement, distribution of funds for law enforcement purposes
frontier_rationale: Allows Cherokee County's sheriff to sell recovered firearms. This is local asset administration.

title: Custodial sexual misconduct, crimes further defined, community corrections program, alcohol or drug abuse court referral and treatment program included, Secs. 14-11-30, 14-11-31 am'd.
description: Custodial sexual misconduct, crimes further defined, community corrections program, alcohol or drug abuse court referral and treatment program included, Secs. 14-11-30, 14-11-31 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Further defines custodial sexual misconduct and includes community-corrections and drug-court treatment programs within the statute's scope. The measure combines institutional accountability with treatment-program coverage.

title: Firearm, possession prohibited at certain places including by persons with a valid pistol permit, exception for qualified retired law enforcement officers, Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
description: Firearm, possession prohibited at certain places including by persons with a valid pistol permit, exception for qualified retired law enforcement officers, Sec. 13A-11-61.2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Prohibits firearm possession in specified places even for permit holders, with a retired-officer exception. This strengthens location restrictions.

title: Abortion, prohibited under certain conditions, Class A felony; attempted abortion a Class C felony, exceptions
description: Abortion, prohibited under certain conditions, Class A felony; attempted abortion a Class C felony, exceptions
frontier_rationale: Creates a near-total abortion ban with felony punishment and narrow exceptions. This is the strongest possible restrictive direction.

title: Capital punishment, death penalty, attendance at executions, further provided, Sec. 15-18-83 am'd.
description: Capital punishment, death penalty, attendance at executions, further provided, Sec. 15-18-83 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Revises who may attend executions. This concerns death-penalty administration and witness access, not sentence severity itself.

title: Abortion, physicians, duty of care owed to babies born alive after faild abortion, criminal penalties, definitions further provided
description: Abortion, physicians, duty of care owed to babies born alive after faild abortion, criminal penalties, definitions further provided
frontier_rationale: Creates care duties and penalties when a baby is born alive after an attempted abortion. It concerns newborn treatment and provider criminal liability more than pre-procedure access.

title: Gardendale, municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts, authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
description: Gardendale, municipal judges and magistrates for municipal courts, authorized to issue warrant recall fee for failure to appear for municipal ordinance or traffic violation, distrib. to municipal corrections fund
frontier_rationale: Authorizes Gardendale warrant-recall fees. This is local justice financing.

title: Consumer Protection, Alabama State of Emergency Consumer Protection Act, enhanced criminal penalties provided under certain conditions, Sec. 13A-9-111.1 added; Sec. 13A-9-114, 34-14A-14, 34-31-32, 34-36-16, 34-37-17 am'd.
description: Consumer Protection, Alabama State of Emergency Consumer Protection Act, enhanced criminal penalties provided under certain conditions, Sec. 13A-9-111.1 added; Sec. 13A-9-114, 34-14A-14, 34-31-32, 34-36-16, 34-37-17 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Enhances penalties for consumer abuses during emergencies. This is consumer protection through punitive enforcement.

title: Pistol permits, active member of U.S. Armed Forces and an honorably discharged veteran, issuance without payment of fee, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 am'd.
description: Pistol permits, active member of U.S. Armed Forces and an honorably discharged veteran, issuance without payment of fee, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Waives pistol-permit fees for active and honorably discharged military members. This modestly expands permit access for a favored group.

title: Crimes and offenses, to revise the criminal penalties for violations of fleeing or attempting to elude law enforcement, Sec. 13A-10-52 am'd.
description: Crimes and offenses, to revise the criminal penalties for violations of fleeing or attempting to elude law enforcement, Sec. 13A-10-52 am'd.
frontier_rationale: The engrossed text grades flight crossing state lines or causing physical injury as a Class C felony and serious injury or death as Class B, while retaining mandatory six-month-to-two-year license suspension. It expands and differentiates punitive fleeing-and-eluding penalties.

title: Sumter Co., providing for an increased issuance fee for pistol permits, and to further provide for distribution of proceeds, Act 2464, 1971 Reg. Sess., am'd.
description: Sumter Co., providing for an increased issuance fee for pistol permits, and to further provide for distribution of proceeds, Act 2464, 1971 Reg. Sess., am'd.
frontier_rationale: Raises Sumter County pistol-permit issuance fees. The inherited 'weaken regulation' label was wrong; this increases local access costs.

title: Crimes and offenses, crime of female genital mutilation established, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses, crime of female genital mutilation established, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes female genital mutilation. It protects bodily integrity through punitive enforcement.

title: School Choice and Student Opportunity Act, formation of charter schools on or near military installation, with focus on serving military dependents, authorized, tenure for certificated teachers temporarily serving in charter school preserved, Sec. 16-6F-12 added; Sec. 16-6F-5 am'd.
description: School Choice and Student Opportunity Act, formation of charter schools on or near military installation, with focus on serving military dependents, authorized, tenure for certificated teachers temporarily serving in charter school preserved, Sec. 16-6F-12 added; Sec. 16-6F-5 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Authorizes military-installation charter schools and preserves tenure for teachers temporarily serving there. This expands targeted charter choice with labor protection.

title: Elmore Co., sheriff, authorized to sell firearms to gun dealers with active business license for one year, Act 2007-325, 2007 Reg Sess., am'd, Sec. 45-26-231.02 am'd.
description: Elmore Co., sheriff, authorized to sell firearms to gun dealers with active business license for one year, Act 2007-325, 2007 Reg Sess., am'd, Sec. 45-26-231.02 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Allows Elmore County to sell recovered firearms to established licensed dealers. This is local disposition procedure.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board, require electronic monitoring for certain inmates upon release, to provide for implementation, provide nondriver photo identification upon release from DOC, Secs. 15-22-26.2, 15-22-29, 41-27-3.2 am'd.
description: Pardons and Paroles Board, require electronic monitoring for certain inmates upon release, to provide for implementation, provide nondriver photo identification upon release from DOC, Secs. 15-22-26.2, 15-22-29, 41-27-3.2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Requires electronic monitoring for specified released inmates while also providing state photo identification upon release. It combines greater correctional surveillance with a reentry-support measure and is not election-integrity legislation.

title: Controlled substances, Tianeptine and related compounds added to Schedule II, subject to criminal penalties , Sec. 20-2-25 am'd.
description: Controlled substances, Tianeptine and related compounds added to Schedule II, subject to criminal penalties , Sec. 20-2-25 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Adds tianeptine compounds to Schedule II and subjects possession or distribution to controlled-substance penalties.

title: Abortion, physicians, duty of care owed to babies born alive after failed abortion, criminal penalties, definitions further provided
description: Abortion, physicians, duty of care owed to babies born alive after failed abortion, criminal penalties, definitions further provided
frontier_rationale: Creates or revises care duties and penalties for infants born alive after attempted abortion. It is newborn-protection enforcement associated with abortion policy.

title: Pistol permits, active member of U.S. Armed Forces and an honorably discharged veteran, issuance without payment of fee, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 am'd.
description: Pistol permits, active member of U.S. Armed Forces and an honorably discharged veteran, issuance without payment of fee, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Waives pistol-permit fees for military members and veterans. This modestly expands permit access.

title: Cullman Co., no cost, pistol permits, applicants may make donation to sheriff, sheriff not required to send any information relating to pistol permits or firearm prohibition
description: Cullman Co., no cost, pistol permits, applicants may make donation to sheriff, sheriff not required to send any information relating to pistol permits or firearm prohibition
frontier_rationale: Makes Cullman permits free and removes specified reporting of permits or prohibited status. It expands access while weakening firearm-information safeguards.

title: Pardons and Paroles, mandatory supervised release of inmates, apply certain sentencing provisions to certain defendants, Sec. 15-22-26.2 am'd.
description: Pardons and Paroles, mandatory supervised release of inmates, apply certain sentencing provisions to certain defendants, Sec. 15-22-26.2 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Extends mandatory supervised release and specified sentencing provisions. This favors release before unsupervised sentence completion while imposing supervision.

title: School Choice and Student Opportunity Act, formation of charter schools on or near military installation, with focus on serving military dependents, authorized, Sec. 16-6F-5 am'd.
