description: School Choice and Student Opportunity Act, formation of charter schools on or near military installation, with focus on serving military dependents, authorized, Sec. 16-6F-5 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Authorizes charter schools near military installations focused on dependents. This expands targeted public-school choice.

title: Expungement, to expand the expungement of criminal records to include convictions of certain misdemeanor offenses, traffic violations, municipal ordinances, and felony offenses, to increase the filing fee for expungements, Secs. 15-27-1, 15-27-2, 15-27-4, 15-27-5, 15-27-7 to 15-27-10, inclusive, 15-27-19 am'd.
description: Expungement, to expand the expungement of criminal records to include convictions of certain misdemeanor offenses, traffic violations, municipal ordinances, and felony offenses, to increase the filing fee for expungements, Secs. 15-27-1, 15-27-2, 15-27-4, 15-27-5, 15-27-7 to 15-27-10, inclusive, 15-27-19 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Broadens expungement to convictions across several offense classes while raising filing costs. Its dominant direction is rehabilitative record relief with a financial barrier.

title: Voting rights restoration, application requirement eliminated, Board of Pardons and Paroles to determine eligibility to receive Certificate of Eligibility to Register to Vote, eliminate requirement to pay all fines, court costs and fees, Secs. 15-22-36.1, 17-3-31 am'd.
description: Voting rights restoration, application requirement eliminated, Board of Pardons and Paroles to determine eligibility to receive Certificate of Eligibility to Register to Vote, eliminate requirement to pay all fines, court costs and fees, Secs. 15-22-36.1, 17-3-31 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Eliminates application and full-payment requirements for restoration eligibility. This substantially expands reenfranchisement independent of criminal debt.

title: Parole, Board of Pardons and Paroles, violations, confinement period for parole violation reduced for time served in holding, Sec. 15-22-32 am'd.
description: Parole, Board of Pardons and Paroles, violations, confinement period for parole violation reduced for time served in holding, Sec. 15-22-32 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Credits time already served in holding toward confinement for parole violations. This reduces duplicative incarceration.

title: Elections, qualified visually impaired voters may vote absentee ballot under certain conditions, Sec. 17-11-3.1 am'd.
description: Elections, qualified visually impaired voters may vote absentee ballot under certain conditions, Sec. 17-11-3.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Expands absentee-ballot eligibility or procedures for qualified visually impaired voters, increasing voting access for a defined disability group.

title: Firearms, concealed carry permits, time periods for permits including lifetime permits, fees, statewide standardized issuance and information management, ALEA to estab., firearms prohibited person database, appeal process provided, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 repealed; Secs. 13A-11-70, 13A-11-75, 22-52-10.1 am'd.
description: Firearms, concealed carry permits, time periods for permits including lifetime permits, fees, statewide standardized issuance and information management, ALEA to estab., firearms prohibited person database, appeal process provided, Sec. 13A-11-75.1 repealed; Secs. 13A-11-70, 13A-11-75, 22-52-10.1 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Creates standardized and lifetime permits while establishing a prohibited-person database and appeals. It combines expanded permit duration with stronger screening and due process.

title: Firearms, prohibitions on state enforcement of certain federal firearm laws, provided
description: Firearms, prohibitions on state enforcement of certain federal firearm laws, provided
frontier_rationale: Bars state enforcement of specified federal firearm laws. The inherited regulation-strengthening label was reversed; this expands gun rights.

title: Firearms, certain restrictions on carrying in motor vehicle, Local Government Pistol Permit Revenue Loss Fund, created, penalties, provided, Secs. 13A-11-55, 13A-11-73 repealed; Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-50, 13A-11-61.2, 13A-11-62, 13A-11-71, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-85, 13A-11-90 am'd.
description: Firearms, certain restrictions on carrying in motor vehicle, Local Government Pistol Permit Revenue Loss Fund, created, penalties, provided, Secs. 13A-11-55, 13A-11-73 repealed; Secs. 13A-11-7, 13A-11-50, 13A-11-61.2, 13A-11-62, 13A-11-71, 13A-11-74, 13A-11-85, 13A-11-90 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Repeals vehicle-carry and permit restrictions and creates a fund compensating local permit revenue losses. This is Alabama's permitless-carry expansion.

title: Firearms, President of the U.S., executive orders limiting firearms, local government officials or agents, enforcement by prohibited, Alabama Second Amendment Preservation Act
description: Firearms, President of the U.S., executive orders limiting firearms, local government officials or agents, enforcement by prohibited, Alabama Second Amendment Preservation Act
frontier_rationale: Bars local officials from enforcing presidential firearm restrictions. This expands gun rights through anti-federal enforcement limits.

title: Firearms, President of the U.S., executive orders limiting firearms, local government officials or agents, enforcement by prohibited, Alabama Second Amendment Preservation Act
description: Firearms, President of the U.S., executive orders limiting firearms, local government officials or agents, enforcement by prohibited, Alabama Second Amendment Preservation Act
frontier_rationale: Bars local enforcement of presidential firearm restrictions. This expands gun rights.

title: Schools, failing, scholarships for students assigned to in order to attend another public or nonpublic school, income tax credits for contributions to scholarship granting organizations increased, Sec. 16-6D-9 am'd.
description: Schools, failing, scholarships for students assigned to in order to attend another public or nonpublic school, income tax credits for contributions to scholarship granting organizations increased, Sec. 16-6D-9 am'd.
frontier_rationale: Increases scholarship credits allowing students assigned to failing schools to attend other public or nonpublic schools. This expands tax-supported choice.

title: Relating to the Alabama School Choice and Student Opportunity Act; to amend Sections 16-6F-5, 16-6F-6, and 16-6F-10, Code of Alabama 1975, to change the appointment process for the Alabama Public Charter School Commission; to authorize the commission to hire staff; to require commissioners to receive annual training; to provide additional guidelines for the authorizing and application review process; to provide further for the operational and categorical funding of public charter schools in their first year of operation; and to clarify the per pupil federal, state, and local funding of conversion public charter schools during their first year of operation.
description: Relating to the Alabama School Choice and Student Opportunity Act; to amend Sections 16-6F-5, 16-6F-6, and 16-6F-10, Code of Alabama 1975, to change the appointment process for the Alabama Public Charter School Commission; to authorize the commission to hire staff; to require commissioners to receive annual training; to provide additional guidelines for the authorizing and application review process; to provide further for the operational and categorical funding of public charter schools in their first year of operation; and to clarify the per pupil federal, state, and local funding of conversion public charter schools during their first year of operation.
frontier_rationale: Reforms charter-commission appointments, staff, training, authorization, and first-year funding. This strengthens and expands charter infrastructure.

title: Relating to environmental protection; to amend Sections 22-30E-2, 22-30E-3, 22-30E-4, 22-30E-5, 22-30E-9, and 35-19-4, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide potentially responsible parties with limitations of liability with respect to a brownfield site; to create the Brownfield Remediation Reserve Fund; to add Sections 22-30E-14, 22-30E-15, and 22-30E-16 to the Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for the creation of brownfield redevelopment districts; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style
description: Relating to environmental protection; to amend Sections 22-30E-2, 22-30E-3, 22-30E-4, 22-30E-5, 22-30E-9, and 35-19-4, Code of Alabama 1975, to provide potentially responsible parties with limitations of liability with respect to a brownfield site; to create the Brownfield Remediation Reserve Fund; to add Sections 22-30E-14, 22-30E-15, and 22-30E-16 to the Code of Alabama 1975, to provide for the creation of brownfield redevelopment districts; and to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style
frontier_rationale: Creates remediation funds and redevelopment districts while limiting responsible-party liability. It promotes cleanup through incentives but reduces some liability exposure.

title: Relating to firearms; to provide prohibitions on the use, ownership, or possession of a firearm under certain conditions; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to firearms; to provide prohibitions on the use, ownership, or possession of a firearm under certain conditions; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: The introduced bill imports the January 2022 federal prohibited-person categories into Alabama law—including felons, fugitives, unlawful drug users, certain mental-health commitments, unlawful aliens, dishonorable discharges, qualifying restraining orders, and domestic-violence convictions—and makes possession a Class C felony. It substantially expands state gun regulation and enforcement.

title: Relating to firearms; to amend Section 13A-11-72, Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for persons prohibited from possessing a firearm; to prohibit aliens unlawfully in the United States or aliens admitted under a nonimmigrant visa from possessing a firearm; to provide a penalty for persons in violation of this provision; to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
description: Relating to firearms; to amend Section 13A-11-72, Code of Alabama 1975, to further provide for persons prohibited from possessing a firearm; to prohibit aliens unlawfully in the United States or aliens admitted under a nonimmigrant visa from possessing a firearm; to provide a penalty for persons in violation of this provision; to make nonsubstantive, technical revisions to update the existing code language to current style; and in connection therewith would have as its purpose or effect the requirement of a new or increased expenditure of local funds within the meaning of Section 111.05 of the Constitution of Alabama of 2022.
frontier_rationale: Bars undocumented immigrants and many nonimmigrant visa holders from firearm possession and adds penalties. This combines gun restriction with immigration enforcement.

title: Relating to the state firearms prohibited person database; to amend Section 22-52-10.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to require the judge of probate to report an order, or any modification to a previous order, of involuntary commitment to the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency; to require circuit judges to report any order of involuntary commitment to the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency; and to require the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency to enter an order, or any modification to a previous order, for involuntary commitment received by a judge of probate or a circuit judge, for entry into the database.
description: Relating to the state firearms prohibited person database; to amend Section 22-52-10.1, Code of Alabama 1975, to require the judge of probate to report an order, or any modification to a previous order, of involuntary commitment to the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency; to require circuit judges to report any order of involuntary commitment to the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency; and to require the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency to enter an order, or any modification to a previous order, for involuntary commitment received by a judge of probate or a circuit judge, for entry into the database.
frontier_rationale: Requires probate and circuit courts to report involuntary commitments and modifications to the prohibited-person database. This strengthens firearm screening.

title: Relating to the Alabama Accountability Act of 2013; to amend Sections 16-6D-3, 16-6D-4, 16-6D-6, 16-6D-8, and 16-6D-9, Code of Alabama 1975; to change the terms failing school and nonfailing school to priority school and qualifying school, respectively; to revise and add definitions; to expand scholarships for eligible students attending nonfailing or qualifying schools; to revise the poverty threshold for determining the qualifications of an eligible student; to provide for the qualifying expenses of eligible students with unique needs; to revise the method of determining the amount of educational scholarship awards; to increase the maximum cumulative amount of tax credits that may be issued each year; to require a scholarship granting organization to maintain a reserve balance and to verify the qualifications of an eligible student with unique needs; and to authorize the Department of Revenue to bar qualifying schools or educational service providers from participating in the program under certain circumstances.
description: Relating to the Alabama Accountability Act of 2013; to amend Sections 16-6D-3, 16-6D-4, 16-6D-6, 16-6D-8, and 16-6D-9, Code of Alabama 1975; to change the terms failing school and nonfailing school to priority school and qualifying school, respectively; to revise and add definitions; to expand scholarships for eligible students attending nonfailing or qualifying schools; to revise the poverty threshold for determining the qualifications of an eligible student; to provide for the qualifying expenses of eligible students with unique needs; to revise the method of determining the amount of educational scholarship awards; to increase the maximum cumulative amount of tax credits that may be issued each year; to require a scholarship granting organization to maintain a reserve balance and to verify the qualifications of an eligible student with unique needs; and to authorize the Department of Revenue to bar qualifying schools or educational service providers from participating in the program under certain circumstances.
frontier_rationale: Broadens scholarship eligibility, poverty thresholds, qualifying schools, special-needs expenses, and award rules. This expands tax-supported private and alternative education.

title: Creating Hope and Opportunity for Our Students’ Education (CHOOSE) Act of 2024, established to provide education savings accounts (ESAs) for parents of children to use in providing education services for those children.
description: Creating Hope and Opportunity for Our Students’ Education (CHOOSE) Act of 2024, established to provide education savings accounts (ESAs) for parents of children to use in providing education services for those children.
frontier_rationale: Creates education savings accounts usable for parental education services. This is a major publicly subsidized school-choice expansion.

title: Crimes & offenses, further provides for the crime of discharging a firearm
description: Crimes & offenses, further provides for the crime of discharging a firearm
frontier_rationale: The engrossed text raises discharging a firearm or dangerous projectile into an occupied dwelling, building, vehicle, aircraft, or watercraft from a Class B to a Class A felony while retaining Class C treatment for unoccupied targets. It is a substantial punitive enhancement for dangerous gunfire.

title: Veterans, to establish and operate a statewide integrated health care system dedicated to Alabama veterans and their immediate family members.
description: Veterans, to establish and operate a statewide integrated health care system dedicated to Alabama veterans and their immediate family members.
frontier_rationale: Creates a statewide integrated healthcare system for veterans and immediate families. This expands targeted public healthcare access.

title: Firearms, to prohibit parts converting a firearm into a machine gun
description: Firearms, to prohibit parts converting a firearm into a machine gun
frontier_rationale: Prohibits parts that convert firearms into machineguns. This strengthens gun-safety regulation and criminal enforcement.

title: Alabama Farm Center created, vested with powers and privileges, deemed economic development organization
description: Alabama Farm Center created, vested with powers and privileges, deemed economic development organization
frontier_rationale: Creates the Alabama Farm Center as an empowered economic-development organization. This is institutionally supported agricultural development.

title: Veterans, to establish and operate a statewide integrated health care system dedicated to Alabama veterans and their immediate family members
description: Veterans, to establish and operate a statewide integrated health care system dedicated to Alabama veterans and their immediate family members
frontier_rationale: Establishes a statewide integrated healthcare system for veterans and immediate family members, expanding state-organized healthcare provision for a defined population.

title: Expungement , to provide that a person adjudged youthful offender for a misdemeanor offense, violation, traffic violation, or municipal ordinance violation may file a petition to have records expunged.
description: Expungement , to provide that a person adjudged youthful offender for a misdemeanor offense, violation, traffic violation, or municipal ordinance violation may file a petition to have records expunged.
frontier_rationale: Allows expungement of specified youthful-offender records. This expands rehabilitation and second-chance relief.

title: Office of Occupational and Professional Licensing, created within the Department of Labor; oversight provided to professional or occupational licensing boards.
description: Office of Occupational and Professional Licensing, created within the Department of Labor; oversight provided to professional or occupational licensing boards.
frontier_rationale: Creates a Labor Department office overseeing occupational boards. This centralizes licensing governance and increases executive oversight.

title: Pardons and Paroles; time frame for parole court extended
description: Pardons and Paroles; time frame for parole court extended
frontier_rationale: The enrolled act retains the ordinary 20-business-day parole-court deadline but permits up to 40 business days during a declared emergency, with sheriff agreement for county-jail detention. It preserves counsel, witnesses, confrontation, and a release remedy at the extended limit, but weakens speedy-hearing protection in emergencies.

title: Financial Institutions; to prohibit financial institutions from using a merchant category code to identify firearms transactions; to prohibit disclosure of financial information regarding firearms transactions
description: Financial Institutions; to prohibit financial institutions from using a merchant category code to identify firearms transactions; to prohibit disclosure of financial information regarding firearms transactions
frontier_rationale: Bars financial institutions from using firearm merchant codes or disclosing transaction information. This protects gun-purchase privacy while preventing financial monitoring.

title: Public preK-12 schools, campus chaplains, public schools authorized to hire or accept as volunteers, local boards of education and governing bodies required to vote on whether to allow, limitations provided
description: Public preK-12 schools, campus chaplains, public schools authorized to hire or accept as volunteers, local boards of education and governing bodies required to vote on whether to allow, limitations provided
frontier_rationale: Authorizes public schools to hire or accept volunteer chaplains after a local governing vote. It expands organized religious presence in public schools while leaving adoption to local discretion.

title: Pardons and Paroles; mandatory supervised release of inmates; terms of revocation revised; exception created
description: Pardons and Paroles; mandatory supervised release of inmates; terms of revocation revised; exception created
frontier_rationale: The introduced bill allows full revocation of mandatory supervised release for any violation, requires a new-offense sentence to run consecutively, delays mandatory release for at least three months after parole or probation revocation, and permits a defendant to waive supervised release. Its dominant direction is more punitive revocation and incarceration.

title: Pardons and Paroles Board; allow inmates to participate in parole hearing virtually
description: Pardons and Paroles Board; allow inmates to participate in parole hearing virtually
frontier_rationale: Allows incarcerated people to participate virtually in parole hearings. This expands meaningful hearing access.

title: Crimes & Offenses, prohibited picketing or protesting in certain circumstances and provided criminal penalties
description: Crimes & Offenses, prohibited picketing or protesting in certain circumstances and provided criminal penalties
frontier_rationale: Prohibits picketing or protesting in specified circumstances and imposes criminal penalties. Without fuller text the exact scope is unclear, but its ideological content is restriction of protest activity through public-order enforcement.

title: Crimes and offenses; crimes of unlawful use of DNA in the first, second, and third degree created, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses; crimes of unlawful use of DNA in the first, second, and third degree created, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Creates graded crimes for unlawful DNA use. This protects genetic privacy through criminal enforcement.

title: Medicaid Agency, colorectal cancer screening test, coverage required for test based on grade A or B recommendation from U.S. Preventative Services Task Force
description: Medicaid Agency, colorectal cancer screening test, coverage required for test based on grade A or B recommendation from U.S. Preventative Services Task Force
frontier_rationale: Requires Medicaid coverage of recommended colorectal screening. This expands preventive-care access.

title: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
description: Illegal immigration; procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal aliens provided for; reporting requirements established
frontier_rationale: Creates procedures for arresting, detaining, transporting, and reporting undocumented immigrants. This expands coercive immigration enforcement.

title: Medicaid; providing presumptive eligibility to pregnant women
description: Medicaid; providing presumptive eligibility to pregnant women
frontier_rationale: Provides presumptive Medicaid eligibility for pregnant women. This directly expands timely prenatal coverage.

title: Medicaid; providing presumptive eligibility to pregnant women
description: Medicaid; providing presumptive eligibility to pregnant women
frontier_rationale: Provides presumptive Medicaid eligibility for pregnant women. This expands timely prenatal coverage.

title: Firearms, revise circumstances when firearm possession is prohibited
description: Firearms, revise circumstances when firearm possession is prohibited
frontier_rationale: Creates a mixed firearms and criminal-justice package: some people with a single older nonviolent felony regain firearm eligibility after five years, while covered defendants face new pretrial possession restrictions and the bill increases occupied-target discharge consequences, revocation exposure, and grounds for denying bail. It must remain multi-axis rather than receive one scalar gun-policy label.

title: Crimes and offenses; further provide for the crime of murder, manslaughter, and assault in the first and second degree; provide enhanced sentencing; define machinegun
description: Crimes and offenses; further provide for the crime of murder, manslaughter, and assault in the first and second degree; provide enhanced sentencing; define machinegun
frontier_rationale: Broadens homicide and assault provisions, enhances sentences, and defines machineguns. This is a punitive violent-crime package.

title: Crimes and offenses, crimes of concealing an illegal alien and human smuggling established, process for determining if a detainee is an illegal alien established
description: Crimes and offenses, crimes of concealing an illegal alien and human smuggling established, process for determining if a detainee is an illegal alien established
frontier_rationale: Creates concealment and smuggling crimes and a detainee status process. This expands immigration-related criminal enforcement.

title: Immigration, requires law enforcement agencies to collect and submit fingerprints and DNA from illegal aliens in custody
description: Immigration, requires law enforcement agencies to collect and submit fingerprints and DNA from illegal aliens in custody
frontier_rationale: Requires fingerprints and DNA from undocumented people in custody. This greatly expands biometric immigration surveillance.

title: Crimes and offenses, possession, use, or sale of "whippets," "laughing gas," "poppers," and "snappers" prohibited in certain circumstances, criminal penalties provided
description: Crimes and offenses, possession, use, or sale of "whippets," "laughing gas," "poppers," and "snappers" prohibited in certain circumstances, criminal penalties provided
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes specified nitrous and inhalant possession, use, or sale. The inherited welfare label was erroneous.

title: Youthful offender status, to prohibit a judge from granting youthful offender status to any person who is 16 years of age and older and charged with capital murder or murder
description: Youthful offender status, to prohibit a judge from granting youthful offender status to any person who is 16 years of age and older and charged with capital murder or murder
frontier_rationale: Bars youthful-offender treatment for people age sixteen or older charged with murder or capital murder. This expands adult punitive treatment of juveniles.

title: Illegal immigration, procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal immigrants provided for; reporting requirements established
description: Illegal immigration, procedures for arrest, detention, transportation of illegal immigrants provided for; reporting requirements established
frontier_rationale: Creates arrest, detention, transportation, and reporting procedures for undocumented immigrants. This expands coercive enforcement.

title: Sex offenders; restrictions for certain sex offenders further provided, Board of Pardons and Paroles authorized to adopt rules
description: Sex offenders; restrictions for certain sex offenders further provided, Board of Pardons and Paroles authorized to adopt rules
frontier_rationale: Authorizes parole or probation officers to restrict child-sex offenders' post-office-box and Internet-capable media use, permits treatment and periodic-polygraph conditions across community release settings, and makes knowing noncompliance a Class C felony. This is a clear expansion of supervision and punishment, with distinct civil-liberty and treatment components.

title: Taxation; participation in the federal tax credit for individuals making qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations provided for
description: Taxation; participation in the federal tax credit for individuals making qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations provided for
frontier_rationale: Provides Alabama participation in a federal scholarship-donation credit. This expands tax-supported educational choice.

title: Crimes & offenses; smoking or vaping marijuana in motor vehicle when child is present prohibited, criminal penalties provided, notification of Department of Human Resources required, mandatory reporting if child smells of marijuana required
description: Crimes & offenses; smoking or vaping marijuana in motor vehicle when child is present prohibited, criminal penalties provided, notification of Department of Human Resources required, mandatory reporting if child smells of marijuana required
frontier_rationale: Criminalizes smoking or vaping marijuana in a vehicle with a child and mandates child-welfare notification and reporting. It combines drug enforcement with expanded family surveillance.

title: Natural resources; conversion of oil and gas wells into alternative energy facilities authorized; lease of state lands for energy sources by Commissioner of Conservation expanded
description: Natural resources; conversion of oil and gas wells into alternative energy facilities authorized; lease of state lands for energy sources by Commissioner of Conservation expanded
frontier_rationale: Authorizes conversion of oil-and-gas wells to alternative-energy facilities and broadens state-land energy leasing. It expands energy-development authority across technologies and is not simply fossil expansion.

title: Health care insurance; to eliminate cost-sharing for screening of men who are at high risk for prostate cancer
description: Health care insurance; to eliminate cost-sharing for screening of men who are at high risk for prostate cancer
frontier_rationale: Eliminates cost sharing for prostate screening among high-risk men. This expands preventive-care affordability.

title: Sex offenders; restrictions for certain sex offenders further provided, Board of Pardons and Paroles authorized to adopt rules
description: Sex offenders; restrictions for certain sex offenders further provided, Board of Pardons and Paroles authorized to adopt rules
frontier_rationale: Authorizes electronic-media and post-office-box restrictions, treatment and polygraph conditions, and a Class C felony for knowing violations, while the enrolled version protects Internet use needed solely for job duties subject to reasonable limits. The package expands supervision and punishment but contains a narrow employment safeguard.

title: Public assistance; Department of Human Resources required to request waiver to prohibit the purchase of soda and candy with SNAP benefits, implementation of prohibition provided for
description: Public assistance; Department of Human Resources required to request waiver to prohibit the purchase of soda and candy with SNAP benefits, implementation of prohibition provided for
frontier_rationale: Requires Alabama to seek a federal waiver barring SNAP purchases of soda and candy and provides for implementation, increasing paternalistic conditions on food assistance.

title: Alabama Charter School Finance Authority, bonding authority established, legislative findings, board membership, powers, contracts, investments
description: Alabama Charter School Finance Authority, bonding authority established, legislative findings, board membership, powers, contracts, investments
frontier_rationale: Creates a charter-school finance authority with bonding powers. This expands institutional and capital support for charter schools.

title: Administrative rules; adopting environmental protection criteria stricter than federal requirements prohibited
description: Administrative rules; adopting environmental protection criteria stricter than federal requirements prohibited
frontier_rationale: Bars Alabama environmental rules stricter than federal requirements. The inherited strengthening label was directionally wrong; this caps state environmental protection.
